Authors: Wenbo Chen, Tianfu Li, Haoxuan Xu, Zhihao Cao, Zhenghan Chen, Zhengming Zhu, Zizhou Luo, Guosheng Yang, Yuan Liu, Lujia Wang, Wen Chen, Haoang Li

Geometry-Preserving Human-to-Robot Upper-Body Motion Retargeting from Monocular Video Manipulation

motion retargeting monocular video body-hand reconstruction inverse kinematics dual-arm dexterous robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种几何保持的框架，用于将单目RGB视频中的人体上半身和手部运动重定向到双臂灵巧机器人，集成了统一的身体-手部重建和与形态无关的几何迁移，并在仿真和物理机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a geometry-preserving framework for retargeting human upper-body and hand motions from monocular RGB video to a dual-arm dexterous robot, integrating unified body-hand reconstruction and morphology-independent geometric transfer, validated in simulation and on a physical robot.

Abstract: Monocular RGB video provides an accessible source of human demonstrations for upper-body robot motion, yet video-driven human-to-robot transfer remains challenging because body and hand motion are recovered at different spatial scales, human and robot kinematics differ substantially, and fine distal motion is difficult to preserve across embodiments. We present a geometry-preserving motion-retargeting framework that integrates unified body--hand reconstruction with morphology-independent geometric transfer. Frame-wise body estimates, video-level observations, and detailed hand evidence jointly constrain a single differentiable Momentum Human Rig (MHR) state, while transient hand artifacts are repaired in parameter space. The reconstructed motion is represented by arm-segment directions, elbow configuration, relative palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations, and is realized on the target robot through multi-stage inverse kinematics and robot-specific hand adaptation. Within the broader system, Across-VAM provides video generation, whereas Across-WAM performs human-to-robot motion mapping. The method is evaluated on 16 monocular videos comprising 1,769 source frames, including 10 signing and six reach-to-grasp sequences. Unified reconstruction reduces mean hand reprojection error from 22.36 to 7.21 pixels relative to SAM 3D Body. All 16 retargeted trajectories completed kinematic simulation playback, and representative signing and reach-to-grasp motions were further demonstrated on a physical robot. The results demonstrate a unified pipeline from monocular human video to coordinated upper-body motion on a dual-arm dexterous robot.

摘要（中文）：单目RGB视频为上半身机器人运动提供了易于获取的人体演示来源，然而，由于身体与手部运动在不同空间尺度上被恢复、人体与机器人运动学存在显著差异，以及精细的末端运动难以在跨实体间保持，视频驱动的人到机器人迁移仍具挑战性。我们提出了一种保持几何特性的运动重定向框架，该框架将统一的身体-手部重建与不依赖形态的几何迁移相结合。逐帧身体估计、视频级观察和详细的手部证据共同约束一个可微分的Momentum Human Rig (MHR)状态，同时，瞬态手部伪影在参数空间中被修复。重建的运动以手臂段方向、肘部构型、相对手掌方向及双侧腕部关系来表示，并通过多阶段逆运动学与机器人特定的手部适配在目标机器人上实现。在更广泛的系统范围内，Across-VAM负责视频生成，而Across-WAM执行人到机器人的运动映射。该方法在包含1,769个源帧的16个单目视频上进行了评估，其中包括10个手语序列和6个伸手抓取序列。与SAM 3D Body相比，统一重建将平均手部重投影误差从22.36像素降至7.21像素。所有16个重定向轨迹均完成了运动学仿真回放，具有代表性的手语和伸手抓取运动进一步在实体机器人上进行了演示。结果表明，该框架实现了从单目人体视频到双臂灵巧机器人协调上半身运动的统一流程。

Authors: Xiaoyu Yang, Sen Han, Da Li, Nan Wu

Urgent Actions Go First: Urgency-Aware Denoising for Real-Time VLA Control VLA

Diffusion Policy Vision-Language-Action Model Real-Time Control Denoising Acceleration Receding-Horizon Control

简要说明：本文提出了一种名为UAD的推理时框架，用于扩散/流匹配VLA策略，根据动作执行的紧迫性分配去噪计算。UAD提前释放紧急动作并利用执行时间细化尾部动作，在显著降低延迟的同时保持成功率，并在仿真和真实世界操作任务中得到了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD), an inference-time framework for diffusion/flow-matching VLA policies that allocates denoising computation based on action execution urgency. UAD releases time-critical actions early and refines tail actions during execution, achieving significant latency speedups while maintaining success rates, validated across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks through iterative denoising, incurring substantial inference latency that severely limits real-time robotic control. Existing acceleration methods treat an action chunk as a monolithic computational unit, ignoring a crucial physical reality of receding-horizon control: actions are generated jointly but consumed sequentially, resulting in inherently heterogeneous execution urgencies. We exploit this asymmetry to introduce Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD), a novel inference-time framework that allocates denoising computation according to when each action is physically needed. UAD releases time-critical urgent actions after fewer denoising steps while overlapping the continued background refinement of tail actions with physical execution. However, heterogeneous denoising introduces two key challenges: early-release errors in urgent actions and trajectory inconsistency in tail actions. UAD elegantly resolves both through two core mechanisms: Trajectory Reconciliation, which reconstructs unified internal state evolution to restore joint denoising coherence without additional model evaluations, and Ghost Action Correction, which leverages non-executed ghost continuations to dynamically compensate for early-release errors across remaining executable actions. Extensive evaluations across multiple VLA architectures, simulation benchmarks, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UAD achieves up to a 1.89x speedup in average action availability latency while maintaining comparable success rates to vanilla inference with optimal denoising budget, offering a more favorable success-latency trade-off than state-of-the-art VLA acceleration baselines.

摘要（中文）：扩散与流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过迭代去噪生成动作块，带来了显著的推理延迟，严重限制了实时机器人控制。现有加速方法将动作块视为一个整体计算单元，忽略了后退时域控制中一个关键的物理现实：动作是联合生成但按序执行的，因此存在本质上异构的执行紧迫性。我们利用这一不对称性，提出了紧迫性感知去噪（UAD），这是一种新颖的推理时框架，根据每个动作实际需要的时间分配去噪计算。UAD在较少的去噪步骤后释放时间关键的紧迫动作，同时将尾部动作的持续后台优化与物理执行重叠进行。然而，异构去噪引入了两个关键挑战：紧迫动作的早期释放误差和尾部动作的轨迹不一致性。UAD通过两个核心机制优雅地解决了这两个问题：轨迹调和，重构统一的内部状态演化以恢复联合去噪的一致性，无需额外的模型评估；以及幽灵动作修正，利用不执行的幽灵延续动态补偿剩余可执行动作中的早期释放误差。跨多种VLA架构、仿真基准和真实世界操控任务的广泛评估表明，UAD在平均动作可用延迟上实现了高达1.89倍的加速，同时保持了与具有最优去噪预算的原始推理相当的成功率，相较于最先进的VLA加速基线，提供了更优的成功率-延迟权衡。

Authors: Zibo Wang, Haochen Han, Pengzhen Ren, Mingtong Dai, Fangming Liu

Faster and Better? Benchmark Bugs and Design Limitations Distort the Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Acceleration VLA

benchmark bugs design limitations VLA acceleration simulated manipulation benchmarks success rate evaluation

简要说明：本文审查了模拟VLA操作基准，识别出22个错误和4个设计局限，这些扭曲了加速方法的评估，并证明修复它们可以逆转方法排名。

TLDR: This paper audits simulated VLA manipulation benchmarks, identifying 22 bugs and 4 design limitations that distort acceleration method evaluations, and shows that fixing them can reverse method rankings.

Abstract: Simulated manipulation benchmarks are the standard tool for evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the acceleration methods that reduce their inference latency for on-robot deployment. On these benchmarks, we observe that some training-free acceleration methods, which approximate the baseline policy's computation, achieve higher measured success rates than the baseline itself. Success rates alone cannot establish whether such gains come from better task execution or from evaluation flaws. We therefore investigate two kinds of benchmark flaws behind these gains: bugs, where the implementation does not match the intended task or evaluation protocol, and design limitations, where success criteria and simulation settings do not fully capture how acceleration affects task execution. Starting from tasks with anomalous gains, we localize root causes by plotting object trajectories against checker acceptance regions, and classify the resulting bugs into task consistency, initialization, and reproducibility. Extending this audit to seven benchmarks, including RoboTwin, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench, we identify 22 bugs of these types and 4 design limitations. For the latter, we revise permissive success checkers, correct unrealistic object masses, and add a motion-aware score that favors smoother actions. Experiments show that bug fixes can reverse method rankings, moving the baseline from last to first on one task. Addressing design limitations can likewise remove anomalous gains: on another task, the baseline moves from 21 percentage points behind an accelerated method to 5 points ahead. Gains attributed to acceleration can therefore be artifacts of the benchmark rather than better task execution. We release our bug fixes and revised benchmark settings to support trustworthy evaluation of VLA acceleration.

摘要（中文）：模拟操作基准是评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略及降低其在机器人部署中推理延迟的加速方法的标准工具。在这些基准上，我们观察到一些无需训练的加速方法，它们近似于基线策略的计算过程，却实现了比基线本身更高的实测成功率。仅凭成功率无法确定此类增益源于更好的任务执行还是评估缺陷。因此，我们研究了这些增益背后两类基准缺陷：一类是bug，即实现与预期任务或评估协议不匹配；另一类是设计局限性，即成功标准和仿真设置未能充分反映加速对任务执行的影响。从出现异常增益的任务出发，我们通过将物体轨迹与检查器接受区域进行对照绘图来定位根本原因，并将由此产生的bug归类为任务一致性、初始化和可复现性三类。将这一审计扩展到七个基准，包括RoboTwin、LIBERO-Plus和VLABench，我们识别出22个此类bug和4个设计局限性。针对后者，我们修订了宽松的成功检查器，纠正了不现实的物体质量，并增加了一个偏好更平滑动作的运动感知评分。实验表明，修复bug可以逆转方法排名，在某一任务上将基线从末位提升至首位。解决设计局限性同样可以消除异常增益：在另一任务上，基线从落后加速方法21个百分点变为领先5个百分点。因此，归因于加速的增益可能是基准的产物，而非更好的任务执行。我们发布了bug修复和修订后的基准设置，以支持对VLA加速的可靠评估。

Authors: Qiwei Chen, Kaijun Zhou, Nuohui Shi, Zhiyang Li, Yuxuan Feng, Jinyu Gu

CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces VLA

semantic state world-action model event-driven interfaces closed-loop manipulation task reasoning

简要说明：CogWAM 提出了一种认知引导的世界-动作模型，通过持久语义状态将任务级推理与世界动作预测对齐，在 RoboDojo、BiCoord 和真实双臂操作中取得了优异表现。

TLDR: CogWAM introduces a cognition-guided world-action model with a persistent Semantic State to align task-level reasoning with world-action prediction, achieving strong results on RoboDojo, BiCoord, and real dual-arm manipulation.

Abstract: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略日益融合语义推理与未来世界预测能力，然而，将这两种能力简单结合并不能确保局部预测与动作始终与任务进度保持一致。为此，我们提出CogWAM——一种认知引导的世界-动作模型，该模型通过一个持久的语义状态（Semantic State）在任务推理与世界-动作学习之间建立了明确的语义接口，该状态存储已完成的任务事件及当前活跃的子任务。CogWAM仅在观测数据指示语义转换时才更新此状态，从而使任务级上下文能够跨越多个动作片段持续存在。为桥接语义上下文与物理预测和控制，CogWAM采用进度条件化的世界（WORLD）查询和动作（ACTION）查询，选择性地提取任务相关信息以用于未来世界预测和动作生成。在训练阶段，语义状态为两个分支提供共享的任务进度上下文，而在推理阶段则移除未来预测分支，直接从观测数据和维护的状态中生成动作。我们进一步引入了语义训练策略，以改善转换学习和闭环条件化。在无需额外机器人动作预训练的情况下，CogWAM在RoboDojo上达到了15.56/11.70%的得分/成功率（Score/SR），并在BiCoord上取得了最先进的性能；同时，真实世界实验展示了闭环双臂操作，其语义状态重生成次数相比逐步更新方式减少了16.4次。

Authors: Sen Wang, Liu Liu, Xinjiang Wang, Zequn Chen, Haoyi Jiang, Taojun Ding, Tingyang Xiao, Zhizhong Su, Jie Wang, Sanping Zhou

ProAct-VLM: Pre-Failure Vision-Language Task Replanning with Continuous Perception Feedback Manipulation

Vision-Language Models adaptive task planning continuous perception feedback long-horizon manipulation pre-failure replanning

简要说明：ProAct-VLM 提出了一种自适应任务规划框架，将 VLM 与实时连续感知反馈相结合，在长时程机器人操作任务中于执行失败前检测环境变化并重新规划，从而提升成功率和效率。

TLDR: ProAct-VLM introduces an adaptive task planning framework that integrates VLMs with continuous real-time perception feedback to detect environmental changes and replan before execution failures in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks, improving success rates and efficiency.

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic tasks are vulnerable to unexpected environmental changes that can render planned actions ineffective or unsafe. To address this, robots must detect such changes as they occur, interpret their impact, and adjust their actions accordingly. Traditional rule-based decision-making pipelines are brittle in open-world conditions, as they are hand-tuned for specific scenarios and lack generalization. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative as they combine broad world knowledge with unified visual--text reasoning, enabling them to generalize across diverse scenarios and generate accurate, grounded task plans. However, for effective deployment in dynamic real-world settings, VLMs must be embedded into frameworks capable of handling uncertainty and environmental changes. Existing frameworks broadly address this reactively, triggering replanning only after execution failures or post-task checks, risking failed actions. Some methods verify conditions before actions, but these discrete checks miss changes occurring during execution. To address this, we present ProAct-VLM, an adaptive, physically grounded task planning framework that integrates VLMs within a real-time perception--feedback loop. ProAct-VLM continuously monitors the environment and re-plans as soon as relevant changes are detected, enabling adaptation before failure occurs. Evaluations against multiple baselines and across different VLM backbones show that our framework improves both success rates and efficiency in dynamic, long-horizon manipulation tasks. Project page: https://github.com/moured/ProAct-VLM

摘要（中文）：长期机器人任务容易受到意外环境变化的影响，这些变化可能使已规划的动作失效或变得不安全。为此，机器人必须在变化发生时及时检测、理解其影响，并相应调整自身动作。传统的基于规则的决策流程在开放世界条件下较为脆弱，因为它们针对特定场景手工调整，缺乏泛化能力。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提供了一种有前景的替代方案，其结合了广泛的世界知识与统一的视觉-文本推理能力，能够在多种场景中泛化，并生成准确、有依据的任务规划。然而，为了在动态真实环境中有效部署，VLMs必须嵌入能够处理不确定性和环境变化的框架中。现有框架大多采用反应式策略，仅在执行失败或任务后检查时触发重新规划，这存在动作失败的风险。有些方法会在动作前验证条件，但这些离散检查无法捕捉执行过程中发生的变化。为此，我们提出了ProAct-VLM，一种自适应、物理基础的任务规划框架，将VLMs集成到实时感知-反馈环路中。ProAct-VLM持续监控环境，并在检测到相关变化时立即重新规划，从而在失败发生前实现自适应调整。与多种基线和不同VLM骨干网络的对比评估表明，我们的框架在动态、长期操控任务中同时提升了成功率和效率。项目页面：https://github.com/moured/ProAct-VLM

Authors: Ahmed Nader Ahmed, Omar Moured, Mughni Irfan Mohammed Abdul, Muhayy Ud Din, Irfan Hussain

BlenDAgger: Blended Shared Control for Interactive Imitation Learning Manipulation

shared control imitation learning interactive learning manipulation data collection

简要说明：BlenDAgger 通过在人工干预期间混合演示者和策略的动作来改进模仿学习，从而在仿真和真实世界任务中取得比完全遥操作修正更高的自主操控性能。

TLDR: BlenDAgger improves imitation learning by blending demonstrator and policy actions during human interventions, yielding higher autonomous manipulation performance than fully teleoperated corrections, validated across simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Robot policies are frequently trained from human corrections, yet teleoperating a robot to provide corrections is burdensome, and human demonstrators are not always optimal. We propose Blended DAgger (BlenDAgger), an approach for collecting data to train imitation learning policies by using shared control to blend the policy's and demonstrator's actions during interventions. By blending human and policy actions, we aim to improve the autonomous performance of manipulation policies. We validate our approach across five manipulation tasks, two in the real world and three in simulation. Our approach achieves higher autonomous performance by 30 or more percentage points on two real-world tasks compared to a typical human-gated correction approach (HG-DAgger). We also investigate the advantages of BlenDAgger that allow for higher autonomous performance, finding that BlenDAgger results in 57% smoother transitions between policy control and human interventions, and 14% higher trajectory similarity to the training data. In a user study (n=14) on two real-world tasks, we find that BlenDAgger results in faster data collection (BF=13.32), and we do not find a difference in subjective perceptions. These results show that blended shared control leads to higher autonomous performance compared to typical methods for fine-tuning robot policies from fully teleoperated interventions.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略通常通过人类纠正进行训练，然而遥控机器人提供纠正既繁琐，且人类演示者并非总是最优的。我们提出了一种名为Blended DAgger (BlenDAgger)的方法，该方法通过共享控制，在干预过程中融合策略与演示者的动作，从而收集数据以训练模仿学习策略。通过融合人类与策略的动作，我们旨在提升操作策略的自主性能。我们在五个操作任务上验证了该方法，其中两个为真实世界任务，三个为仿真任务。与典型的人类门控纠正方法(HG-DAgger)相比，我们的方法在两个真实世界任务中实现了至少30个百分点的自主性能提升。我们还探究了BlenDAgger能够带来更高自主性能的优势，发现BlenDAgger使得策略控制与人类干预之间的转换平滑度提高了57%，轨迹与训练数据的相似度提高了14%。在一项涉及两个真实世界任务的用户研究（n=14）中，我们发现BlenDAgger实现了更快速的数据收集（BF=13.32），而在主观感知方面未发现显著差异。这些结果表明，与从完全遥操作干预中微调机器人策略的典型方法相比，混合共享控制能够带来更高的自主性能。

Authors: Cailyn Smith, Geoffrey Sun, Henny Admoni, Zackory Erickson

Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation VLN

test-time adaptation vision-language navigation decision credit policy improvement sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：本文提出信用引导策略改进（CGPI），一种用于视觉语言导航的测试时自适应方法，利用动作引起的观测转移计算有符号的决策信用，提出轻量级策略更新，并仅保留经过先前信用支持交互验证的更新，在VLN基准上取得一致提升，并展示了零样本仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: This paper proposes Credit-Guided Policy Improvement (CGPI), a test-time adaptation method for vision-language navigation that uses action-induced observation transitions to compute signed decision credit, proposes lightweight policy updates, and retains only updates verified by prior credit-supported interactions, achieving consistent gains in VLN benchmarks and demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Test-time adaptation for vision-language navigation (TTA-VLN) enables pretrained policies to adapt online to unseen environments using only test-time observations and interaction history. However, distribution shifts can distort local action preferences and lead to off-course decisions. Existing methods rely on predictive uncertainty, trajectory-level feedback, or accumulated adaptation experience to correct such deviations. These signals, however, do not directly reveal whether an executed action supports instruction-guided progress toward the goal. Moreover, a plausible corrective signal does not guarantee a reliable policy update. The key challenge is thus twofold: identifying interactions that support goal-directed improvement and determining whether the resulting updates are worth retaining. We observe that each executed action induces an immediate observation transition, providing evidence of its local consequences. Based on this insight, we propose Credit-Guided Policy Improvement (CGPI), which recovers signed, reference-relative decision credit from action-induced observation transitions without external outcome feedback. With the pretrained navigation policy frozen, CGPI uses this credit to propose lightweight adaptation updates and verifies them against prior credit-supported interactions. Updates are retained only when supported and rolled back otherwise. CGPI achieves consistent gains across the evaluated VLN benchmarks and navigation backbones, while qualitative robot trials further illustrate the feasibility of zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：测试时适应用于视觉语言导航（TTA-VLN）使预训练策略能够仅利用测试时的观测和交互历史，在线适应未见环境。然而，分布偏移可能扭曲局部动作偏好，导致偏离路线的决策。现有方法依赖预测不确定性、轨迹级反馈或累积的适应经验来纠正此类偏差。然而，这些信号并不能直接揭示所执行的动作是否支持朝向目标的指令引导进展。此外，一个看似合理的纠正信号并不能保证可靠的政策更新。因此，关键挑战有两个方面：识别支持目标导向改进的交互，以及判断由此产生的更新是否值得保留。我们观察到，每个执行的动作都会引起即时的观测转变，为其局部后果提供证据。基于这一见解，我们提出了信用引导的策略改进（CGPI），该算法从动作引起的观测转变中恢复带符号的、相对于参考的决策信用，而无需外部结果反馈。在保持预训练导航策略冻结的情况下，CGPI利用该信用提出轻量级的适应更新，并根据先前信用支持的交互对其进行验证。仅在更新获得支持时予以保留，否则回滚。CGPI在评估的VLN基准和导航骨干网络上均取得了一致的性能提升，同时定性机器人试验进一步展示了零样本模拟到现实迁移的可行性。

Authors: Yang Li, Sijia Zhang, Yihan Li, Aming WU, Zihao Zhang, Ziju Han, Yahong Han

RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

Hierarchical Physical Knowledge self-improving robotic manipulation dual-loop harness vision-language models physical experience

简要说明：RoboHarn-Evo 提出了一种双环支架，从物理经验中演化分层物理知识，在不更新基础模型的情况下提升长时程机器人操作能力，在RMBench上显著提高成功率，并零样本迁移至RoboDojo。

TLDR: RoboHarn-Evo introduces a dual-loop harness that evolves Hierarchical Physical Knowledge from physical experience to improve long-horizon robot manipulation without updating the base VLM, achieving significant success rate gains on RMBench and zero-shot transfer to RoboDojo.

Abstract: Vision-language models can coordinate long-horizon robot manipulation, yet successful task reasoning still depends on whether local physical interactions produce the intended effects. We study how repeated interaction can improve this capability without updating the base model. We introduce RoboHarn-Evo, a dual-loop harness that evolves Hierarchical Physical Knowledge (HPK) from physical experience. HPK couples two levels of reusable knowledge: Task Knowledge captures which subtask should be executed and when it is complete, while Action Knowledge captures object-relative geometric strategies and their physical effects. During execution, the agent retrieves knowledge at the corresponding decision level and grounds it in the current scene under the task goal. Across episodes, physical feedback is used to revise historical knowledge, update its applicability, and organize reusable entries for subsequent retrieval. Experiments on RMBench show that HPK improves average success by up to 24.2 percentage points across different agent models. With 80 interaction rollouts, held-out success rises from 48.3% to 75.0% for GPT-5.5 and from 70.0% to 88.3% for GPT-6. RoboHarn-Evo also resolves over 83% of historical knowledge errors while retaining 95.8% of valid knowledge, and transfers zero-shot from RMBench to RoboDojo with gains of 35.0 and 25.0 percentage points. These results demonstrate that physical interaction can be accumulated into reusable knowledge for improving subsequent manipulation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型能够协调长期机器人操作任务，然而任务推理的成功与否仍取决于局部物理交互是否产生了预期效果。我们研究了在不更新基础模型的前提下，重复交互如何提升这一能力。为此，我们提出了RoboHarn-Evo，一种双回路框架，能够从物理经验中演化出分层物理知识（HPK）。HPK耦合了两个层级的可复用知识：任务知识捕获应执行哪个子任务及其完成时机，而动作知识则捕获对象相对几何策略及其物理效果。在执行过程中，智能体在相应的决策层级检索知识，并在任务目标的指导下将其具体化到当前场景中。跨回合地，物理反馈被用于修正历史知识、更新其适用性，并组织可复用条目以供后续检索。在RMBench上的实验表明，HPK在不同智能体模型上将平均成功率提升了最多24.2个百分点。在80次交互回放后，GPT-5.5的未见场景成功率从48.3%提升至75.0%，GPT-6从70.0%提升至88.3%。RoboHarn-Evo还解决了超过83%的历史知识错误，同时保留了95.8%的有效知识，并从RMBench零样本迁移至RoboDojo，分别获得35.0和25.0个百分点的提升。这些结果表明，物理交互可以被积累为可复用知识，从而改进后续操作任务的表现。

Authors: Shifeng Bao, Fanding Huang, Yihan Lin, Youhe Feng, Guanlin Li, Chen Zhao, Yang Li, Jiawei He, Cheng Chi, Jing Zhang

Wrench-ACT: Enhancing Robot Policies for Contact Rich Behavior Using Direct Wrench Control Manipulation

wrench control imitation learning contact-rich manipulation force feedback teleoperation Action Chunking with Transformers

简要说明：本文提出Wrench-ACT，一种模仿学习策略，其动作输出仅为力/力矩（wrench），直接供纯力控制器使用，基于双边力反馈遥操作演示训练，在五个接触丰富的操作任务上达到或超越基于位置的基线方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces Wrench-ACT, an imitation learning policy that predicts wrenches (force/torque) as the sole action output for direct use by a pure force controller, trained on bilateral wrench demonstrations and evaluated on five contact-rich manipulation tasks where it matches or outperforms position-based baselines.

Abstract: While contact-rich manipulation requires deliberate regulation of interaction forces, recent approaches to robot manipulation learning predominantly represent actions as target positions or poses. Even methods that incorporate force sensing either use it solely as an observation or, when predicting forces as part of the output, rely on a hybrid force controller. In this paper, we propose an imitation learning policy that predicts wrenches as its sole action output for direct use by a pure force controller. Our studies suggest that force-domain imitation learning depends critically on data collection, with force-feedback teleoperation improving policy performance by capturing the operator's deliberate force regulation. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) as the base architecture, we train single-task models on bilateral wrench demonstrations and evaluate them on five contact-rich manipulation tasks. The wrench policy matches or outperforms position-based baselines across all tasks, with gains varying according to the degree of deliberate force regulation each task requires. Cross-condition ablations show that the bilateral data collection interface and the wrench action space each contribute independently to performance. To support further research, we will release over 1000 wrench-action demonstrations spanning these tasks on a companion website upon publication.

摘要（中文）：摘要：尽管富含接触的操作需要对交互力进行审慎调节，但近期机器人操作学习的方法主要将动作表示为目标位置或姿态。即使融合了力传感的方法，要么仅将其用作观测信息，要么在将力预测作为输出的一部分时，依赖混合力控制器。本文提出了一种模仿学习策略，该策略将力旋量作为其唯一的动作输出，供纯力控制器直接使用。我们的研究表明，力域模仿学习的关键在于数据采集，而力反馈遥操作通过捕捉操作者的审慎力调节，提升了策略性能。以带动作分块的Transformer（ACT）为基础架构，我们在双边力旋量演示上训练单任务模型，并在五个富含接触的操作任务上对其进行评估。在所有任务中，力旋量策略均达到或超过了基于位置基线的表现，其增益因各任务所需审慎力调节程度的不同而有所差异。交叉条件消融实验表明，双边数据采集界面与力旋量动作空间各自独立地贡献于性能提升。为支持进一步研究，我们将在论文发表后在配套网站上发布涵盖这些任务的1000余个力旋量动作演示数据。

Authors: Johannes Hechtl, Yannik Blei, Simon Ball, Reihaneh Mirjalili, Michael Krawez, Seongjin Bien, Philipp Schmitt, Wolfram Burgard

RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation VLA

neural ISP RAW processing vision-language-action models robotic manipulation robustness

简要说明：RawVLA 引入了一个流式神经ISP，为冻结的VLA策略自适应处理RAW相机观测，提高了在退化成像条件下的鲁棒性，并提出了RawVLA-Bench基准来评估图像处理对机器人操作的影响。

TLDR: RawVLA introduces a streaming neural ISP that adaptively processes RAW camera observations for frozen VLA policies, improving robustness to degraded imaging conditions. It also presents RawVLA-Bench, a benchmark evaluating image processing effects on robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常处理由固定相机图像信号处理器（ISP）生成的RGB图像，而成像流水线被排除在学习与评估闭环之外。我们系统性地考察了这一被忽视的设计选择在五个基本ISP维度上产生的后果：增益、传感器噪声、色彩响应、色调响应以及位深。我们的分析表明，RAW到RGB的转换过程实质上同时影响着动作预测与操作成功率，且不同ISP维度所产生的影响存在显著差异。基于这些发现，我们提出了RawVLA——一种流式神经ISP，能够为冻结的VLA策略自适应地渲染RAW观测数据，同时将其建模能力集中于与具身行为相关的成像因素上。此外，我们构建了RawVLA-Bench，一个RAW域操作基准测试平台，旨在将图像处理作为显式评估变量，覆盖干净与恶劣采集条件。在RawVLA-Bench上的实验表明，RawVLA在标准条件下保持原有性能的同时，显著提升了降质成像条件下的鲁棒性，从而确立了自适应RAW处理作为物理相机与具身策略之间有效接口的地位。

Authors: Shuhong Liu, Heng Zhou, Lingfeng Qian, Yuhao Fang, Xianbao Hou, Qianyu Zhou, Lin Gu, Wei Sui, Jianfei Yang, Ziteng Cui

Anisotropic Representations Improve Planning in JEPA World Models WorldModel

latent world models anisotropic representations planning JEPA visual control

简要说明：本文提出AnisoWM，一种使用各向异性高斯正则化（可学习对角协方差）的潜在世界模型，使潜在规划成本与任务结果对齐，在四个视觉控制环境中提高了规划成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces AnisoWM, a latent world model that uses anisotropic Gaussian regularization with learnable diagonal covariance to align latent planning costs with task outcomes, improving planning success across four visual control environments.

Abstract: Latent world models learn action-conditioned dynamics in representation space and often score candidate actions by Euclidean distance to a goal representation. Joint training typically regularizes the representation to prevent collapse, but the resulting representation geometry also determines how terminal errors are weighted during planning. We show that accurate prediction and noncollapsed representations do not guarantee a task-aligned latent planning cost: isotropic Gaussian regularization can induce a geometry that ranks feasible outcomes differently from the task cost. To address this mismatch, we introduce AnisoWM with $Λ$Reg, which replaces the fixed isotropic Gaussian target with a learnable diagonal covariance under fixed-trace and anisotropy constraints. The prediction objective, predictor architecture, and Euclidean planner remain unchanged; the target is used only during training. Our analysis characterizes the prediction-driven allocation of target variance, its dependence on the training distribution, and the conditions under which the induced metric reduces planning regret. Across four visual control environments, AnisoWM improves planning success over LeWorldModel in all four. Its latent planning cost also shows better agreement with task outcomes. Project website: https://rkdrn79.github.io/AnisoWM-page/

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型在表示空间中学习基于动作的条件动力学，并通常通过目标表示的欧氏距离对候选动作进行评分。联合训练通常会规范化表示以防止塌缩，但由此产生的表示几何结构也决定了规划过程中终端误差的加权方式。我们证明，准确的预测和非塌缩的表示并不能保证与任务对齐的潜在规划成本：各向同性高斯正则化可能诱导出一种几何结构，使得对可行结果的排序与任务成本不一致。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们引入了带有$Λ$Reg的AnisoWM，它用固定迹和各向异性约束下的可学习对角协方差替代固定的各向同性高斯目标。预测目标、预测器架构和欧氏规划器均保持不变；该目标仅在训练期间使用。我们的分析刻画了预测驱动的目标方差分配、其对训练分布的依赖性，以及诱导度量降低规划遗憾的条件。在四个视觉控制环境中，AnisoWM在规划成功率上均优于LeWorldModel。其潜在规划成本与任务结果表现出更好的一致性。项目网站：https://rkdrn79.github.io/AnisoWM-page/

Authors: Mingu Kang, Yoori Oh, Sookyung Kim, Joonseok Lee

FP2: Equipping Robotic Foundation Models with Force Control Manipulation

force control robotic foundation models contact-rich manipulation action-regulation decomposition

简要说明：FP2提出了一种轻量级下游接口，通过动作-调节分解为任务适应的机器人基础模型（RFM）添加显式力控制，在多种RFM骨干的接触丰富操作任务中提升了性能。

TLDR: FP2 introduces a lightweight downstream interface that adds explicit force control to task-adapted robotic foundation models (RFMs) via an action-regulation decomposition, improving performance in contact-rich manipulation tasks with multiple RFM backbones.

Abstract: Robotic foundation models (RFMs) are increasingly capable of general-purpose manipulation, yet reliable physical interaction remains challenging in contact-rich settings. We present FP2, a lightweight downstream interface that equips task-adapted RFMs with explicit force control while preserving their action-generation capability. FP2 adopts an action-regulation decomposition: the task-adapted RFM serves as a foundation policy responsible for task-level action generation, while a high-frequency force control policy focuses solely on interaction regulation. To condition force regulation on the ongoing manipulation, FP2 compresses foundation-policy contextual representations and combines them with wrench and proprioceptive histories to predict structured force-control parameters. We evaluate FP2 with four RFM backbones across four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks. FP2 consistently improves task performance and force regulation quality over the corresponding foundation policies, while comparing favorably with representative force-aware and force-control baselines. Ablations further show that foundation-policy context and physical feedback are complementary for effective force regulation, while preserving foundation-policy action generation improves both efficiency and novel-object generalization. Project website: http://force-policy.github.io/fp2

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型（RFMs）在通用操作任务中能力日益增强，但在高接触场景下的可靠物理交互仍具挑战性。我们提出FP2，一种轻量级下游接口，能够为任务适配的RFMs赋予显式力控制能力，同时保留其动作生成功能。FP2采用动作-调节分解架构：任务适配的RFM作为基础策略，负责任务级动作生成，而高频力控制策略仅专注于交互调节。为了将力调节与当前操作状态关联，FP2压缩基础策略的上下文表示，并将其与力和位姿历史信息相结合，以预测结构化的力控制参数。我们在四项真实世界高接触操作任务中，使用四种RFM骨干网络对FP2进行了评估。FP2在任务性能和力调节质量上均持续优于对应的基础策略，同时与具有代表性的力感知及力控制基线方法相比也表现更优。消融实验进一步表明，基础策略上下文与物理反馈对有效力调节具有互补作用，而保留基础策略的动作生成能力则同时提升了效率与新物体的泛化能力。项目网站：http://force-policy.github.io/fp2

Authors: Hongjie Fang, Shirun Tang, Junjian Hu, Shidong Zhang, Derek Zhang, Linhao Chen, Dehai Li, Mingyu Mei, Wanxi Liu, Cewu Lu, Shiquan Wang

Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation Manipulation

World-Action Models post-deployment learning dexterous manipulation classifier-free guidance visual world prediction

简要说明：DEWO 通过在部署后学习中增加视觉世界模型监督和基于任务进展的引导，改进了灵巧操作中的世界-动作模型，提高了模拟和真实机器人任务的成功率。

TLDR: DEWO improves World-Action Models in dexterous manipulation by adding visual world-model supervision and task-progress-guided classifier-free guidance during post-deployment learning, boosting success rates on simulated and real robot tasks.

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

摘要（中文）：世界行为模型（WAMs）将动作生成与物理交互如何展开的预测相结合。然而，当前的部署后学习范式通常仅通过改进行为而不要求更好的世界预测来提升性能。特别是在灵巧操作任务中，微小的执行误差会在高维动作空间中不断累积，阻碍策略改进，并使交互超出世界模型的训练分布。受此启发，我们提出了直接经验世界模型优化（DEWO），一种面向WAMs的部署后学习范式，它在动作模仿的同时，通过视觉经验细化世界表示，以更好地调节动作生成。具体而言，该方法识别交互转折点，并从成功与失败的未来状态中学习，以支持无分类器引导。此外，一个额外的价值头从视频表示中估计任务进度，并在推理过程中进度停滞时激活引导机制。在五个DexJoCo任务中，DEWO在所有三种WAM变体上均提升了平均成功率。消融实验表明，来自成功与失败延续的视觉监督在预测和控制两方面均优于单纯的动作监督。在Wuji和Sharpa上的四项真实世界任务中，3×3网格评估显示，经过两轮部署学习后，在至少有一次初始成功的单元格中，成功率从51.0%提升至71.7%，提升了20.7个百分点。这些发现支持通过部署经验持续进行预测学习以改进控制，使世界建模成为WAM自适应过程中的主动组成部分。

Authors: Xiangcheng Zhan, Zirui Chen, Yicheng Zhao, Ziteng Gao, Shuo Yang

Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies Manipulation

few-shot policy learning coding agent keyframe extraction bimanual manipulation LIBERO

简要说明：Encore 提出了一种少样本智能体系统，将演示提炼为关键帧包，使编码智能体能够编写并改进操作策略，从而泛化到扰动任务并在真实双臂机器人上运行。

TLDR: Encore introduces a few-shot agentic system that distills demonstrations into keyframe packs, enabling a coding agent to write and refine manipulation policies that generalize to perturbed tasks and run on real bimanual robots.

Abstract: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.

摘要（中文）：编码智能体如今已能在他人的少量帮助下编写、运行和调试程序。然而，机器人任务通常仅以一句话的形式给出规格说明，句中未提及如何抓取、以何种顺序进行接触以及最终结果应呈现何种形态，而仅凭这一句话的智能体必须通过试错来摸索这些细节。我们提出了ENCORE，该方法为智能体提供少量演示作为可供阅读的依据，而非作为训练数据。一个确定性的构建器将每次演示提炼为一组多视角关键帧、夹爪事件、帧条以及完整轨迹。编码智能体研究该数据包，针对固定的感知与动作API编写策略程序，在几次开发 rollout 中迭代优化，并在封闭评估前冻结程序——该评估过程绝不透露成功信号。在LIBERO-PRO上，智能体的首个程序在带演示的一半扰动任务中即告成功，在无演示的一个任务中也能成功；而冻结后的程序性能超越了使用相同语言模型的最强先前智能体系统（96.3%对比89.3%）。在指令未说明目标的RoboDojo任务中，若无演示，任何程序都无法成功。ENCORE还可在真实双臂机器人上运行，仅凭各五次演示即可学会立方体交接和杯子翻转任务。

Authors: Yifan Kang, Zihan Wang, Zhiwen Fan, Bangya Liu

DROM: A Language-Guided Diffusion Framework for Multi-Skill Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

language-conditioned diffusion Dynamic Movement Primitives multi-skill manipulation long-horizon task decomposition Motion Planning Diffusion

简要说明：DROM 是一个语言引导的扩散框架，利用 DMP 增强演示数据，并通过 LLM 将语言指令分解为技能序列，从而以少量数据实现多技能和长期机器人操作。

TLDR: DROM is a language-guided diffusion framework that uses DMPs to augment demonstrations and an LLM to decompose language instructions into skills, enabling multi-skill and long-horizon robotic manipulation with limited data.

Abstract: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse, long-horizon tasks from limited demonstrations remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. We present DROM, a language-guided diffusion framework that enables robots to learn, represent, and compose multiple manipulation skills within a single generative policy. DROM leverages Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) to augment a small set of expert demonstrations into expressive multi-skill datasets, substantially reducing data collection while improving spatial generalization beyond the demonstrated workspace. Building upon Motion Planning Diffusion (MPD), we extend the diffusion architecture to support language-conditioned multi-skill trajectory generation through cross-attention, allowing a single model to generate skill-consistent motions for a diverse set of manipulation primitives, including orientation-sensitive behaviors that are difficult to design using conventional motion planning or hard-coded controllers. For long-horizon manipulation, a large language model decomposes high-level operator requests into executable sequences of skills, enabling natural language interaction and autonomous task execution. We validate DROM on a Franka Emika Panda robot, a FANUC CRX25ia robot, and in MuJoCo simulation across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that DROM outperforms Motion Planning Diffusion and Behavior Cloning baselines, achieves robust multi-skill generalization, and composes learned skills to reliably execute long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural language instructions using only a limited number of human demonstrations. Datasets, simulation environments, and more at https://github.com/automation-robotics-machines/drom.

摘要（中文）：从有限的示范中学习针对多样化、长时间跨度任务的稳健操作策略，仍然是机器人领域的一项基本挑战。我们提出了DROM，一个语言引导的扩散框架，使机器人能够在单一生成策略中学习、表示和组合多种操作技能。DROM利用动态运动原语（DMPs）将少量专家示范扩充为表现力丰富的多技能数据集，大幅减少了数据收集工作，同时提升了超出示范工作空间的空间泛化能力。基于运动规划扩散（MPD），我们扩展了扩散架构，通过交叉注意力支持语言条件化的多技能轨迹生成，使单一模型能够为多样化的操作原语生成与技能一致的运动，包括那些难以通过传统运动规划或硬编码控制器设计的姿态敏感行为。对于长时间跨度的操作任务，大语言模型将高层操作员请求分解为可执行的技能序列，从而实现自然语言交互和自主任务执行。我们在Franka Emika Panda机器人、FANUC CRX25ia机器人以及MuJoCo仿真环境中，对多种操作任务进行了DROM的验证。实验结果表明，DROM优于运动规划扩散和行为克隆基线方法，实现了稳健的多技能泛化，并能组合所学技能，仅凭有限数量的人类示范即可可靠地执行来自自然语言指令的长时间跨度操作任务。数据集、仿真环境及更多信息请参见https://github.com/automation-robotics-machines/drom。

Authors: Vincenzo Pomponi, Rocco Felici, Paolo Franceschi, Stefano Baraldo, Oliver Avram, Loris Roveda, Luca Maria Gambardella, Anna Valente

Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing VLA

VLA execution errors self-compensation RoboStress benchmark online adaptation

简要说明：本文提出一种部署时自适应方法，使VLA策略能预补偿机器人执行误差，并引入RoboStress模拟基准，在仿真和真实机械臂上显著提升任务成功率。

TLDR: The paper proposes a deployment-time adaptation method for VLA policies to pre-compensate for robot execution errors, and introduces RoboStress, a simulation benchmark with controlled execution-error scenarios, demonstrating significant task success gains on simulated and physical robot arms.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail when a robot's executed motion deviates from their commanded action. Such execution errors arise from the robot's mechanics and operating conditions, such as wear and payload changes. We propose self-compensating VLA, a deployment-time adaptation method that enables a VLA policy to pre-compensate for the robot's execution errors when generating commands. Without task rewards or labels, it updates the policy online using the residual between the action commanded by a VLA and the motion executed by the robot. To stress-test VLA robustness across execution conditions that are impractical to cover with physical robots alone, we introduce RoboStress, a controlled simulation benchmark. It combines established joint-level models of friction, backlash, compliance, and gravity-compensation error into seven deployment scenarios whose execution errors depend on the robot's state and motion history. On RoboStress, self-compensating VLA achieves higher average task success than both the base policies and methods that build in robustness during training. On two physical robot arms with different usage histories, it raises the average task success rate by more than 30 percentage points on each arm, and the gains extend to objects not seen in the task demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人实际执行运动偏离其指令动作时往往会失效。此类执行误差源于机器人的机械结构及运行条件，例如磨损和负载变化。我们提出了一种自补偿VLA方法，这是一种部署时的自适应方法，使VLA策略在生成指令时能够对机器人的执行误差进行预补偿。该方法无需任务奖励或标签，仅利用VLA指令动作与机器人实际执行运动之间的残差在线更新策略。为了在难以仅依靠实体机器人覆盖的执行条件下对VLA的鲁棒性进行压力测试，我们引入了RoboStress，一个受控仿真基准。该基准将成熟的关节级摩擦、间隙、柔顺性和重力补偿误差模型整合为七种部署场景，其执行误差取决于机器人的状态和运动历史。在RoboStress上，自补偿VLA相较于基础策略及在训练期间引入鲁棒性的方法，取得了更高的平均任务成功率。在两个使用历史不同的实体机械臂上，自补偿VLA将每个机械臂的平均任务成功率提高了超过30个百分点，并且其增益可扩展至任务演示中未见过的物体。

Authors: Sohyun Lee, Yoonjae Baek, Jaesang Won, Jinnyeong Kim, Kang Hyunwoo, Seung-Hwan Baek, Ivan Laptev, Suha Kwak

V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents VLA

world-action model predictive visual latent flow-matching action expert manipulation DROID pretraining

简要说明：V-JEPA Policy在冻结的预测性视觉潜在空间（V-JEPA 2.1）上构建世界动作模型，联合学习未来潜在预测器和流匹配动作专家，在操作基准上取得竞争性能，并受益于野外视频预训练。

TLDR: V-JEPA Policy builds a world-action model on a frozen predictive visual latent space (V-JEPA 2.1), jointly learning a future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert from task-specific demonstrations, achieving competitive performance on manipulation benchmarks and benefiting from in-the-wild video pretraining.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy.

摘要（中文）：世界-行动模型（WAMs）将未来视觉状态预测与动作生成相结合。通过适配大规模预训练的视频生成器或图像编辑模型，近期一系列代表性WAM同时继承了预测知识及其所依托的模型结构。我们提出的问题是：大规模预测性预训练所诱导出的预测性视觉潜空间，是否足以在不继承完整预训练视觉生成模型的情况下，为有效的WAM学习提供充分基础？为回答这一问题，我们引入了V-JEPA Policy——一个基于冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器潜空间构建WAM的简易框架。该框架中，一个指令条件下的未来潜空间预测器与一个流匹配动作专家在单一下游阶段中从零开始联合训练，预测器产生的未来信息上下文键值状态用于条件化动作生成。V-JEPA Policy总参数量为0.9B，其中可训练参数为0.6B，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa-GR1基准上取得了与代表性WAM及视觉-语言-动作基线相当的性能。在相同的下游框架和训练预算下对多种视觉基础模型进行比较，结果表明V-JEPA潜空间优于判别式、重建式及面向视频理解的其他替代方案，尤其在分布偏移情境下优势更为明显。除任务特定学习外，在DROID视频-指令对上预训练预测器（不使用动作标签）并将其适配为WAM，在下游控制和分布外泛化方面均带来了显著提升。综合而言，这些发现确立了预测性视觉潜空间作为从任务特定演示中有效学习WAM、以及迁移从更广泛真实世界视频中获取的未来建模知识的基础。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy 获取。

Authors: Yang Zhang, Jiangyuan Zhao, Chenyou Fan, Jiayu Hu, Xiu Yuan, Chenjia Bai, Xiu Li

InsightMap: Structured Spatial Modeling for Embodied Multimodal Reasoning VLN

top-down map action-conditioned prediction multimodal backbone R2R-CE RxR-CE

简要说明：InsightMap 提出了一种基于俯视地图的结构化空间建模框架，通过动作条件地图预测增强具身导航，在多个基准和真机上取得优异性能。

TLDR: InsightMap introduces a top-down map-based spatial memory and action-conditioned map prediction framework for embodied navigation, improving performance on R2R-CE, RxR-CE, static spatial tasks, and real robots.

Abstract: Language-guided navigation requires connecting partial observations to a persistent spatial reference and learning how actions change that representation. We introduce InsightMap, a framework that uses top-down maps as both explicit spatial memory and action-conditioned prediction targets. Historical views are linked to labeled map locations, and a shared multimodal backbone jointly learns navigation action prediction and post-action map generation. Map prediction provides auxiliary training supervision, while navigation inference decodes actions from the observed spatial context. An aligned RGB-D data pipeline supports a common interface for navigation, visual question answering, situated reasoning, and 3D grounding. On the validation-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, InsightMap achieves success rates (SR) of 56.9% and 54.9%, respectively. Adding map-prediction supervision improves R2R-CE SR by 4.3 and success weighted by path length (SPL) by 3.2 percentage points. On static spatial tasks, InsightMap achieves 103.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, 60.1% exact-match accuracy on SQA3D, and 53.1% grounding accuracy at 0.5 IoU on ScanRefer with detected object proposals. On Unitree Go2, it outperforms NaVid and NaVILA in hallway, lab, and office environments.

摘要（中文）：语言引导的导航要求将局部观测与持久化的空间参考相连接，并学习动作如何改变这一表征。我们提出InsightMap，一个将俯视地图同时作为显式空间记忆和动作条件预测目标的框架。历史视角与标注的地图位置相关联，共享的多模态骨干网络联合学习导航动作预测和动作后地图生成。地图预测提供辅助训练监督，而导航推理则从观测到的空间上下文中解码动作。对齐的RGB-D数据流水线支持导航、视觉问答、情境推理和3D定位的统一接口。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的验证未见场景划分上，InsightMap的成功率（SR）分别达到56.9%和54.9%。加入地图预测监督使R2R-CE的SR提升4.3个百分点，按路径长度加权成功率（SPL）提升3.2个百分点。在静态空间任务中，InsightMap在ScanQA上取得103.7的CIDEr分数，在SQA3D上取得60.1%的精确匹配准确率，在ScanRefer上使用检测到的物体提议在0.5 IoU下取得53.1%的定位准确率。在Unitree Go2上，它在走廊、实验室和办公室环境中均优于NaVid和NaVILA。

Authors: Hongpei Zheng, Hujun Yin

Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead VLA

Vision-Language-Action models spurious correlations domain-invariant latent lookahead prediction visual robustness

简要说明：本文提出DILL，一种通过域不变潜在前瞻表示学习框架，以减少VLA模型中的虚假相关性，在仿真和真实操作中提升视觉鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces DILL, a representation-learning framework that uses domain-invariant latent lookahead to reduce spurious correlations in VLA models, improving visual robustness in simulation and real-world manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. Counterfactual task-view evaluations show that DILL reduces shortcut reliance, while LIBERO-Plus evaluations demonstrate improved visual robustness, with 69.1% average success, 11.4 percentage points above the strongest baseline. Real-world manipulation experiments further support DILL's applicability beyond controlled simulation. Complementary latent-space diagnostics show that these behavioral gains are accompanied by representations that better preserve task-consistent structure while suppressing domain-specific variation. Our project page is available at https://dill-vla.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在视觉分布偏移下仍显脆弱，往往依赖于与领域特定因素相关的虚假相关性，而非任务相关的结构。我们提出领域不变潜在前瞻（DILL），一种缓解VLA策略中捷径学习的表示学习框架。我们的核心思想是利用从领域变换轨迹数据中学到的领域不变未来潜在表征来监督策略学习。通过对比目标和高斯解缠正则化训练任务-领域编码器，以将任务相关结构与领域特定的视觉变化分离开来。所学编码器随后通过前瞻预测和领域解缠为VLA策略学习提供未来潜在表征，促使策略聚焦于任务相关结构而非偶然的视觉因素。反事实任务视图评估表明，DILL降低了捷径依赖，而LIBERO-Plus评估展示了视觉鲁棒性的提升，平均成功率达到69.1%，超出最强基线11.4个百分点。真实世界操作实验进一步支持了DILL在受控仿真之外的应用可行性。补充的潜在空间诊断表明，这些行为增益伴随着更好地保留任务一致结构同时抑制领域特定变化的表示。我们的项目页面可在 https://dill-vla.github.io/ 访问。

Authors: Junghyun Kim, Ngseo Kim, ChungWoo Lee, Seoyeon Lee, Woo-Jeong Baek, Adam Zhou, Chip Huyen, Jun-Ki Lee, Gi-Cheon Kang, Byoung-Tak Zhang

ReF-HIL: Shaping the Critic around Human Action Neighborhoods for Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

human-in-the-loop RL robotic manipulation value shaping human demonstrations real-world learning

简要说明：ReF-HIL提出了一种人在回路强化学习框架，通过利用成功的人类示范来塑造价值学习，并在学习到的人类动作邻域内约束策略更新，从而在真实机器人操作任务中实现高效学习。

TLDR: ReF-HIL introduces a human-in-the-loop RL framework that shapes value learning using successful human demonstrations and constrains policy updates within a learned human-action neighborhood, enabling efficient real-world robotic manipulation learning.

Abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) offers a promising route to efficient training of robotic manipulation policies by combining autonomous learning with human demonstrations and online corrections. However, insufficient use of successful human experience in value learning prolongs costly real-world training, while persistent imitation penalties can limit value-driven policy improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ReF-HIL, an efficient HIL-RL framework that uses human guidance to accelerate the learning process. Human-Reference-Guided Value Shaping learns an independent value reference from successful human experience to guide online value learning, while incorporating local corrective feedback. A Human Action Fence defines a learned human-action neighborhood, allowing value-driven optimization for better performance without imitation penalties inside while constraining policy and value updates outside. Experiments on five diverse and challenging real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved overall learning efficiency and higher success rates compared with the evaluated baselines. Specifically, ReF-HIL reaches 90% autonomous success in only 18-63 minutes of active training and achieves final success rates of 91.7-100%. These results highlight the potential of human-guided reinforcement learning to acquire reliable manipulation skills efficiently in the real world. Project website: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/ReF-HIL-7762/

摘要（中文）：人类在环强化学习（HIL-RL）通过将自主学习与人类示范及在线纠正相结合，为机器人操作策略的高效训练提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，在价值学习中未能充分利用成功的人类经验，会导致昂贵的现实世界训练时间延长，而持续的模仿惩罚则可能限制价值驱动的策略改进。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了ReF-HIL，一种高效的人类在环强化学习框架，利用人类引导来加速学习过程。人类参考引导的价值塑造（Human-Reference-Guided Value Shaping）从成功的人类经验中学习独立的价值参考，以指导在线价值学习，同时纳入局部纠正反馈。人类动作围栏（Human Action Fence）定义了一个学习得到的人类动作邻域，在该邻域内部允许进行价值驱动的优化以追求更优表现，而无需施加模仿惩罚，在邻域外部则对策略和价值更新加以约束。在五项多样且具有挑战性的现实世界操作任务上的实验表明，与所评估的基线方法相比，ReF-HIL在整体学习效率和成功率方面均有提升。具体而言，ReF-HIL仅需18至63分钟的主动训练即可达到90%的自主成功率，并最终实现91.7%至100%的成功率。这些结果凸显了人类引导的强化学习在现实世界中高效获取可靠操作技能的潜力。项目网站：https://anonymous.4open.science/w/ReF-HIL-7762/

Authors: Shaoyin Luo, Song Wang, Shibo Xia, Tianle Zhang, Zhaowei Liang, Guanghui Shen, Bin Wang, Dan Wu

BCNav: Bearing-Conditioned Depth Policies for Sound Source Navigation RLRobot

sound source navigation direction-of-arrival depth image imitation learning continuous velocity control

简要说明：BCNav通过声源方向估计将声学感知与导航策略解耦，仅使用深度图像和方位角训练策略，通过模仿学习输出连续速度指令，无需声学微调或真实音频数据即可在真实机器人上实现声源导航。

TLDR: BCNav decouples acoustic source localization from navigation by using DOA estimation to provide a scalar bearing to the sound source, then trains a depth-image and bearing-conditioned policy via imitation learning to output continuous velocity commands, enabling real-world sound source navigation without acoustic fine-tuning or real audio data.

Abstract: The ability to navigate toward sound sources extends a robot's reach beyond its visual field, enabling response to auditory events in unknown environments. To equip robots with this capability, existing methods couple acoustic and visual information through joint audio-visual learning in acoustic simulators. However, acoustic simulation is both low-fidelity and expensive, producing a domain gap that prevents reliable real-world deployment, while the discrete action spaces inherited from grid-based simulators introduce an additional kinematic gap on physical robots. To alleviate these issues, we propose BCNav, a decoupled framework that separates the acoustic module from the learned navigation policy using direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation: an estimator provides a scalar bearing to the sound source, so the navigation policy only processes depth images and a bearing angle, two inputs whose domain gaps are well characterized. We collect shortest-path demonstrations with calibrated bearing noise injection and train the policy via imitation learning to output continuous velocity commands directly executable on ground robots. We demonstrate the method in simulation and on a physical robot, navigating unknown environments without any acoustic fine-tuning, prior mapping, or real-world audio data collection. Code is available at https://github.com/york1to/bcnav.

摘要（中文）：对声源的导航能力使机器人的探索范围超越了其视觉视野，使其能够在未知环境中对听觉事件作出响应。为使机器人具备这一能力，现有方法通过在声学模拟器中进行视听联合学习，将声学信息与视觉信息相结合。然而，声学模拟既保真度低又成本高昂，导致域差距问题，阻碍了其在实际环境中的可靠部署；同时，基于网格模拟器所继承的离散动作空间，也为物理机器人带来了额外的运动学差距。为缓解上述问题，我们提出BCNav，一种解耦框架，通过到达方向（DOA）估计将声学模块与学习型导航策略相分离：估计器提供指向声源的标量方位角，从而使导航策略仅需处理深度图像与方位角两个输入，这两个输入的域差距已被充分刻画。我们通过注入校准的方位噪声收集最短路径演示，并利用模仿学习训练策略，使其直接输出可在地面机器人上执行的连续速度指令。我们在仿真环境和物理机器人上验证了该方法，能够在无需任何声学微调、预先建图或真实音频数据采集的情况下，导航未知环境。代码已开源至 https://github.com/york1to/bcnav。

Authors: Yaozhong Kang, Jiang Wang, Takeshi Ashizawa, Benjamin Yen, Kazuhiro Nakadai

Predictive Safety Curricula for Robust Legged Locomotion Locomotion

curriculum learning safety critic legged locomotion ANYmal-D collision reduction

简要说明：本文提出了预测安全课程（PSC），利用对未来安全成本的预测来分配腿部运动训练经验，提高了可靠性并减少了真实机器人上的碰撞。

TLDR: The paper introduces Predictive Safety Curricula (PSC), a framework that uses learned predictions of future safety cost to allocate training experience in legged locomotion, improving reliability and reducing collisions on real robots.

Abstract: Rare but consequential failures can persist in learned locomotion policies for legged robots even when average task performance is high, in part because standard curricula primarily adapt task difficulty rather than the distribution of safety-critical experience. We introduce Predictive Safety Curricula (PSC), a framework for allocating locomotion training experience using learned predictions of future safety cost. PSC trains a distributional safety critic from policy rollouts and uses its predictions to prioritize both terrain contexts and previously encountered randomized events. The resulting curriculum modifies the training distribution while leaving the task reward and policy-optimization loss unchanged. We evaluate PSC in controlled rough-terrain locomotion and in production locomotion systems. PSC improves reliability relative to standard terrain progression, advantage-based replay, and learning-progress curricula, with the largest gains on difficult terrain and under degraded observations. The same allocation principle transfers to two production locomotion stacks. On ANYmal-D hardware, PSC reduces shank-collision incidence by $63\%$ relative to the learning-progress curriculum across three matched training seeds, with a reduction in every seed. On a production stair-climbing platform, PSC eliminates observed shank collisions in the evaluated hardware trials. These results show that learned predictions of future safety cost can provide an effective signal for allocating training experience toward rare failure modes and improving locomotion reliability.

摘要（中文）：罕见但后果严重的失败可能在四足机器人学习运动策略中持续存在，即使平均任务性能较高，部分原因在于标准课程主要调整任务难度，而非安全关键经验的分布。我们提出了预测性安全课程（PSC），一种利用未来安全成本的 learned 预测来分配运动训练经验的框架。PSC 从策略回放中训练一个分布性安全评论家，并利用其预测来优先处理地形环境和先前遇到的随机事件。由此产生的课程修改了训练分布，同时保持任务奖励和策略优化损失不变。我们在受控崎岖地形运动和生产级运动系统中评估了 PSC。与标准地形进度、基于优势的回放和学习进度课程相比，PSC 提高了可靠性，在困难地形和观测退化条件下提升最为显著。相同的分配原则可迁移到两个生产级运动栈。在 ANYmal-D 硬件上，PSC 在三个匹配的训练种子中，相对于学习进度课程，将小腿碰撞发生率降低了 63%，且每个种子均有所减少。在生产级爬楼梯平台上，PSC 在评估的硬件试验中消除了观察到的小腿碰撞。这些结果表明，未来安全成本的 learned 预测可以为将训练经验分配到罕见故障模式并提高运动可靠性提供有效信号。

Authors: Ivan Ovinnikov, Pascal Sutter, Christian Gehring, Jordis Herrmann

Beyond Token Importance: Preserving Spatial Scaffolds for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference VLA

visual token pruning spatial scaffold VLA inference acceleration farthest point sampling LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：本文诊断了VLA模型中语义视觉令牌剪枝失效的原因，并提出GeoScaffold这一免训练方法，通过区域预算和最远点采样保留空间骨架，在仅保留20%令牌时保持高成功率并实现1.78倍预填充加速。

TLDR: The paper diagnoses why semantic visual token pruning fails for VLA models and proposes GeoScaffold, a training-free method that preserves spatial scaffolds via region-based budgeting and farthest point sampling, achieving high success rate with only 20% tokens and 1.78x prefill speedup.

Abstract: Existing VLA pruning strategies primarily select individual visual tokens according to task-level semantic relevance, while overlooking the spatial information required for robotic manipulation. To examine this limitation, we construct a simple Stride baseline that uniformly samples tokens along the flattened one-dimensional visual sequence, representing a purely geometric pruning strategy. Surprisingly, Stride outperforms semantic pruning and random pruning at certain pruning ratios, but collapses when the token budget is only slightly reduced. We characterize this phenomenon through the spatial coverage radius, defined as the largest spatial blind spot induced by the retained token set after pruning. Our analysis reveals a strong correlation between the spatial structure of retained tokens and task success, suggesting that reliable VLA pruning requires preserving not only task-relevant tokens but also the spatial scaffold of the scene. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose GeoScaffold, a training-free visual token pruning method that partitions each image into spatial regions, allocates inter-region token budgets using task-relevance weights, and selects intra-region scaffold tokens via farthest point sampling to reduce the local coverage radius. On pi 0.5 and LIBERO, GeoScaffold retains only 20% of visual tokens while preserving a 93.2% average success rate, and achieves a 1.78 times prefill speedup over the unpruned baseline.

摘要（中文）：现有视觉语言行动（VLA）模型剪枝策略主要根据任务级语义相关性选择单个视觉令牌，而忽略了机器人操作所需的空间信息。为探究这一局限性，我们构建了一个简单的Stride基线方法，沿展平的一维视觉序列均匀采样令牌，代表一种纯几何剪枝策略。令人惊讶的是，Stride在特定剪枝比例下优于语义剪枝和随机剪枝，但当令牌预算仅略微减少时便会出现性能崩塌。我们通过空间覆盖半径来刻画这一现象，该半径定义为剪枝后保留令牌集所引发的最大空间盲区。分析结果表明，保留令牌的空间结构与任务成功率之间存在强相关性，提示可靠的VLA剪枝不仅需要保留任务相关令牌，还需保留场景的空间骨架。基于这一诊断，我们提出GeoScaffold——一种无需训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，将每幅图像划分为空间区域，利用任务相关性权重分配区域间令牌预算，并通过最远点采样选择区域内骨架令牌以缩小局部覆盖半径。在pi 0.5和LIBERO基准上，GeoScaffold仅保留20%的视觉令牌，平均成功率仍保持93.2%，同时相较未剪枝基线实现了1.78倍的预填充加速。

Authors: Jiayu Chen, Shuyong Gao, Jingkai Jia, Xiaosheng Bu, Jiyuan Fu, Lingyi Hong, Kaixun Jiang, Yipan Xu, Wenqiang Zhang

ComManip: Overfitting Manipulation Policies to Comfortable Regions Manipulation

comfortable manipulation regions data efficiency mobile manipulation VLA policies limited demonstrations

简要说明：ComManip 提出了一种将操作策略专门化到‘舒适区域’的学习范式，并在推理时通过移动基座使目标保持在熟悉的图像空间范围内，在有限示范下显著提高了多种策略架构的任务成功率。

TLDR: ComManip proposes a learning paradigm that specializes manipulation policies to 'comfortable regions' and repositions the mobile base during inference to keep targets within these familiar image-space ranges, significantly improving task success under limited demonstrations across multiple VLA and policy families.

Abstract: Training robot manipulation policies relies on costly robot demonstrations, making large-scale data collection impractical. Meanwhile, to improve policy generalization, existing approaches seek greater diversity in visual observations by varying object placements, viewpoints, and robot configurations during data collection. However, under a limited demonstration budget, this strategy forces the policy to model diverse visual observations, providing insufficient supervision to learn reliable observation-action correspondences under similar local conditions. Our study reveals that policies trained under this strategy achieve lower task success rates than those trained within a compact, visually and kinematically stable region. We refer to these stable regions as comfortable manipulation regions. To exploit this finding, we propose ComManip, a learning paradigm that specializes manipulation policies to comfortable manipulation regions. During inference, ComManip repositions the mobile base until the detected target center enters the familiar image-space range estimated from comfortable-region demonstrations. It then executes the same manipulation policy, enabling effective manipulation across diverse target locations. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple manipulation tasks, demonstration budgets, and policy families including ACT, $π_{0.5}$, RDT, OpenVLA-OFT, and SmolVLA. The results demonstrate that ComManip improves task success by roughly 20 percentage points or more across different policy architectures in large workspaces under limited demonstration budgets, suggesting that specializing manipulation policies to comfortable regions provides a more data-efficient learning paradigm for manipulation.

摘要（中文）：训练机器人操作策略依赖于成本高昂的机器人示教，这使得大规模数据采集难以实现。与此同时，为提升策略的泛化能力，现有方法通过在数据采集过程中改变物体摆放位置、视角和机器人构型来增加视觉观测的多样性。然而，在有限的示教预算下，该策略迫使策略模型对多样的视觉观测进行建模，导致在相似的局部条件下缺乏足够的监督信号来学习可靠的观测-动作对应关系。本研究发现，在该策略下训练的策略，其任务成功率低于在紧凑且视觉与运动学稳定的区域内训练的策略。我们将这些稳定区域称为舒适操作区域。为利用这一发现，我们提出ComManip，一种将操作策略专门化于舒适操作区域的学习范式。在推理阶段，ComManip重新定位移动基座，直至检测到的目标中心进入由舒适区域示教估计出的熟悉图像空间范围，随后执行相同的操作策略，从而实现对不同目标位置的有效操作。我们在多个操作任务、示教预算以及包括ACT、$π_{0.5}$、RDT、OpenVLA-OFT和SmolVLA在内的多种策略家族上进行了大量实验。结果表明，在有限示教预算下的大工作空间中，ComManip在不同策略架构下将任务成功率提升了约20个百分点或更多，这表明将操作策略专门化于舒适区域为操作提供了一种更具数据效率的学习范式。

Authors: Yidan Lai, Xinyi Chen, Shuquan Man, Huiping Zhuang

AeroManip-VLA: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning for Aerial Manipulation with RL-Generated Demonstrations VLA

aerial manipulation vision-language-action models RL-generated demonstrations simulation benchmark imitation learning

简要说明：AeroManip-VLA 提出了一个基于强化学习生成演示的可扩展空中操作模拟基准，支持自动化数据生成、轨迹分析和 VLA 模型的系统评估。

TLDR: AeroManip-VLA presents a scalable simulation benchmark with RL-generated demonstrations for aerial manipulation, enabling automated data generation, trajectory analysis, and systematic evaluation of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in GPU-accelerated parallel environments.

Abstract: Aerial manipulators extend robotic manipulation into 3D workspaces that are difficult for ground-based robots to access, creating new opportunities for general-purpose manipulation. However, extending Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to aerial robots introduces distinct challenges due to the tight coupling between manipulation and flight, continuously changing observations, and safety-critical physical interactions. These challenges demand diverse training data and systematic policy evaluation, yet collecting demonstrations and evaluating policies directly on physical aerial platforms are costly, difficult to scale, and hard to repeat under controlled conditions. We present AeroManip-VLA, a scalable benchmark for aerial VLA data generation and policy evaluation. AeroManip-VLA provides a GPU-accelerated simulation framework with low-level payload-aware flight and manipulation control in massively parallel environments. Building on this framework, we combine reusable reinforcement learning policies with expert task rules to automatically generate demonstrations without human teleoperation across diverse objects, environments, and randomized initial conditions. The generated data include basic skills such as grasping and placing, as well as long-horizon tasks that require both navigation and manipulation. We further introduce automated event labeling and trajectory categorization to filter demonstrations. These mechanisms enable fine-grained analysis of task progress, behavioral outcomes, and safety-related failures. Finally, we evaluate a range of imitation learning and VLA baselines across different task settings, revealing their performance characteristics and failure modes. Together, AeroManip-VLA enables scalable aerial manipulation data generation, structured trajectory analysis, and systematic VLA evaluation in simulation prior to real-world deployment.

摘要（中文）：空中机械臂将机器人操控能力扩展至地面机器人难以进入的三维工作空间，为通用操控创造了新的机遇。然而，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推广至空中机器人面临独特挑战，原因在于操控与飞行的紧密耦合、持续变化的观测状态以及安全攸关的物理交互。这些挑战要求多样化的训练数据和系统化的策略评估，但在物理空中平台上采集示范数据并评估策略成本高昂、难以扩展，且难以在受控条件下重复进行。我们提出AeroManip-VLA，一个面向空中VLA数据生成与策略评估的可扩展基准平台。AeroManip-VLA提供了GPU加速的仿真框架，在超并行环境中实现低层级的有效载荷感知飞行与操控控制。在该框架基础上，我们将可复用的强化学习策略与专家任务规则相结合，无需人工遥操作即可在多样化的物体、环境和随机初始条件下自动生成示范数据。生成的数据涵盖抓取、放置等基本技能，以及需要同时进行导航和操控的长时程任务。我们进一步引入自动事件标注和轨迹分类机制以筛选示范数据。这些机制能够对任务进度、行为结果和安全相关失败进行细粒度分析。最后，我们在不同任务设置下评估了一系列模仿学习和VLA基线方法，揭示了其性能特征和失败模式。综上，AeroManip-VLA在真实世界部署前，实现了可扩展的空中操控数据生成、结构化轨迹分析以及系统化的VLA仿真评估。

Authors: Rui Huang, Yanlin Mu, Lidong Li, Yucong Wang, Zichen Yan, Lin Zhao

PreferenceFlow: Test-Time Guidance of Flow-Matching Robot Policies from Human Interventions Manipulation

flow-matching policy human interventions preference model test-time guidance robot manipulation

简要说明：PreferenceFlow 利用人工干预偏好和基于梯度的引导，在测试时改进预训练的流匹配机器人策略，在无需环境奖励或策略更新的情况下，提高了真实世界插入任务的成功率。

TLDR: PreferenceFlow improves pretrained flow-matching robot policies at test time using human intervention preferences and gradient-based guidance, achieving higher success rates on real-world insertion tasks without environment rewards or policy updates.

Abstract: Flow-matching policies can represent complex robot behaviors but remain susceptible to local errors under distribution shift at deployment. Many reinforcement learning approaches to policy improvement require reward signals that are difficult to specify or obtain in real-world manipulation. We present PreferenceFlow, a framework for improving a pretrained flow policy at test time without environment rewards or updates to the base policy. Human intervention chunks are paired with robot chunks generated from the same initial conditioning state to train a preference model. During infer- ence, we adopt the QGF sampling update, replacing its value gradient with the preference gradient evaluated at an estimated clean action. A gradient-cap loss penalizes excessive gradients on intervention pairs, while a zero-gradient loss discourages guidance near actions from expert demonstrations. On four real-world precision insertion tasks with a Franka robot, Pref- erenceFlow achieves a mean success rate of 90.5%, compared with 69% for the frozen policy. Ablations support the roles of gradient regularization and correctly ordered preference labels in the evaluated settings. These results demonstrate the utility of human interventions as local preference supervision for guiding frozen generative robot policies.

摘要（中文）：流匹配策略能够表征复杂的机器人行为，但在部署时面对分布偏移仍易产生局部误差。许多用于策略改进的强化学习方法依赖于难以在真实操作任务中明确指定或获取的奖励信号。我们提出PreferenceFlow，一种在测试阶段无需环境奖励或对基础策略进行更新即可改进预训练流策略的框架。我们将人工干预片段与由相同初始条件状态生成的机器人片段配对，以训练一个偏好模型。在推理过程中，我们采用QGF采样更新，将其中基于价值函数的梯度替换为在估计的干净动作处评估的偏好梯度。梯度上限损失用于惩罚干预对上的过大梯度，而零梯度损失则抑制在专家示范动作附近产生引导。在Franka机器人上进行的四项真实世界精密插入任务中，PreferenceFlow的平均成功率达到90.5%，而冻结策略仅为69%。消融实验验证了在所评估场景下梯度正则化及正确排序偏好标签的作用。这些结果证明了人工干预可作为局部偏好监督信号，用于引导冻结的生成式机器人策略。

Authors: Yiqi Tang, Diyuan Shi, Runze Li, Donglin Wang

VidAct: Learning Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos with Object-Centric 3D Awareness Manipulation

video-to-robot object-centric 3D awareness residual trajectory transfer complete-object point cloud zero-shot deployment

简要说明：VidAct 通过单目视频学习物体中心、具3D感知的操作策略，结合网格重建、残差轨迹迁移和完整物体点云预测作为辅助监督，实现零样本真实世界部署。

TLDR: VidAct learns object-centric, 3D-aware manipulation policies from a single monocular video per task, using mesh reconstruction, residual trajectory transfer, and complete-object point cloud prediction as auxiliary supervision for zero-shot real-world robot deployment.

Abstract: Video demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data for learning manipulation, yet existing reconstruction-based approaches often rely on constrained camera viewpoints or human-to-robot retargeting, while the reconstructed trajectories are difficult to adapt to new objects configurations without distorting the trajectory shape. Another key limitation is that the resulting policies often lack precise object-level 3D geometry awareness, limiting object grounding and object shape awareness critical for precise manipulation. To bridge these gaps, we propose VidAct, an efficient video-to-robot framework that learns object-centric, 3D-aware manipulation policies from a single monocular video per task and enables zero-shot real-world deployment. VidAct consists of three key components. First, VidAct reconstructs object meshes and motion from arbitrary demo videos and canonicalizes the motion in the static object frame, avoiding embodiment-specific retargeting and accommodating diverse camera viewpoints. Second, VidAct employ residual trajectory transfer for adapting the reconstructed motion to novel object configurations while preserving its motion shape. Finally, as the key policy-learning component, VidAct predicts simulation-provided privileged complete-object point clouds at each frame as an auxiliary task while retaining RGB-only deployment, providing dense object-centric supervision over both object pose and 3D geometry. Experiments on human, robot, generated, and internet videos demonstrate broad video applicability and zero-shot deployment. Per-frame complete-object 3D supervision improves policy generalization and sim-to-real success, while residual trajectory transfer enables reliable trajectory adaptation with better shape preservation.

摘要（中文）：视频演示为学习操作提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，能够降低获取机器人数据的成本，然而现有的基于重建的方法往往依赖受限的相机视角或人机重定向，同时重建的轨迹难以在不扭曲轨迹形状的情况下适应新的物体配置。另一个关键局限在于，由此得到的策略通常缺乏精确的物体级三维几何感知，这限制了对于精确操作至关重要的物体锚定与物体形状感知能力。为弥补上述不足，我们提出VidAct，一种高效的视频到机器人框架，该框架能够从每个任务仅需的单目视频中学习以物体为中心、具备三维感知的操作策略，并实现零样本的真实世界部署。VidAct由三个关键组件构成。首先，VidAct从任意演示视频中重建物体网格与运动，并在静态物体坐标系中对运动进行规范化处理，从而避免针对具体本体进行重定向，并适应多样化的相机视角。其次，VidAct采用残差轨迹迁移，在保持运动形状的同时，将重建的运动适配到新的物体配置上。最后，作为策略学习的关键组件，VidAct在每一帧预测仿真提供的特权完整物体点云作为辅助任务，同时仅依赖RGB进行部署，从而在物体姿态和三维几何两方面提供密集的物体中心监督。在人类、机器人、生成视频以及互联网视频上的实验表明，该方法具有广泛的视频适用性和零样本部署能力。逐帧的完整物体三维监督提升了策略的泛化能力与仿真到现实的迁移成功率，而残差轨迹迁移则实现了可靠的轨迹适配，并具有更好的形状保持性能。

Authors: Hang Li, Mingxin Zhang, Zihan Wu, Yang Tian, Dong Chen, Fengyi Shen, Yuan Meng, Xiangtong Yao, Heng Zhang, Ziyuan Liu, Zhenshan Bing, Alois Knoll

LexiconVLA: Learning Reusable Atomic Action Codebooks for Unseen Tasks VLA

atomic action codebooks cross-task reuse visual-language-action models trajectory reconstruction RLBench

简要说明：LexiconVLA 提出了一种可复用的原子动作词典，通过轨迹重建和视觉-原子对齐学习全局与细节码本，增强 VLA 策略的跨任务复用与未见任务性能，在 RLBench 和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: LexiconVLA introduces a reusable atomic-action lexicon with global and detail codebooks, learned via trajectory reconstruction and visual-atomic alignment, to enhance VLA policies' cross-task reuse and unseen-task performance on RLBench and real robots.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle to reuse recurring interactions in unseen tasks. Our diagnostic study reveals that reliable task completion does not imply consistent execution of constituent atomic actions across task contexts. We present LexiconVLA, a retrievable atomic-action lexicon for cross-task reuse. Global and detail codebooks capture shared interaction structure and fine-grained execution variation, respectively, preserving both reusable patterns and execution details. Visual-Atomic Action Alignment couples trajectory reconstruction from visual state changes with visual outcome prediction from action codes, grounding the lexicon in motion and its effects. We learn these codebooks with trajectory reconstruction and visual alignment on our AtomAction Dataset of 57,803 segments from 69 tasks. A planner and scene-aware adapter translate new goals into code-conditioned subtasks for a shared policy, without skill-specific experts or deployment-time parameter updates. Across five policy backbones on 26 RLBench tasks, LexiconVLA largely maintains performance on 18 seen tasks while improving success on 8 tasks held out from policy training. With BridgeVLA, unseen-task success rises from 16.67% to 34.17% (+17.50 percentage points), and overall success reaches 71.08%, the highest among methods with reported results. Real-robot experiments demonstrate stepwise execution and failure recovery.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在面对未见任务时，难以复用其中反复出现的交互模式。我们的诊断性研究表明，任务的成功完成并不保证其组成原子动作在不同任务情境中的一致性执行。为此，我们提出LexiconVLA——一个可检索的原子动作词典，用于跨任务复用。全局码本与细节码本分别捕捉共享的交互结构和细粒度的执行差异，同时保留可复用模式与执行细节。视觉-原子动作对齐机制将视觉状态变化驱动的轨迹重建与动作编码驱动的视觉结果预测相结合，从而将词典锚定于动作本身及其效果。我们基于自建的AtomAction数据集（涵盖69个任务中的57,803个片段），通过轨迹重建和视觉对齐学习这些码本。规划器与场景感知适配器将新目标转化为基于编码的子任务，交由共享策略执行，无需任务专属专家或部署期参数更新。在26个RLBench任务上、跨越五种策略主干网络，LexiconVLA在18个已见任务上基本保持原有性能，同时将8个未参与策略训练的任务成功率进一步提升。以BridgeVLA为骨干时，未见任务成功率从16.67%提升至34.17%（提升17.50个百分点），总体成功率最高可达71.08%，为已报告结果方法中的最优水平。真实机器人实验验证了分步执行与失败恢复能力。

Authors: Zeming Wei, Jianheng Ye, Xinshuai Song, Sirui Chen, Yang Liu, Liang Lin

T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics VLA

test-time training fast weights memory-dependent manipulation vision-language-action model

简要说明：T²Mem 通过在预训练 VLA 策略中利用测试时训练将观测历史编码为快速权重，从而提升依赖记忆的机器人操作任务在 16 个 RoboMME 任务上的表现。

TLDR: T²Mem introduces test-time training to embed observation history into fast weights of a pretrained VLA policy, improving memory-dependent robotic manipulation across 16 RoboMME tasks.

Abstract: Memory-dependent robotic manipulation requires policies to use information that is no longer available in the current observation. Retaining history alone is insufficient: memory must preserve information that supports future actions. One challenge is whether a memory-free foundation model can learn to retain and use historical information from action demonstrations alone, without external memory support. We introduce T$^2$Mem, a framework that develops this capability within a pretrained vision-language-action policy, without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. T$^2$Mem uses test-time training to encode observation history into compact fast weights through online self-supervised updates, avoiding repeated processing of the full history. An observation-grounded interface extracts vision-language information for memory formation and supplies retrieved context to the action expert. Action supervision shapes what the memory learns to retain and use, while alternating memory-policy learning gives each component a fixed counterpart during optimization. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, T$^2$Mem improves average success from 17.93% to 56.83% over the memory-free base policy and outperforms the recurrent-memory methods reported in the benchmark, while controlled profiling indicates at least 3x inference speedup over explicit methods. Project website: https://yzliu84.github.io/T2MEM-project/

摘要（中文）：记忆相关的机器人操作要求策略能够利用当前观测中已不再可用的信息。仅保留历史记录并不足够：记忆必须保存支持未来行动的信息。其中一个挑战是，一个无记忆的基础模型能否仅从动作示范中学会保留并利用历史信息，而无需外部记忆支持。我们提出了T$^2$Mem框架，该框架在预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略中发展出这一能力，无需外部推理模型或记忆专用标注。T$^2$Mem通过测试时训练，利用在线自监督更新将观测历史编码为紧凑的快速权重，避免了重复处理完整历史。一个基于观测的接口提取视觉-语言信息以形成记忆，并为动作专家提供检索到的上下文。动作监督塑造记忆学习保留和利用的内容，而交替的记忆-策略学习在优化过程中为每个组件提供固定的对应部分。在16个RoboMME任务中，T$^2$Mem将平均成功率从无记忆基础策略的17.93%提升至56.83%，并超越了基准中报告的循环记忆方法，同时受控性能分析表明，其推理速度相比显式方法至少提升3倍。项目网站：https://yzliu84.github.io/T2MEM-project/
