Authors: Yize Liu, Huang Huang, Yining Hong, Zijian Du, Zhi Cao, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu

OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport HumanoidEmbodied

optimal transport motion retargeting humanoid robots loco-manipulation whole-body control

简要说明：OTRetarget 通过使用熵最优传输处理表面交互表示，联合将人类演示重定向到人形机器人和物体，保持接触一致性并提升机器人与物体的交互保真度，在仿真和真实 G1 人形机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: OTRetarget jointly retargets human demonstrations to humanoid robots and objects by leveraging entropic optimal transport on surface interaction representations, preserving contacts and improving robot-object interaction fidelity, with validation in simulation and on a real G1 humanoid.

Abstract: Transferring human motion to humanoid robots requires adapting the demonstrated motion to the robot morphology while preserving interactions with the environment. This is particularly challenging for loco-manipulation tasks, where contacts with the ground and manipulated objects must remain consistent despite differences in body proportions. Yet, skeletal motion alone does not fully describe these interactions, and fixing object trajectories limits the adaptation to a new embodiment. In this paper, we introduce OTR ETARGET, a unified approach to jointly retarget robot and multi-object motion from human demonstrations. Our approach represents surface interactions through signed distances, closest surface points, and relative directions, and uses entropic optimal transport to transfer these quantities across human, robot, and object geometries. We incorporate the resulting interaction targets into a constrained inverse kinematics formulation that balances contact preservation with motion style and jointly optimizes robot and object poses at each frame. This formulation accommodates robot-object and object-object interactions without rescaling the scene or the demonstration. We validate the proposed approach on OMOMO, where it achieves a robot- object interaction Jaccard score of 87% and a depth error of 8.7 mm, compared with 28% and 29.3 mm for OmniRetarget. Finally, we demonstrate transfer to a physical G1 humanoid using whole-body policies trained with reinforcement learning on the retargeted references, across motions including two-handed box pick-and-place onto a table.

摘要（中文）：将人体运动迁移至人形机器人，需在保留与环境交互的同时，使演示运动适配机器人形态。这对于全身操控任务尤为挑战，因为尽管身体比例存在差异，与地面及被操作物体的接触必须保持一致。然而，仅凭骨骼运动无法完整描述这些交互，且固定物体轨迹会限制对新形态的适配。本文提出OTR ETARGET，一种统一方法，可同时将人体演示中的机器人与多物体运动进行重定向。该方法通过符号距离、最近表面点及相对方向来表达表面交互，并利用熵最优传输将这些量在人体、机器人与物体几何之间传递。我们将所得交互目标融入带约束的逆运动学框架，该框架在保持接触与运动风格间取得平衡，并逐帧联合优化机器人与物体姿态。该公式能够适应机器人-物体及物体-物体交互，无需对场景或演示进行缩放。我们在OMOMO上验证了所提方法，其机器人-物体交互Jaccard得分为87%，深度误差为8.7毫米，而OmniRetarget分别为28%和29.3毫米。最后，我们展示了向实体G1人形机器人的迁移，利用在重定向参考上经强化学习训练的全身体策略，涵盖双手抓取箱子并放置到桌面等动作。

Authors: Guillaume Besset, Erwann Carn, Timothée Carecchio, Valentin Tordjman-Levavasseur, Fabian Schramm, Yann de Mont-Marin, Justin Carpentier, Ajay Suresha Sathya

HACo: Learning Haptic Active Compliance for Force-Aware Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

haptic active compliance dexterous manipulation tactile feedback joint-torque feedback force regulation

简要说明：HACo提出了一种基于触觉主动柔顺的策略，用于力感知灵巧操作，直接从触觉反馈（指尖触觉和关节力矩）学习力调节动作，并利用命令-状态差异作为辅助监督。它在多种接触丰富任务中达到83%的平均成功率，大幅超越基线。

TLDR: HACo introduces a haptic active compliance policy for force-aware dexterous manipulation, learning force-regulating actions from haptic feedback (fingertip tactile and joint torque) and using command-state discrepancy as auxiliary supervision. It achieves 83% mean success rate across diverse contact-rich tasks, outperforming baselines by a large margin.

Abstract: Contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires policies that translate physical feedback into motion commands while regulating interaction loads across evolving multi-contact interactions. This requires haptic observations of contact state and action supervision showing how commands should adapt. Existing policies often overlook complementary fingertip tactile and joint-torque feedback, while common action targets either encode excessive loading or omit motion constrained by the object. We introduce HACo, a Haptic Active Compliance policy that learns force-regulating actions directly from haptic feedback. Compliance-regulated teleoperation converts operator inputs into controller-executable compliant actions that preserve motion intent while regulating loads. HACo learns these actions directly, using command-state discrepancy as auxiliary compliant-intent supervision. It combines local fingertip tactile responses with joint-torque feedback capturing load transmission through the articulated hand, including contacts beyond tactile coverage. A Compliance Grounding Module uses gated haptic cross-attention to ground action generation in the evolving haptic state, enabling closed-loop force regulation without explicit online contact modeling. We evaluate HACo on a real-world benchmark covering multi-contact friction, tangential interaction, fragile curved-surface contact, rotational torque, and deformable-object manipulation. Across 20 trials per task, HACo achieves an 83% mean success rate, compared with 35% for the strongest evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate active compliance across diverse force-sensitive dexterous manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的灵巧操纵需要能够将物理反馈转化为运动命令，同时在不断演化的多接触交互中调节交互载荷的策略。这需要对接触状态的触觉观测，以及显示命令应如何调整的动作监督。现有策略往往忽视互补的指尖触觉和关节力矩反馈，而常见的动作目标要么编码过度的载荷，要么忽略由物体约束的运动。我们提出了HACo，一种触觉主动顺从策略，直接从触觉反馈中学习力调节动作。顺从调节遥操作将操作者输入转换为控制器可执行的顺从动作，在调节载荷的同时保留运动意图。HACo直接学习这些动作，利用命令-状态差异作为辅助的顺从意图监督。它结合局部指尖触觉响应与关节力矩反馈，捕捉通过铰接手传递的载荷，包括触觉覆盖范围之外的接触。顺从接地模块使用门控触觉交叉注意力，将动作生成锚定在不断演化的触觉状态中，实现无需显式在线接触建模的闭环力调节。我们在涵盖多接触摩擦、切向交互、脆弱曲面接触、旋转力矩和可变形物体操纵的真实世界基准上评估了HACo。每个任务进行20次试验，HACo实现了83%的平均成功率，而最强评估基线为35%。这些结果展示了在多样化力敏感灵巧操纵任务中的主动顺从能力。

Authors: Naisheng Ye, Yinzhe Zhou, Junkai Zhao, Yuhang Lu, Checheng Yu, Zhenjie Yang, Pengwei Wang, Hongyang Li

Simple Agentic Memory for Generalist Robot Policies Manipulation

robot memory generalist robot policies task-relevant state frozen policies manipulation benchmark

简要说明：本文提出SimpleARM，一种免训练的記憶层，为冻结的通用机器人策略提供源自交互历史的紧凑任务相关状态，显著提升了依赖記憶的操作任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes SimpleARM, a training-free memory layer that equips frozen generalist robot policies with compact, task-relevant state extracted from interaction history, significantly improving success on memory-dependent manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Visual-memory systems commonly retain or compress past observations. Robot control additionally requires interaction-derived state that no individual frame may explicitly represent, such as persistent identity relations, accumulated progress, or ordered procedures. We introduce Simple Agentic Robot Memory (SimpleARM), a training-free memory layer for frozen generalist robot policies. From the task instruction, SimpleARM specifies what to monitor; frozen perceptual tools maintain compact typed state online; structured access retrieves that state only when a proposed subgoal depends on history; and current-view grounding resolves recalled entities before execution. We evaluate SimpleARM on RoboMME, a benchmark of memory-dependent robot manipulation tasks that require history information no longer available in the current observation. Across all 16 tasks and three policy seeds, SimpleARM achieves 67.17% mean success, compared with 44.51% for the strongest non-oracle baseline. Matched ablations show mechanism specificity: removing relation, reference, progress, or route state produces large losses where the affected state is retrieved for control, while largely sparing other tasks. These results support a state-based view of robot memory: effective memory for control is not simply retained visual history, but compact task-relevant state derived from the interaction history.

摘要（中文）：视觉记忆系统通常会保留或压缩过去的观察信息。机器人控制还需要交互产生的状态，这些状态可能无法由任何单个帧显式表示，例如持续的同一性关系、累积的进度或有序的程序步骤。我们引入了简单智能体机器人记忆（SimpleARM），这是一种面向冻结的通用机器人策略的无训练记忆层。根据任务指令，SimpleARM 指定需要监控的内容；冻结的感知工具在线维护紧凑的类型化状态；结构化访问仅在提出的子目标依赖历史信息时检索该状态；当前视图定位在执行前解析被回忆的实体。我们在 RoboMME 上评估了 SimpleARM，这是一个依赖记忆的机器人操作任务基准，这些任务需要当前观察中不再可用的历史信息。在所有 16 个任务和三种策略种子中，SimpleARM 取得了 67.17% 的平均成功率，而最强的非预言机基线仅为 44.51%。匹配的消融实验显示了机制的特异性：移除关系、引用、进度或路线状态会在受影响的检索控制状态的任务中产生较大损失，而对其他任务影响甚微。这些结果支持一种基于状态的机器人记忆观点：用于控制的有效记忆不仅仅是保留的视觉历史，而是从交互历史中提取的紧凑任务相关状态。

Authors: Yuyou Zhang, Yunbei Zhang, Miao Li, Janet Wang, Zijian Jin, Shilong Liu, Ding Zhao

EquivDP3: A SIM(3)-Invariant Point-Cloud Encoder for Data-Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

SIM(3)-equivariant encoder diffusion policy humanoid loco-manipulation data efficiency point-cloud

简要说明：EquivDP3 将 SIM(3) 等变的 Vector Neuron Network 编码器集成到层次化扩散策略中，用于人形机器人移动操作，在 Unitree G1 模拟中以 5-10 个演示提高了数据效率。

TLDR: EquivDP3 integrates a SIM(3)-equivariant Vector Neuron Network encoder into a hierarchical diffusion policy for humanoid loco-manipulation, improving data efficiency at 5-10 demonstrations on the Unitree G1 in simulation.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies for humanoid loco-manipulation must generalize across object poses and lighting from only a handful of demonstrations. 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3) conditions a diffusion-based action generator on point-cloud features, but its PointNet-style encoder has no built-in equivariance to the rotations, translations, and scalings (SIM(3)) that manipulation tasks respect. EquiBot closed this gap for wheeled manipulators with a SIM(3)-equivariant Vector Neuron Network (VNN) encoder. We extend this to a substantially more complex embodiment, the 43-joint Unitree G1 humanoid, and propose EquivDP3: a two-stage policy where a high-level diffusion planner with a SIM(3)-equivariant VNN encoder emits 6 Hz whole-body command chunks, executed at 50 Hz by a frozen, pre-trained RL locomotion policy and a differential inverse-kinematics module for the arms, trained end-to-end by behavior cloning. Across two simulated IsaacLab benchmarks and four non-equivariant baselines (5-100 demonstrations, in- and out-of-distribution), EquivDP3's advantage concentrates in the low-data regime: at 5-10 demonstrations it reaches 67.1% success versus 38.2-52.4% for the baselines, while by 50-100 all encoders converge (74.3-85.2%) and the ordering is no longer meaningful. A proprioception-only control confirms this gap is genuinely perceptual: with the point cloud removed, success drops to 31% vs. 60% (EquivDP3) at 5 demonstrations and 78% vs. 99% at 10, but vanishes by 50-100, showing the high-data plateau reflects a benchmark ceiling, not five encoders learning the same invariance. The encoder costs only 0.8 ms of extra latency per action chunk over the PointNet encoder it replaces. Baking geometric symmetry into a hierarchical diffusion policy's perception backbone is a practical, nearly free way to improve data efficiency for humanoid loco-manipulation when demonstrations are scarce.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 针对人形机器人移动操作任务的视觉运动策略，必须仅凭少量示范即可在不同物体姿态和光照条件下泛化。3D扩散策略（DP3）以点云特征为条件，驱动基于扩散的动作生成器，但其PointNet风格的编码器不具备对操作任务所涉及的旋转、平移和缩放（SIM(3)）的内在等变性。EquiBot通过引入SIM(3)等变的向量神经元网络（VNN）编码器，填补了这一空白，但其应用于轮式机械臂。本文将这一方法扩展至复杂度显著更高的43关节Unitree G1人形机器人，并提出EquivDP3：一种两阶段策略，其中高层扩散规划器采用SIM(3)等变的VNN编码器，以6 Hz的频率输出全身指令块，由冻结的预训练强化学习运动策略和手臂差分逆运动学模块以50 Hz执行，并通过行为克隆进行端到端训练。在两个模拟IsaacLab基准测试及四个非等变基线（5-100次示范，分布内与分布外）中，EquivDP3的优势集中于低数据场景：在5-10次示范时，其成功率达到67.1%，而基线为38.2%-52.4%；当示范次数增至50-100时，所有编码器的表现趋于一致（74.3%-85.2%），性能排序不再具有显著意义。仅依赖本体感觉的控制实验证实，该差距确实源于感知层面：在去除点云输入后，5次示范时成功率从EquivDP3的60%降至31%，10次示范时从99%降至78%，但到50-100次示范时差距消失，表明高数据平台期反映的是基准测试的上限，而非五种编码器学到了相同的不变性。该编码器相较其所替代的PointNet编码器，每个动作块仅增加0.8 ms的额外延迟。将几何对称性融入分层扩散策略的感知主干，是一种在实际中近乎无成本且有效的途径，可在示范稀缺时提升人形移动操作任务的数据效率。

Authors: Abu Hanif Muhammad Syarubany, Chang D. Yoo

Learning to Explore Hidden Kinematics for Articulated Object Manipulation Manipulation

articulated object manipulation belief representation reinforcement learning Bayesian filtering active perception

简要说明：本文提出一种针对铰接物体操作的方法，通过维持关节运动学的贝叶斯信念，并将其渲染为逐点铰接流场，结合强化学习训练策略以减小后验熵，在PartManip和ArticuRiddle基准上取得最先进结果。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for articulated object manipulation that maintains a Bayesian belief over joint kinematics, renders this belief as per-point articulation flow fields, and trains a policy with reinforcement learning to reduce posterior entropy, achieving state-of-the-art results on PartManip and ArticuRiddle benchmarks.

Abstract: The kinematics of an articulated object is often ambiguous from vision alone. Interaction resolves the ambiguity, and active perception methods exploit this by searching for the single action that most sharpens a belief over the kinematic parameters at each step. Such greedy search cannot be extended over a horizon without forward models of the contact and inertial dynamics, which are themselves unknown. We instead amortize action selection into training. We maintain a belief distribution over joint type and parameters, initialized from a generative prior and updated by Bayesian filtering on the observed part motion. To condition the policy on this belief, we render it as a per-point articulation flow field, the motion that the current posterior predicts for every point on the object. Carrying the inductive bias of articulated motion, this representation generalizes better than a latent encoding of the belief or flow tracked from observation. We train the policy with reinforcement learning, rewarding the entropy that each interaction removes from the posterior, so that informative exploration becomes learned behavior rather than a search at every step. Our method outperforms previous approaches across door and drawer manipulation on the PartManip benchmark, and reaches 61.7% success on ArticuRiddle, a new dataset of objects whose appearance implies the wrong articulation, against 44.4% for the best previous method. Project Website: https://hiddenkinematics.github.io/

摘要（中文）：铰接物体的运动学特性仅凭视觉往往具有模糊性。交互能够消除这种模糊性，而主动感知方法正是利用这一点，在每一步搜索能使运动学参数信念最锐化的单一动作。然而，若无接触动力学与惯性动力学的正向模型（这些模型本身也是未知的），这种贪心搜索无法在时间跨度上扩展。我们转而将动作选择分摊到训练过程中。我们维持一个关于关节类型与参数的信念分布，该分布由生成式先验初始化，并通过对观测到的部件运动进行贝叶斯滤波来更新。为将策略条件化于该信念，我们将其渲染为逐点的关节运动流场，即当前后验对物体上每一点运动的预测。该表示携带着铰接运动的归纳偏置，比从观测中追踪的信念潜在编码或光流具有更好的泛化性能。我们利用强化学习训练策略，以每次交互从后验中消除的熵作为奖励，从而使信息量丰富的探索成为习得行为，而非每一步的搜索。在PartManip基准的门和抽屉操作任务中，我们的方法优于以往方法；在ArticuRiddle这一新数据集（包含外观暗示错误关节类型的物体）上，我们达到61.7%的成功率，而此前最佳方法仅为44.4%。项目网站：https://hiddenkinematics.github.io/

Authors: Ruiyao Liu, Boshu Lei, Zhuoyang Pan, Kostas Daniilidis

Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment VLA

asynchronous execution distribution alignment flow-field distillation reactive control vision-language-action models

简要说明：本文针对VLA策略异步执行导致的动作分布不一致问题，提出递归流场蒸馏和提议-解析两种机制，使异步策略的动作分布与原始VLA对齐，从而提升反应能力，并在LIBERO和RoboMimic基准上显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper addresses the distribution mismatch caused by asynchronous execution of VLA policies, proposing Recursive Flow-Field Distillation and Propose-Resolve to align asynchronously produced action distributions with the original VLA, improving reactivity and success rates on LIBERO and RoboMimic benchmarks.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) have achieved remarkable generalization, but their inference delays can conflict with the demands of real-time control. Asynchronous execution avoids pauses between action chunks by predicting the next sequence of actions while the robot carries out the previous one. In this paper, we study whether asynchronous execution produces the same action distribution as the original VLA. We find that, for non-Markovian demonstrations, asynchronous execution can produce a fundamentally different action distribution, which can limit the policy's reactivity. In our method, we seek to restore this reactivity by aligning the asynchronously produced action distribution with that of the original VLA through two complementary mechanisms. First, Recursive Flow-Field Distillation trains the asynchronous policy using the VLA's action-generation flow. We characterize the learned distribution theoretically and show experimentally that our asynchronous policy can generate nearly the full range of actions the original VLA would produce, while existing asynchronous methods recover only a fraction of that range. Second, Propose-Resolve prepares multiple action sequences asynchronously and uses the latest observation to select among them based on a lightweight approximation of their likelihood under the VLA's action distribution. Our resulting method matches the original VLA's success on LIBERO and retains about 80% of its success on RoboMimic, about 30 percentage points more than existing asynchronous methods.

摘要（中文）：通用机器人策略（如视觉-语言-动作模型，VLA）已实现了显著的泛化能力，但其推理延迟可能与实时控制的需求相冲突。异步执行通过在机器人执行前一段动作序列的同时预测下一段动作序列，从而避免了动作块之间的停顿。本文研究了异步执行是否会产生与原始VLA相同的动作分布。我们发现，对于非马尔可夫演示，异步执行可能产生根本不同的动作分布，从而限制策略的响应性。在我们的方法中，我们通过两种互补机制，将异步生成的动作分布与原始VLA的动作分布对齐，以恢复这种响应性。首先，递归流场蒸馏利用VLA的动作生成流训练异步策略。我们在理论上刻画了所学分布的特征，并通过实验表明，我们的异步策略能够生成原始VLA几乎全范围的动作，而现有异步方法仅能恢复该范围的一小部分。其次，提出-解决机制异步准备多个动作序列，并利用最新观测，基于其在VLA动作分布下的似然性的轻量近似进行选择。我们的方法在LIBERO基准上达到了与原始VLA相当的成功率，并在RoboMimic基准上保留了约80%的成功率，比现有异步方法高出约30个百分点。

Authors: Moritz Zoellner, Reece O'Mahoney, Ioannis Havoutis, Rohan Paleja

Trajectory-Level Mode Guidance for Controllable Diffusion-Based Multi-Robot Motion Planning Other

diffusion models multi-robot motion planning trajectory-level guidance multimodal generation collision avoidance

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于基于扩散的多机器人运动规划的轨迹级引导方法，通过逐步引入粗略轨迹先验并保持多模态性，实现了可控且安全的多机器人协调。

TLDR: This paper proposes a trajectory-level guidance method for diffusion-based multi-robot motion planning that progressively incorporates coarse trajectory priors while preserving multimodality, demonstrating controllable and safe multi-robot coordination.

Abstract: Motion planning often admits multiple feasible solutions, making multimodal generation valuable, particularly for flexible multi-robot coordination. Diffusion models naturally learn such trajectory distributions, yet incorporating coarse and partial trajectory priors without restricting generation remains challenging. Such priors indicate a desirable region of the solution space rather than a single solution, motivating conditioned generation that preserves multimodality. In this paper, we guide trajectory generation in the clean trajectory space and progressively incorporate trajectory priors with a timestep-dependent guidance strength. At each reverse diffusion step, the reconstructed clean trajectory provides a unified space for integrating planning costs and partial trajectory priors. Planning costs are incorporated through gradient-based refinement, while the partial prior is progressively injected at the corresponding noise levels with decreasing guidance strength. This guides generation toward the prior in early stages while gradually releasing the constraint to preserve the inherent multimodality of the diffusion model. The framework naturally extends to multi-robot planning by incorporating inter-robot collision costs. Experiments on single- and multi-robot planning tasks demonstrate controllable trajectory synthesis, diverse feasible solutions, and safe multi-agent coordination.

摘要（中文）：运动规划通常存在多个可行解，这使得多模态生成具有重要意义，尤其是在灵活的多机器人协调场景中。扩散模型天然能够学习此类轨迹分布，然而，在不限制生成多样性的前提下融入粗略且部分给定的轨迹先验仍具挑战性。此类先验指示的是解空间中的理想区域，而非单一解，因此需要保留多模态特性的条件生成方法。本文在干净的轨迹空间中进行轨迹生成引导，并采用随时间步变化的自适应引导强度，逐步融入轨迹先验。在每个反向扩散步骤中，重建出的干净轨迹为整合规划代价与部分轨迹先验提供了统一空间。规划代价通过基于梯度的精化方式引入，而部分先验则在对应的噪声层级上以递减的引导强度逐步注入。该方法在早期阶段将生成过程引导至先验区域，随后逐步释放约束，以保留扩散模型固有的多模态特性。该框架通过引入机器人间的碰撞代价，自然扩展至多机器人规划场景。在单机器人与多机器人规划任务上的实验表明，该方法能够实现可控的轨迹合成、多样化的可行解以及安全的多智能体协调。

Authors: Tianyou Yu, Shengze Cai, Chao Xu

FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation Manipulation

bimanual manipulation vision-language-action model robotic trajectory dataset subtask prediction long-horizon tasks

简要说明：提出了FineART，一个包含40k轨迹和533k子任务的密集标注双手操作数据集，以及FineART-VLA，一种能预测自己下一步子任务的视觉-语言-动作策略，在长时程任务中展现出更高的成功率和数据效率。

TLDR: Introduces FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset with 40k episodes and 533k subtasks, and FineART-VLA, a VLA policy that predicts its own next subtask, showing improved success rates and data efficiency in long-horizon tasks.

Abstract: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

摘要（中文）：在真实世界环境中运行的机器人必须执行跨长时间跨度的复杂多步骤双臂任务，而非单一、孤立的动作。当前的操控数据集难以支持这一能力：尽管单臂数据集已达到数十万条轨迹的规模，但它们通常每个片段仅提供一条高层指令，而少数确实标注了子任务的双臂数据，也仅对其录制时长的一小部分进行了标注。我们提出了FineART，一个密集标注的双臂操控数据集，包含40,543个片段、1,718小时、跨151个任务的533,913个子任务。我们还提出了FineART-VLA，一种能够预测自身下一子任务的视觉-语言-动作策略，并表明以这种方式进行中期训练可带来显著提升。具体而言，在空间消歧任务上的成功率从32.0%提高到100.0%，而逐步的人工子任务引导将未见过的长时程任务成功率从16.0%提升到76.0%。此外，在新机器人上进行极少量微调后，该策略所需数据仅为未经中期训练的基线方法的十分之一，并能零样本泛化到新硬件上完全未见过的任务。我们开源了完整数据集、模型权重和训练代码。

Authors: Jade Choghari, Pepijn Kooijmans, Mansi Agarwal, Yusuf Umut Ciftci, Aseem Doriwala, Catherine Weaver, Mouli Sivapurapu, Kai Yang, Jackson Lee, Thomas Wolf, Pragna Mannam

StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks VLA

structured rewards online RL long-horizon manipulation subtask decomposition VLA post-training

简要说明：StructRL提出了一种在线强化学习框架，将长时程VLA任务分解为可验证的子任务，并提供结构化中间奖励，在RoboCasa365和LIBERO-Long上使用GR00T-N1.5和pi 0.5增强了后训练性能。

TLDR: StructRL introduces an online RL framework that decomposes long-horizon VLA tasks into verifiable subtasks and provides structured intermediate rewards, improving post-training performance on RoboCasa365 and LIBERO-Long with GR00T-N1.5 and pi 0.5.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on shorter-horizon manipulation tasks but still struggle with long-horizon tasks that require multiple dependent manipulations from a single command. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies through environment interaction, yet many existing methods provide reward only after the complete task succeeds. However, such terminal supervision is sparse and does not distinguish early failures from rollouts that make substantial partial progress. We propose StructRL, an online RL framework that constructs structured intermediate supervision from verifiable subtask completions. StructRL decomposes each task into verifiable subtasks, grants intermediate rewards only after the prerequisite subtasks have been completed, and scales each reward according to completion pace. Across RoboCasa365 and LIBERO-Long with GR00T-N1.5 and pi 0.5, StructRL consistently outperforms evaluated online RL baselines. These results show that verifiable, structured intermediate rewards improve long-horizon VLA post-training. Code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在较短时域的操作任务上表现良好，但在需要从单个指令出发完成多个相互依赖操作的长时间跨度任务上仍面临挑战。在线强化学习（RL）可以通过环境交互来改进这些策略，然而许多现有方法仅在完整任务成功后才提供奖励。然而，此类终端监督信号稀疏，且无法区分早期失败与产生了实质性部分进展的轨迹。我们提出StructRL，一种在线强化学习框架，通过可验证的子任务完成情况构建结构化的中间监督信号。StructRL将每个任务分解为可验证的子任务，仅在前置子任务完成后授予中间奖励，并根据完成进度对每项奖励进行缩放。在RoboCasa365和LIBERO-Long上，结合GR00T-N1.5与pi 0.5，StructRL始终优于所评估的在线强化学习基线方法。这些结果表明，可验证的、结构化的中间奖励能够改善长时域VLA后训练效果。代码已公开于 https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL。

Authors: Ziyi Yin, Sangmin Woo, Kang Zhou, Sungyeon Kim, Aosong Feng, Haibo Ding, Jun Huan

ChronoSRL: Temporal Geometry for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

self-supervised reinforcement learning temporal geometry sim-to-real locomotion goal reaching

简要说明：ChronoSRL 在自监督强化学习中引入显式的时间几何嵌入，使策略能够更快更可靠地到达目标，并在标准基准和四足机器人仿真到现实的实验中表现优于基线方法。

TLDR: ChronoSRL introduces a self-supervised reinforcement learning method with an explicit temporal geometry in the critic's embeddings, training policies to reach goals sooner and more reliably. It outperforms baselines on standard benchmarks and demonstrates sim-to-real locomotion tasks on a quadruped robot.

Abstract: A goal that is close in space can be far away in time. Obstacles, terrain, and the agent's own capabilities determine how long it takes to get there. Yet, critics in contrastive and survival reinforcement learning do not measure the distances in their representation space in units of time. We therefore introduce ChronoSRL, which gives the critic's embeddings an explicit temporal geometry. The distance between state-action and goal embeddings is trained to match the time that the agent takes to reach the goal (goal-reaching time), while goals that were not reached, and goals from other trajectories, are pushed at least one discount horizon away. Furthermore, reaching a goal quickly once does not mean that reaching it is reliable in general, so the policy should not follow the temporal distance directly. Instead, we build on survival reinforcement learning and predict from our temporal embeddings not only the full distribution of goal-reaching times but also the time spent near the goal. Thereby, the policy is trained to favor actions that reach the goal sooner and more reliably and that keep the agent near it. ChronoSRL learns faster and reaches higher performance than contrastive, action-chunked contrastive, and survival reinforcement learning baselines on seven standard locomotion and navigation benchmarks, even with much smaller networks. To test the limits of self-supervised reinforcement learning, we introduce velocity tracking, goal-position reaching, and box climbing tasks with a quadruped robot in a realistic sim-to-real locomotion setup, and show how the shaping terms that are typical for robotics can be naturally incorporated into our framework. ChronoSRL is the only one of the tested self-supervised reinforcement learning methods that learns to stay at the commanded velocities and goal positions, and climbs the highest boxes.

摘要（中文）：在空间中近在咫尺的目标，在时间上却可能远在天涯。障碍物、地形以及智能体自身的能力，共同决定了抵达目标所需的时间。然而，对比强化学习与生存强化学习中的评价器，并未以其表示空间中的距离来度量时间单位。为此，我们提出ChronoSRL，为评价器的嵌入赋予明确的时间几何结构。状态-动作对与目标之间的嵌入距离被训练为与智能体到达目标所需的时间（即目标到达时间）相匹配，而未被到达的目标以及其他轨迹中的目标，则被推离至至少一个折扣视界之外。此外，一次快速到达目标并不意味着该目标在一般情况下能够可靠到达，因此策略不应直接遵循时间距离。相反，我们基于生存强化学习，从时间嵌入中不仅预测目标到达时间的完整分布，还预测在目标附近停留的时间。由此，策略被训练为倾向于选择能更早、更可靠地到达目标并使智能体保持在目标附近的动作。在七个标准运动控制与导航基准任务上，即便使用更小的网络，ChronoSRL的学习速度与最终性能均优于对比学习、动作分块对比学习及生存强化学习基线。为检验自监督强化学习的极限，我们在真实的仿真到现实运动控制设置中，引入了四足机器人的速度跟踪、目标位置到达及爬箱任务，并展示了机器人领域典型的塑形项如何自然地融入我们的框架。在所测试的自监督强化学习方法中，ChronoSRL是唯一能够学会保持指令速度与目标位置，并攀爬最高箱体的方法。

Authors: Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters

Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation Manipulation

test-time adaptation actuator degradation telemetry-conditioned policy action rectification robot manipulation

简要说明：TeAR 是一种策略无关的方法，利用执行器遥测数据修正冻结操作策略的动作，在执行器退化情况下无需微调即可提高成功率。

TLDR: TeAR is a policy-agnostic method that uses actuator telemetry to rectify actions of frozen manipulation policies, improving success under actuator degradation without fine-tuning.

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies are usually trained under the assumption that a commanded action produces the same motion as it did during training even after hours of operation. Real hardware violates this assumption as the motors gradually heat up, current saturates near contact, voltage sags under load, thus the same policy action can produce a weaker, delayed, or noisier motion. These conditions are already measured by onboard telemetry, such as joint temperature, motor current, and supply voltage, yet this signal is typically used only for logging or safety checks rather than policy adaptation. We introduce Telemetry-Aware Action Rectification (TeAR), a policy-agnostic method that turns a frozen manipulation policy into a telemetry-conditioned policy by rectifying its outgoing action before it reaches the low-level controller. TeAR learns a lightweight Transformer that combines the proposed action with live actuator telemetry and amplifies, damps, or biases individual action components. We evaluate TeAR across 18 policy-task pairs spanning 8 policy families and 5 manipulation tasks. In an additional paired evaluation with degradation-model mismatch, TeAR achieves 31.8% success, compared with 25.6% for the base policy and 30.6% for an assumed-model inverse. On a physical arm, TeAR improves success under heating by 10-15% without on-robot fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作策略通常在假设指令动作即使在运行数小时后仍能产生与训练时相同运动的条件下进行训练。然而，真实硬件并不满足这一假设，因为电机逐渐升温、电流在接触附近达到饱和、电压在负载下下降，因此相同的策略动作可能产生更弱、延迟或噪声更大的运动。这些条件已通过机载遥测数据（如关节温度、电机电流和供电电压）进行测量，但该信号通常仅用于日志记录或安全检查，而非策略自适应。我们提出了遥测感知动作校正（Telemetry-Aware Action Rectification, TeAR），这是一种与策略无关的方法，通过在冻结策略的动作到达底层控制器之前对其进行校正，将其转化为遥测条件策略。TeAR学习了一个轻量级Transformer，将提出的动作与实时执行器遥测数据相结合，并对各个动作分量进行放大、阻尼或偏置。我们在覆盖8种策略族和5种操作任务的18个策略-任务对上评估了TeAR。在额外的退化模型失配配对评估中，TeAR的成功率达到31.8%，而基础策略为25.6%，假设模型逆变换为30.6%。在物理机械臂上，TeAR在加热条件下无需机器人端微调即可将成功率提升10-15%。

Authors: Som Sagar, Ransalu Senanayake

SkillWeaver: Agentic Exploration over Neural Interaction Skills for Scalable Robot Data Generation Manipulation

agentic data generation neural interaction skills VLM-guided exploration sim-to-real manipulation

简要说明：SkillWeaver 是一个智能体框架，通过在模拟器中自主探索可复用的参数化神经交互技能，并由 VLM 引导，大规模生成机器人演示数据，实现操纵策略的规模化模拟到真实迁移。

TLDR: SkillWeaver is an agentic framework that autonomously generates large-scale robot demonstration data in simulation by exploring over reusable, parameterized neural interaction skills guided by a VLM, enabling scalable sim-to-real transfer for manipulation policies.

Abstract: Large-scale demonstrations have driven unprecedented progress in robot learning, yet collecting robot data through teleoperation is expensive and difficult to scale to diverse environments and long-horizon tasks. Simulation offers a scalable alternative, but existing data-generation pipelines often rely on open-loop controllers, scripted skill sequences, or task-specific programs. We introduce SkillWeaver, an agentic framework that autonomously generates robot experience by exploring over Neural Interaction Skills (NIS): reusable, parameterized, closed-loop policies that expose learned physical interaction capabilities to a reasoning agent. Given a task and a simulated environment, a VLM agent reasons about what to do next, invokes and parameterizes NIS to interact with the environment, observes their outcomes, and generates verification, reflection, and memory to guide subsequent exploration. We instantiate NIS as reinforcement-learned policies for closed-loop, contact-rich manipulation and organize exploration as verifier-guided tree search, enabling the agent to discover successful long-horizon behaviors without relying on predetermined execution pipelines. SkillWeaver scales autonomously to 39.1K demonstrations across 14.1K scenes, which we distill into visuomotor policies. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation, training on SkillWeaver-generated experience substantially improves generalization to novel objects, spatial configurations, tasks, and environments, and enables zero- and few-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer. Our results suggest agentic exploration over neural interaction skills as a scalable alternative for robot data generation.

摘要（中文）：大规模演示推动了机器人学习的空前进步，然而通过遥操作收集机器人数据成本高昂，且难以扩展到多样化环境和长时程任务。仿真提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但现有数据生成流程往往依赖于开环控制器、脚本化技能序列或特定任务的程序。我们提出了SkillWeaver，一个智能体框架，通过在神经交互技能（NIS）上进行自主探索来生成机器人经验：NIS是可复用、参数化的闭环策略，将学习到的物理交互能力暴露给推理智能体。给定任务和仿真环境，视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体推理下一步该做什么，调用并参数化NIS与环境交互，观察其结果，并生成验证、反思和记忆以指导后续探索。我们将NIS实例化为强化学习策略，用于闭环、接触丰富的操作，并将探索组织为验证器引导的树搜索，使智能体无需依赖预定义的执行流程即可发现成功的长时程行为。SkillWeaver可自主扩展到14.1K场景中的39.1K条演示，我们将其蒸馏为视觉运动策略。在仿真基准测试和真实世界操作中，使用SkillWeaver生成的体验进行训练，显著提升了对新物体、空间配置、任务和环境的泛化能力，并实现了零样本和少样本的仿真到仿真及仿真到真实的迁移。我们的结果表明，基于神经交互技能的智能体探索可作为机器人数据生成的可扩展替代方案。

Authors: He Zhu, Lusen Zhao, Kwan Man Cheng, Su Li, Katerina Fragkiadaki

KPI: A Promptable Kernel for Physical Interaction on Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

promptable kernel physical interaction whole-body tracking vision-language agent humanoid

简要说明：本文提出了KPI，一种可提示内核，通过视觉语言智能体从自然语言指令生成的每个方向的契约（跟踪、顺从或保持力）来调整人形机器人的全身跟踪控制器以进行物理交互，并展示了绞盘操作、开门和箱子搬运等指令驱动任务。

TLDR: This paper introduces KPI, a promptable kernel that adapts a humanoid's whole-body tracking controller for physical interaction based on per-direction contracts (track, comply, or hold force) generated from a natural language instruction by a vision-language agent. It demonstrates instruction-driven tasks like winch operation, door opening, and box transport on a real humanoid.

Abstract: Humanoids now walk, balance and reach with remarkable generality: one whole-body tracking policy follows references from a human, or from an end-to-end policy. That generality travels in the trajectory, and a trajectory alone carries limited information about the interaction it should produce: at contact, the executing controller determines how the robot behaves. Single-task policies usually reach hard interactions by optimising trajectory and controller together in simulation; general stacks usually assume a preset or hand-chosen controller. We present KPI, a promptable kernel for physical interaction between the trajectory source and an unmodified whole-body tracker. Instead of a controller fixed before the task, the trajectory source sends a contract: per direction, track, comply, or hold a force range. From tracking error and a wrench estimate, the kernel adapts the arms' stiffness, damping, reference and feedforward toward it at contact rate. We demonstrate KPI through an agentic framework: from one instruction, a vision-language agent writes both the reference trajectory and the contract, with no task-specific code. We demonstrate instruction-driven winch operation, door opening, and box transport, alongside scripted surface-interaction experiments. In the winch demonstration, the humanoid is able to turn a crank to hoist a second robot fully off the ground.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人如今在行走、平衡和抓取方面展现出卓越的通用性：一个全身跟踪策略可以跟随来自人类或端到端策略的参考动作。这种通用性体现在轨迹之中，而单一的轨迹所包含的交互信息十分有限：在接触时，执行控制器决定了机器人的行为方式。单任务策略通常通过在仿真中同时优化轨迹和控制器来实现硬性交互；而通用框架通常假定使用预设或人工选择的控制器。我们提出了KPI，一种在轨迹源与未修改的全身跟踪器之间实现物理交互的可提示内核。不同于在任务前固定控制器的方式，轨迹源发送一份契约：针对每个方向，指定跟踪、顺从或维持力范围。基于跟踪误差和力/力矩估计，该内核以接触频率自适应调整手臂的刚度、阻尼、参考值和前馈量。我们通过一个智能体框架演示了KPI：仅凭一条指令，视觉-语言智能体即可编写参考轨迹和契约，无需任何任务特定代码。我们展示了指令驱动的绞盘操作、开门和箱子搬运，以及脚本化的表面交互实验。在绞盘演示中，人形机器人能够转动曲柄，将另一个机器人完全吊离地面。

Authors: Yikai Wang, Honghao Zhu, Xiao Hu, Hao Zhang, Zelin Wang, Yip Fun Yeung, Ding Zhao, Lingfeng Sun

Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback Manipulation

test-time adaptation meta-learning forward dynamics model shared belief latent sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：SCOUT提出了一种元学习框架，通过在测试时利用动作-结果反馈更新共享信念潜在空间来适应机器人操作策略，改善了sim-to-real迁移。

TLDR: SCOUT introduces a meta-learning framework that adapts robotic manipulation policies at test time by updating a shared belief latent space via action-outcome feedback, improving sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: While pretrained robotic policies exhibit impressive capabilities in controlled environments, unobserved physical properties and dynamics require these policies to rapidly adapt during deployment. Existing test-time adaptation methods typically rely on sparse scalar rewards, failing to exploit the rich geometric and dynamic feedback from the environment during physical interaction. To address this challenge, we propose SCOUT, a dynamics-aware meta-learning framework that enables manipulation policies to rapidly adapt by continuously revising their internal beliefs about environment dynamics. Our approach couples an action-prediction policy with a forward dynamics model via a shared belief latent space. During meta-training, an inner loop updates this shared belief latent by minimizing the dynamics prediction error against the observed action outcome, while the outer loop optimizes the network for action selection. At deployment, this structure allows the agent to infer and adapt to unknown physical dynamics on the fly. By updating its latent belief based on action-outcome mismatches, the policy automatically adapts without risking catastrophic forgetting. We demonstrate that SCOUT significantly accelerates online adaptation across simulated manipulation benchmarks and achieves robust sim-to-real transfer in the real world. Project webiste can be found here: https://liy1shu.github.io/SCOUT/

摘要（中文）：虽然预训练机器人策略在受控环境中展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但未知的物理属性和动力学特性要求这些策略在部署过程中快速适应。现有的测试时自适应方法通常依赖稀疏的标量奖励，未能充分利用物理交互过程中来自环境的丰富几何与动态反馈。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SCOUT，一种动力学感知的元学习框架，使操作策略能够通过持续修正其对环境动力学的内部信念来实现快速适应。我们的方法通过共享信念潜空间将动作预测策略与前向动力学模型耦合。在元训练阶段，内循环通过最小化动力学预测误差与观测到的动作结果之间的差异来更新这一共享信念潜变量，而外循环则优化网络以进行动作选择。在部署时，该结构使智能体能够即时推断并适应未知的物理动力学。通过基于动作结果不匹配更新其潜在信念，策略能够自动适应而无需担忧灾难性遗忘。我们证明SCOUT在模拟操作基准测试中显著加速了在线适应，并在真实世界中实现了稳健的仿真到现实迁移。项目网站见：https://liy1shu.github.io/SCOUT/

Authors: Yishu Li, Liyuan Geng, Xinyi Mao, Amber Li, David Held

SAKI: Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation from Human Videos for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

skill assembly kinematic imitation mobile manipulation human videos closed-loop execution

简要说明：SAKI将人类视频技能获取、跨演示组装和闭环全身执行相结合，用于长时间跨度的移动操作，实现技能复用与组合。

TLDR: SAKI connects human-video skill acquisition, cross-demonstration assembly, and closed-loop whole-body execution for long-horizon mobile manipulation, enabling skill reuse and composition.

Abstract: Learning from human videos offers a promising route to acquiring diverse manipulation skills. Extending this capability beyond tabletop settings to long-horizon mobile manipulation requires adapting and composing demonstrated interactions across changing scenes and robot configurations. We present Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation (SAKI), a framework connecting human-video skill acquisition, cross-demonstration assembly and closed-loop whole-body execution. SAKI prepares reusable object-centric skills that preserve task-critical interactions while allowing transfer paths to adapt. Given a goal and supplied task dependencies, it selects and orders skills, binds their object roles to the current scene, and carries scene estimates and robot configuration between successive skills. Whole-body kinematic imitation generates coordinated base, arm and gripper motion. During execution, persistent object estimates maintain task references across viewpoint changes, while visual feedback updates remaining trajectories. Real-robot experiments demonstrate skill reuse across layouts and the composition of independently demonstrated interactions into continuous mobile tasks, including tidying and wiping. Ablation results show that task-conditioned reference preparation substantially improves long-horizon task completion with whole-body optimisation and visual feedback held fixed. Check https://aus.bot/research/saki/ for video demos!

摘要（中文）：从人类视频中学习为获取多样化的操作技能提供了一条有前景的途径。将这一能力从桌面场景扩展到长时间跨度的移动操作，需要适应并组合在不同场景和机器人配置下演示的交互行为。我们提出了技能组装与运动学模仿（SAKI）框架，该框架连接了人类视频技能获取、跨演示组装和闭环全身执行。SAKI准备了可复用的以对象为中心的技能，既保留了任务关键的交互，又允许迁移路径进行适应。给定目标和提供的任务依赖关系后，它选择并排序技能，将其对象角色绑定到当前场景，并在连续技能之间传递场景估计和机器人配置。全身运动学模仿生成协调的基座、手臂和夹爪运动。在执行过程中，持久的对象估计在视角变化时维持任务参照，同时视觉反馈更新剩余轨迹。真实机器人实验证明了技能在不同布局中的重用，以及将独立演示的交互组合为连续移动任务（包括整理和擦拭）的能力。消融结果表明，在全身优化和视觉反馈保持固定的情况下，任务条件化参考准备显著提高了长时间跨度任务的完成率。视频演示请访问 https://aus.bot/research/saki/！

Authors: Yijie Lu, James Zhao, Weiming Zhi

In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications VLA

in-context learning context-conditioned policies geometric demonstration transfer world-model-based control robot learning

简要说明：本文综述了机器人情境学习，将方法分为四类接口家族，分析了在操作和导航中如何实现任务习得与迁移，并提出物理递归自我改进的研究议程。

TLDR: This paper surveys in-context learning for robots, categorizing methods into four interface families and analyzing how they enable task acquisition and transfer across manipulation and navigation, concluding with an agenda for physical recursive self-improvement.

Abstract: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人必须推断出新任务的要求，并将这种理解转化为适当的物理动作。机器人的情境学习通过使用示范和交互，在部署期间保持神经参数固定的情况下，引导已有的能力来支持这一过程。我们围绕连接情境证据与执行的接口来组织这篇文献综述，区分了四个类别：情境条件策略、几何示范迁移、基于世界模型的控制，以及基于技能和智能体的执行。对这些接口进行比较，阐明了它们的迁移假设，以及训练、对应关系和记忆在使情境发挥作用中的角色。在操作和导航领域，我们审视了这些机制如何在对象、环境和执行条件变化时保留所教授的要求。本分析将方法设计与评估实践联系起来，以区分对教学的响应性、物理迁移以及保留经验带来的益处。由此产生的研究议程将组合式任务获取和忠实迁移与物理递归自我改进相结合，在这种自我改进中，经验提升了学习后续任务的能力。

Authors: Haojian Huang, Zexi Li, Junhao Guo, Yehang Zhang, Wenxuan Peng, Bohan Zhou, Weilin Ruan, Leyi Wu, Chenxu Wang, Jianchong Su, Binghui Xie, Wosong Chen, Yingjie Xu, Tianhao Zhou, Suzeyu Chen, Pukun Zhao, Jiaqi He, Xinyi Li, Runze Li, Peiran Dong, Shaoxiang Dang, Jing Huang, Yingbing Chen, Yifan Chang, Tianyi Zhang, Shiyuan Deng, Haozhi Wang, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Han Yang, Kaiwen Zhou, Huaping Liu, James Cheng, Rui Shao, Donglin Wang, Yaochu Jin, Jianye Hao, Ying-Cong Chen, Yinchuan Li

Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method VLN

multi-agent vision-and-language navigation coordination LLM topological memory

简要说明：本文首次系统性地定义了多智能体视觉语言导航（MAVLN）任务，提出包含约束的基准数据集和协调感知的基线方法TRISS，结合LLM调度、共享拓扑记忆与冲突避免执行。

TLDR: This paper introduces MAVLN, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent vision-and-language navigation with constraints, a large benchmark, and a coordination-ready baseline method (TRISS) featuring an LLM-based scheduler, shared topological memory, and conflict-aware execution.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). A verified four-stage crafting pipeline instantiates the task as MAVLN, comprising 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes with teams of up to four agents under three instruction regimes, accompanied by tailored constraint-aware metrics. We further present TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler, a shared topological memory that turns each agent's exploration into team knowledge, and a conflict-aware execution mechanism that realizes simultaneous intentions as collision-free routes. Extensive experiments establish TRISS as a comprehensive baseline and reveal substantial room for improvement across scheduling, planning, and execution, highlighting the challenges of coordinating under MAVLN task constraints. Project page: https://xyz9911.github.io/mavln.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）长期以来主要聚焦于单个智能体遵循单一指令的任务，然而许多现实应用场景要求机器人团队协作完成超出任何单个智能体能力范围的任务。我们提出系统性多智能体视觉与语言导航（Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation），据我们所知，这是首次将多智能体VLN系统性地形式化为一个带约束的协调问题：每项任务由若干子任务构成，这些子任务携带依赖关系和资源约束（存在锁与持有链）。一个经过验证的四阶段生成流程将该任务实例化为MAVLN，涵盖145个场景中的11,724个回合，智能体团队规模最多为四个，并采用三种指令体制，同时配套设计了针对性的约束感知评估指标。我们进一步提出TRISS，一种具备协调能力的导航系统，它将基于大语言模型的子任务调度器、共享拓扑记忆（可将每个智能体的探索转化为团队知识）以及冲突感知执行机制相结合，从而将同步意图实现为无碰撞路径。大量实验表明TRISS可作为综合性基线，同时揭示了在调度、规划与执行方面仍有显著改进空间，凸显了在MAVLN任务约束下进行协调的挑战。项目主页：https://xyz9911.github.io/mavln。

Authors: Yunzhe Xu, Zhe Liu

Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems WorldModel

stochastic world models perception surrogates vision-based neural feedback systems closed-loop verification emergency braking

简要说明：本文提出使用具有物理基础潜在变量的随机世界模型作为视觉神经反馈系统验证的感知替代，并开发了结合伪造、自适应细化、符号和反向分析的验证程序，在紧急制动基准上实现了状态空间解析。

TLDR: This paper introduces stochastic world models with physically grounded latents as perception surrogates for verifying vision-based neural feedback systems, and develops a verification procedure combining falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses, achieving state-space resolution on an emergency braking benchmark.

Abstract: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

摘要（中文）：验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统，需要对其控制器所依据的观测模型进行建模。该模型必须捕捉传感器产生的变化，同时保持对闭环分析的可行性。生成对抗网络（GANs）已被用作感知代理，但此类网络规模庞大，再现复杂场景效果不佳，且难以验证。我们探索将随机世界模型作为更丰富的感知代理类别。我们训练了一个具有物理基础潜在变量的世界模型，该模型基于标准验证器可界定的操作构建。与参数数量高达其130倍的生成对抗网络代理相比，该模型在再现留出帧方面更为忠实。为验证这些代理，我们开发了一种结合伪造、自适应细化、符号分析及反向分析的程序。在采用GAN代理的紧急制动基准测试中，我们的程序解析了整个状态空间，其中38%的状态空间是现有最先进验证器未能解析的。在基准测试的RGB版本中（此前尚无验证结果报道），我们的程序使用世界模型代理解析了超过80%的状态空间。

Authors: I. Samuel Akinwande, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Clark Barrett

Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models action intervention causal effect prediction physics shifts effect loss

简要说明：本文提出 Do-JEPA，一种隐式世界模型训练目标，通过预测动作与参考动作下隐式未来的差异来干预动态过程，从而提高因果效应预测和物理变化下的泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces Do-JEPA, a latent world model training objective that intervenes on the dynamics by predicting the difference between latent futures under an action and a reference action, improving causal effect prediction and generalization under physics shifts.

Abstract: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型被训练用于预测接下来会发生什么，因此其目标函数中没有任何内容能够区分某个动作所导致的结果与仅仅与之共现的事件。诸如C-JEPA之类的对象掩码模型对预测器所能看到的内容进行干预；而我们则对物理上实际发生的事件进行干预。从同一个保存的模拟器状态出发，我们在动作$a$和参考动作$a_{\varnothing}$下分别运行动力学过程，并训练模型预测两个潜在未来之间的差异$\Delta z=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$。由此产生的目标函数Do-JEPA包含效应损失、支持损失（动作进入的位置）、传播损失（效应传播的路径）以及不变性损失（必须保持不变的内容）。在具有对象对齐变量的合成系统中，支持监督在99.95%的测试案例中正确找到了被直接干预的对象，而稀疏动作掩码在每个案例中都将动作发送到了干扰槽位，响应起始监督则恢复了环形传播图（边AUROC为0.975对比0.624）。从像素出发，效应损失优于在完全相同数据上训练的对照组：在端到端LeWM模型上，潜在效应误差降低了28.4%；在自然动作序列上训练和测试时，物理效应误差降低了13.5%；在三个独立生成的CausalWorld基准上，物理偏移下的响应效应误差降低了约20%，预测效应的潜在上下文敏感性降低了66%。从零开始训练会牺牲事实准确性；而用该损失对现有模型进行微调则可以消除这一代价。综合来看，这些结果表明，对世界本身进行干预——而非对模型所见内容进行干预——有助于潜在世界模型更准确地预测其动作所导致的结果。

Authors: Hossein Resani, Javen Qinfeng Shi

Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation Evidence Seeking Progress Grounding Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization Future-guided Reverse Generation

简要说明：SeekVLN 提出了一种用于视觉语言导航的证据寻求框架，将语义进度推理与主动获取任务相关观察相结合，通过未来引导反向生成和反事实对比策略优化来解决'进度近视'故障模式，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了最佳结果。

TLDR: SeekVLN introduces an evidence-seeking framework for Vision-Language Navigation that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations, addressing the 'Progress Myopia' failure mode via future-guided reverse generation and counterfactual contrastive policy optimization, achieving SOTA results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体从长视距指令和部分自我中心观察中持续推断任务进度。现有的基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的导航智能体通常仅基于现有观察进行推理，即使缺少任务相关证据时仍可能保持自信。例如，即使指示下一个转弯的地标位于当前视野之外，智能体仍可能自信地继续前进并最终迷失方向。我们将这种失败模式称为“进度短视”（Progress Myopia）：智能体未能识别不可靠的进度推断，并继续基于不充分的证据采取行动。为解决这一问题，我们提出SeekVLN，一种证据寻求框架，将语义进度推理与主动获取任务相关观察相结合。SeekVLN采用两阶段训练：首先，未来引导反向生成（FRG）利用未来专家动作增强离线专家轨迹，补充额外视角和证据标注。在这些轨迹上进行监督微调，无需额外专家交互即可建立证据寻求和进度推理的先验。然而，仅靠模仿学习无法揭示证据寻求是否能改善后续导航效果。因此，我们引入反事实对比策略优化（C2PO）进行强化微调。通过将每个证据寻求分支与从相同状态出发的反事实直接导航分支进行对比，C2PO利用对比奖励根据后续导航收益对寻求决策进行信用分配。在模拟基准上的实验表明，SeekVLN取得了最先进的性能，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上相较于基础模型分别将成功率提升了12.7%和7.5%。模拟和真实世界评估均展现出类似人类的证据寻求行为，从而实现更可靠的进度推断。

Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust WorldModel

world models subjective logic uncertainty estimation imagination trust

简要说明：本文提出了LucidWM，一种将主观逻辑整合到潜在状态转移中的世界模型，以显式建模不确定性和信任，使智能体能够检测不可靠预测并改善基于想象的决策。

TLDR: This paper introduces LucidWM, a world model that integrates subjective logic into latent transitions to explicitly model doubt and trust, enabling agents to detect unreliable predictions and improve decision-making in imagination.

Abstract: World models enable agents to learn and plan in imagination, but predictions beyond their experience can become unreliable and mislead decisions. Existing uncertainty estimates derived from predictions can remain overconfident on unfamiliar state-action pairs. We propose the Lucid World Model (LucidWM), which learns doubt from experience and propagates trust through imagination. By integrating Subjective Logic into categorical latent transitions, LucidWM distinguishes predicted outcomes from their evidential support and assigns each transition a degree of doubt. The complement of this doubt defines transition-level trust, which accumulates multiplicatively along imagined trajectories to reweight returns for policy learning and guide action selection. Uncertainty estimation requires no additional parameters or forward passes. Evaluated on four base world models against seventeen uncertainty readouts, LucidWM detects environmental changes and signals uncertainty during action-corrupted rollouts. In a controlled navigation case study, acting on trust reduces the number of steps required to reach the goal from 362 to 190. Fifteen demonstration videos show how LucidWM doubts its dreams and acts on that doubt. Videos are available at https://lucidwm.github.io.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使智能体能够在想象中学习和规划，但对超出其经验范围的预测可能变得不可靠，并误导决策。现有基于预测的不确定性估计在面对陌生的状态-动作对时，可能仍表现出过度自信。我们提出了“清醒世界模型”（LucidWM），它从经验中学习怀疑，并通过想象传播信任。通过将主观逻辑融入分类潜在状态转移中，LucidWM能够区分预测结果与其证据支持，并为每次转移赋予一定程度的怀疑。该怀疑的补数定义了转移层面的信任，信任沿想象轨迹以乘法方式累积，以重新加权回报用于策略学习，并指导动作选择。不确定性估计无需额外参数或前向传播。在四种基础世界模型上，针对十七种不确定性读数进行评估，LucidWM能够在动作扰动的轨迹中检测环境变化并发出不确定性信号。在一项受控导航案例研究中，基于信任的行动将到达目标所需的步数从362步减少至190步。十五个演示视频展示了LucidWM如何质疑其梦境并据此采取行动。视频可在 https://lucidwm.github.io 获取。

Authors: Ziqi Wen, Ting Xu, Lianyu Wang, Xian Lin, Yanda Meng, Huazhu Fu, Meng Wang, Ching-Yu Cheng

VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action model traffic signal control multi-view roadside videos cooperative reinforcement learning adaptive reasoning

简要说明：VLALight 是首个用于从多视角路边视频进行端到端交通信号控制的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过两阶段监督冷启动训练和协作智能体强化学习，并采用自适应推理模式来优化局部控制和全网交通效率，在真实世界数据集上优于基线方法。

TLDR: VLALight is the first vision-language-action model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos, using two-stage supervised cold-start training and cooperative agentic reinforcement learning with adaptive reasoning modes to optimize both local control and network-wide traffic efficiency, outperforming baselines on real-world datasets.

Abstract: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. To establish this capability, we develop a two-stage supervised cold-start training strategy for visual traffic understanding and signal decision-making, followed by cooperative agentic reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes local control and network-wide traffic efficiency. Furthermore, VLALight introduces adaptive fast and slow reasoning modes, enabling the policy to allocate deeper reasoning only when additional deliberation provides sufficient control benefits. Through balanced mode-aware rollouts and relative advantage optimization, VLALight learns to trade off decision quality and inference cost. Extensive experiments on seven real-world traffic-flow datasets across three urban networks demonstrate that VLALight consistently outperforms transportation-based, RL-based, and LLM/VLM-based baselines. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of cooperative perception, network-level optimization, and adaptive reasoning. These results demonstrate the potential of VLA models for real-world physical traffic control. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/VLALight.git.

摘要（中文）：交通信号控制（TSC）对于提升城市交通流动性、缓解拥堵至关重要。尽管路侧摄像头已在信号交叉口广泛部署，能够提供不断演变的交通流丰富视觉观测，但现有TSC方法通常依赖人工设计的交通状态或独立的感知模块，导致物理观测与控制决策之间存在鸿沟。我们提出VLALight，这是首个基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的多视角路侧视频端到端交通信号控制系统。VLALight通过多目标时空交通推理及跨交叉口的拓扑感知协同感知，将视觉观测直接映射为协调的信号控制动作。为建立该能力，我们开发了一种两阶段监督冷启动训练策略，分别用于视觉交通理解和信号决策，随后引入协同智能体强化学习，联合优化局部控制与网络级交通效率。此外，VLALight引入了自适应快慢推理模式，使得策略仅在额外思考能够提供充分控制收益时才分配更深层次的推理。通过平衡的模态感知轨迹采样与相对优势优化，VLALight学会了权衡决策质量与推理成本。在三个城市路网上的七套真实交通流数据集上进行的大量实验表明，VLALight持续优于基于交通工程、强化学习及LLM/VLM的基线方法。消融实验验证了协同感知、网络级优化及自适应推理的有效性。上述结果展示了VLA模型在真实物理交通控制中的巨大潜力。我们的项目地址为：https://github.com/usail-hkust/VLALight.git。

Authors: Pan Zhang, Siqi Lai, Kemu Dong, Hao Liu

Speed in the Blind Spot: An Interpretability Analysis of Dynamic Perception in VLMs for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

velocity understanding interpretability vision-language models autonomous driving linear probes

简要说明：本文针对自动驾驶中视觉语言模型的速度理解能力进行了受控诊断研究，发现模型即使产生合理的规划输出，也常无法可靠恢复或时间性接地动态状态。研究在nuScenes上评估了通用、物理AI和面向驾驶的VLA模型，结合语言评估、时间扰动、反事实提示和线性探针，揭示了周围物体速度、自身速度和未来速度任务中的不同失败模式。

TLDR: This paper presents a controlled diagnostic study of velocity understanding in Vision-Language Models for autonomous driving, revealing that models often fail to reliably recover or temporally ground dynamic states despite producing plausible planning outputs. It evaluates general-purpose, physical AI, and driving-oriented VLA models on nuScenes, using verbal evaluation, temporal perturbations, counterfactual hints, and linear probes to uncover distinct failure modes in surrounding-agent speed, ego speed, and future ego-speed tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models are increasingly used in autonomous-driving systems, yet their ability to recover dynamic physical state from visual input remains insufficiently characterized. We study velocity understanding as a controlled diagnostic across three tasks: surrounding-agent speed, current ego speed, and short-horizon future ego-speed proposal. On nuScenes, we evaluate open-weight general-purpose and PhysicalAI VLMs, together with the driving-oriented Alpamayo-1.5 Vision-Language-Action model, using multiple input and output formulations. We combine verbal evaluation with temporal perturbations, counterfactual ego-speed hints and linear probes of hidden representations. The tasks exhibit distinct failure modes. Surrounding-agent speed is weakly encoded in an agent-specific form, whereas current ego speed is often internally accessible but poorly verbalized: continuous probes achieve 4.7-5.8 km/h MAE compared with 10.2-16.8 km/h MAE for verbal outputs. Multiple frames provide inconsistent verbal gains to single frame inputs, and frame order is rarely exploited. Under non-optimized QLoRA, task-specific adaptation improves both task-relevant latent speed representations and verbal readout, but continuous surrounding-agent speed estimation remains weak, while most future-speed gains survive frame shuffling, indicating limited temporal grounding. Driving specialized Alpamayo-1.5 shows stronger latent representations for surrounding-agent and future ego speed, while current ego-speed decodability is comparable and substantial probe-verbal gaps remain. Thus, driving specialization can strengthen motion representations but does not guarantee stronger encoding across both scene and ego states or reliable readout. The results show that plausible planning outputs do not necessarily imply reliable recovery or temporal grounding of the underlying dynamic state.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型正越来越多地应用于自动驾驶系统，但其从视觉输入中恢复动态物理状态的能力仍缺乏充分表征。我们以速度理解作为受控诊断任务，涵盖三个子任务：周围智能体速度、当前自车速度以及短期未来自车速度预测。在nuScenes数据集上，我们评估了开放权重的通用模型和PhysicalAI视觉-语言模型，以及面向驾驶的Alpamayo-1.5视觉-语言-动作模型，采用多种输入和输出格式。我们将语言评估与时间扰动、反事实自车速度提示及隐藏表示的线性探针相结合。各任务表现出不同的失效模式。周围智能体速度以智能体特定形式被弱编码，而当前自车速度通常在内部可访问但语言化表达较差：连续探针的MAE为4.7-5.8 km/h，而语言输出的MAE为10.2-16.8 km/h。多帧输入相比单帧输入在语言输出上的提升有限，且帧顺序很少被有效利用。在非优化QLoRA条件下，任务特定微调既改善了任务相关的潜在速度表征，也提升了语言读出能力，但连续周围智能体速度估计仍然较弱，而大多数未来速度增益在帧打乱后仍然存在，表明时间 grounding 有限。驾驶专用的Alpamayo-1.5在周围智能体和未来自车速度方面表现出更强的潜在表征，而当前自车速度的可解码性与通用模型相当，且探针与语言输出之间的显著差距依然存在。因此，驾驶专用化可以增强运动表征，但并不能保证在场景状态和自车状态上均实现更强的编码或可靠的读出。结果表明，看似合理的规划输出并不必然意味着对底层动态状态的可靠恢复或时间 grounding。

Authors: Katharina Winter, Stefan Englmeier, Fabian B. Flohr

Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement RLRobot

skill-space shooting foundation model guidance policy improvement reusable skills real-world robots

简要说明：技能空间射击利用基础模型从技能库中探索修正行为，并将成功试验转化为策略改进，使自主机器人无需人工演示即可跨任务扩展改进。

TLDR: Skill-space shooting uses foundation models to explore corrective skills from a skill library and converts successful trials into policy improvements for autonomous robots, enabling scalable improvement across tasks without human demonstrations.

Abstract: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. Recent agentic systems offer a way to reduce this reliance on human effort by using foundation models to autonomously compose learned behaviors to complete tasks. Yet completing tasks this way does not itself teach a task policy to overcome its own failures; that requires turning these behaviors into learnable corrections for the policy. Our insight is that many such corrections are familiar short behaviors, or skills: they recur across tasks and describe actions that foundation models can reason about from a scene. We introduce skill-space shooting, which uses foundation model guidance to explore corrections through these reusable skills and turn successful trials into policy improvement. Real-world experiments show repeated improvement in policies acting autonomously, while skills can also be shared to reduce the teaching needed to improve on new tasks. By making reusable skills a source of corrective supervision, skill-space shooting enables scalable and generalizable policy improvement within and across tasks. Additional results and videos at https://skill-space-shooting.github.io.

摘要（中文）：部署于物理世界中的机器人必须能够在遇到新情境和失败时，超越其初始训练进行改进。为了使这种改进能够跨任务扩展，必须有效利用经验，而不需要针对每次修正进行人工演示。近期出现的智能体系统提供了一种减少对人类努力依赖的途径，它利用基础模型自主组合已学行为以完成任务。然而，以这种方式完成任务本身并不能教会任务策略克服自身的失败；这需要将这些行为转化为策略可学习的修正。我们的洞见在于，许多此类修正是熟悉的短行为，即技能：它们在多个任务中反复出现，并描述了基础模型能够从场景中推理出的动作。我们提出了技能空间射击（skill-space shooting）方法，利用基础模型引导，通过这些可复用技能探索修正，并将成功尝试转化为策略改进。真实世界实验表明，策略在自主运行中能够持续改进，同时技能也可以被共享，从而减少在新任务上改进所需的教导量。通过将可复用技能作为修正监督的来源，技能空间射击能够在任务内部及跨任务中实现可扩展且可泛化的策略改进。更多结果和视频请访问 https://skill-space-shooting.github.io。

Authors: Zihang Rui, Renhao Wang, Haoxu Huang, Yang Gao

In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks Manipulation

robotic in-context learning visual demonstrations minimalist ICL framework low-cost data collection manipulation tasks

简要说明：该论文正式定义了机器人上下文学习（ICL），提出了一种极简框架（SimpleICL），包括视觉提示编码器和低成本数据收集协议，无需大规模预训练即可在仿真和真实环境中取得强大性能。

TLDR: This paper formalizes robotic in-context learning (ICL) for manipulation, proposing a minimalist framework (SimpleICL) with a visual prompt encoder and low-cost data collection, achieving strong performance in simulation and real-world settings without massive pretraining.

Abstract: We study robotic in-context learning (ICL), an emerging paradigm that enables robots to infer and execute tasks from visual demonstrations. Despite its growing promise, the problem itself remains under-defined: a visual demonstration simultaneously conveys action trajectories, object semantics, manipulation affordances, spatial relations, and task goals, making it unclear what information the robot is actually expected to follow. In this work, we first provide a clear problem definition of robot ICL that explicitly defines its learning target and resolves this fundamental prompt ambiguity. Building on this definition, we develop a minimalist and reproducible ICL framework (SimpleICL) with a visual prompt encoder and a low-cost data collection protocol. Without massive pre-training or specialized data infrastructure, our framework achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world environments. Extensive experiments further reveal several key properties of robot ICL, including action, semantic, composition, and affordance discrimination. We will fully open-source our data and training pipeline to facilitate systematic and reproducible research on robot ICL. The project page can be found at https://simpleicl.github.io/simpleicl.

摘要（中文）：我们研究机器人情境学习（ICL），这是一种新兴范式，使机器人能够通过视觉演示来推断并执行任务。尽管其前景日益广阔，但该问题本身仍缺乏明确界定：一个视觉演示同时传达了动作轨迹、物体语义、操作可供性、空间关系和任务目标，这使得机器人究竟应遵循何种信息尚不明确。在本研究中，我们首先提供了机器人ICL的清晰问题定义，明确规定其学习目标，并解决了这一根本性的提示模糊问题。在此基础上，我们构建了一个极简且可复现的ICL框架（SimpleICL），包含视觉提示编码器和低成本数据采集协议。无需大规模预训练或专门的数据基础设施，我们的框架在仿真和真实环境中均取得了优异性能。大量实验进一步揭示了机器人ICL的若干关键特性，包括动作辨别、语义辨别、组合辨别和可供性辨别。我们将全面开源我们的数据和训练流程，以促进机器人ICL的系统性和可复现性研究。项目页面可在https://simpleicl.github.io/simpleicl访问。

Authors: Minxing Li, Minghao Han, Weizhi Zhao, Hanwen Wang, Xiangshuo Liu, Shuyao Shang, Jingxiang Zhou, Mingchao Sun, Hongyu Pan, Mu Xu, Yu Liu, Lue Fan, Zhaoxiang Zhang

WayFinder: Hierarchical Visual-Language-Action for Zero-Shot Waypoint Generation and Low-Level Kinematic Control VLA

hierarchical VLA zero-shot waypoint generation low-level kinematic control MLLM AirSim navigation

简要说明：WayFinder是一种分层VLA框架，利用零样本MLLM生成航点，并通过轻量级机载策略进行底层控制，在无需微调的情况下提高了AirSim中的导航成功率。

TLDR: WayFinder is a hierarchical VLA framework that uses a zero-shot MLLM for waypoint generation and a lightweight onboard policy for low-level control, improving navigation success in AirSim without fine-tuning.

Abstract: Visual Language Action (VLA) models offer unprecedented generalization for autonomous robots; however, their real-world deployment is frequently bottlenecked by unreliable execution and the prohibitive computational cost of fine-tuning for specific robot embodiments and tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose WayFinder, an end-to-end, closed-loop hierarchical VLA framework that circumvents the need for fine-tuning by decoupling high-level task reasoning from low-level kinematic control. WayFinder utilizes a zero-shot, offboard Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) policy to process linguistic context and state maps for strategic waypoint generation. Asynchronously, a lightweight, onboard policy executes real-time kinematic control at high frequency based on continuous sensor feedback. We evaluate WayFinder in Microsoft AirSim, testing on four environments of varying complexity and three MLLM scales to balance prediction efficacy with computational efficiency. Our results demonstrate that WayFinder achieves superior navigation reliability compared to baseline low-level policies. By querying the high-level MLLM only during navigation failures, WayFinder eliminates the need for fine-tuning, minimizes expensive inferences, and significantly increases navigation success rates by up to 27.45%.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言动作（VLA）模型为自主机器人带来了前所未有的泛化能力；然而，其在实际部署中常常受限于执行的不可靠性以及针对特定机器人本体和任务进行微调所带来的高昂计算成本。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了WayFinder，一种端到端、闭环的分层VLA框架，通过将高层任务推理与低层运动控制解耦，从而避免了微调的需求。WayFinder利用一种零样本、离车的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）策略来处理语言上下文和状态地图，以生成战略性路径点。同时，一种轻量级的车载策略基于连续传感器反馈，以高频执行实时运动控制。我们在Microsoft AirSim中对WayFinder进行了评估，测试了四种复杂度不同的环境以及三种规模的MLLM，以在预测效能与计算效率之间取得平衡。结果表明，与基线低层策略相比，WayFinder实现了更优越的导航可靠性。通过仅在导航失败时查询高层MLLM，WayFinder无需微调，减少了昂贵的推理调用，并将导航成功率显著提升了高达27.45%。

Authors: Timothy K Johnsen, Marco Levorato

Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking AutonomousDriving

Adaptive Cruise Control personalized driving shared-control overrides acceleration profile prediction driver behavior modeling

简要说明：本文提出 CoP-ACC，一种通过驾驶员超控事件学习的个性化自适应巡航控制系统，利用聚类、上下文分类和残差回归生成个性化加速度曲线，以减少人工干预并提升舒适性。

TLDR: This paper presents CoP-ACC, a personalized Adaptive Cruise Control system that learns from driver throttle overrides during highway overtaking by clustering acceleration profiles, classifying driving contexts, and refining predictions with a residual regressor, aiming to reduce manual interventions and improve comfort.

Abstract: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

摘要（中文）：自适应巡航控制（ACC）系统通常针对普通驾驶员进行标定，这往往导致在诸如高速公路超车等时间关键性操作中，车辆行为与个体期望之间存在不匹配。当ACC被认为过于保守且行为不一致时，驾驶员会通过油门接管进行干预，从而为系统行为提供隐式反馈。本文将这类接管动作重新定义为人在回路中的监督信号，并提出了一种数据驱动的个性化车辆自适应框架，称为情境驱动型个性化ACC（CoP-ACC）。该方法并非仅依赖易于过度平滑动态响应的端到端回归，而是引入了一种混合流程，结合了：（i）无监督层次聚类，用于从接管事件中提取代表性加速度剖面；（ii）一个情境分类器，用于将操作前的驾驶条件映射到相应的剖面；（iii）一个残差回归器，将所选剖面优化为平滑的、针对即时情境定制的个性化加速度剖面。基于真实公共道路数据，并以 withheld 强制ACC基线为对照进行评估，该方法表现出较高的重建保真度，能够生成在潜在接管情境下趋于驾驶员期望行为的加速度剖面。研究结果凸显了从共享控制接管中学习的潜力，有助于实现预测性、个性化的ACC行为，减少人工干预并提升乘坐舒适性。

Authors: Ruizheng Xu, Lounis Adouane, Javier Ibañez-Guzmán, Clément Zinoune

Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding for Trustworthy LLM-Based Robot Planning VLN

LLM-based robot planning semantic grounding risk estimation ambiguity detection trustworthy navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种风险感知的语义锚定框架，在执行LLM机器人规划前估计歧义、幻觉和语义冲突风险，使系统能够安全执行、请求澄清或拒绝指令，并引入了TRUST-NAV基准来评估可信导航规划。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework that estimates ambiguity, hallucination, and semantic-conflict risks before LLM-based robot planning, enabling safe execution, clarification, or rejection, and introduces the TRUST-NAV benchmark for evaluating trustworthy navigation planning.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in robot navigation, but their outputs may become unreliable when instructions are ambiguous, unsupported by the environment, or semantically inconsistent. This paper presents a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework for trustworthy LLM-based robot planning. Unlike existing LLM-based planners that primarily optimize plan generation, we formulate semantic grounding reliability as a multi-dimensional risk estimation problem. The proposed architecture explicitly models grounding uncertainty through ambiguity, hallucination and semantic-conflict risks before planning occurs, enabling the system to decide whether to execute the instruction, request clarification, or reject it. To evaluate the approach, we introduce TRUST-NAV, a benchmark containing both standard navigation tasks and risk-inducing instruction scenarios. Experimental results show that while conventional LLM planners achieve strong performance on valid navigation tasks, the proposed framework substantially improves ambiguity detection and semantic conflict rejection. These findings suggest that trustworthy robot planning should be evaluated not only by task completion, but also by the ability to recognize when execution should not occur.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作机器人导航中的高层规划器，但当指令存在歧义、缺乏环境支持或语义不一致时，其输出可能变得不可靠。本文提出了一种基于风险感知的语义 grounding 框架，以实现可信赖的基于LLM的机器人规划。与现有主要优化规划生成的LLM规划器不同，我们将语义 grounding 的可靠性建模为多维风险估计问题。所提出的架构在规划发生之前，通过模糊性、幻觉和语义冲突风险显式建模 grounding 不确定性，使系统能够决定是执行指令、请求澄清还是拒绝指令。为评估该方法，我们引入了TRUST-NAV基准测试，其中包含标准导航任务和风险诱导指令场景。实验结果表明，尽管传统LLM规划器在有效导航任务上表现出较强性能，但所提出的框架显著提升了歧义检测和语义冲突拒绝能力。这些发现表明，可信赖的机器人规划不仅应通过任务完成情况来评估，还应通过识别何时不应执行的能力来评估。

Authors: Łukasz Sobczak, Nur Keleşoğlu, Sławomir Piotr Nowak

Towards Spatial Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration in Subterranean Mining Environments Perception3D

zero-shot vision-language segmentation 3D scene graph heterogeneous robot collaboration subterranean mining inspection planning

简要说明：本文介绍了地下矿山异构机器人团队的机载感知管线，利用零样本视觉-语言语义分割生成矿藏的三维场景图并规划近距离检查视角，并在实地测试中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an onboard perception pipeline for heterogeneous robot teams in subterranean mines, using zero-shot vision-language semantic segmentation to generate 3D scene graphs of mineral deposits and plan close-range inspection viewpoints, validated in field tests.

Abstract: The autonomous extraction of deep mineral deposits in abandoned underground mines is fundamentally a multi-agent integration problem. No single platform simultaneously offers the mobility to traverse kilometers of degraded drifts and the sensing payload required to characterize an ore body. This article presents the onboard perception pipeline that bridges two heterogeneous agents within the PERSEPHONE autonomous mining mission. Which consist of a lightweight Explorer robot that maps an unknown mine and generates a 3D scene graph of inspection targets, by running a zero-shot, vision-language semantic segmentation stack that detects mineral deposits directly from natural-language prompts. The map and the graph are then handed to a second Inspector robot, which carries an advanced sensing payload and uses them to plan close-range inspection viewpoints. We detail the complete pipeline, with emphasis on the geometric abstraction that turns raw detections into actionable inspection targets, spanning per-view bounding-box generation, cross-view box merging, plane fitting, and polygon extraction, and we report an extensive field validation in a subterranean test facility and in an active magnesite mine, covering both iron-vein and magnesite mineralization under realistic, perceptually degraded conditions.

摘要（中文）：废弃地下矿山深层矿床的自主开采，本质上是一个多智能体集成问题。没有任何单一平台能够同时具备穿越数公里退化巷道所需的机动性，以及表征矿体所需的传感载荷。本文介绍了在PERSEPHONE自主采矿任务中连接两个异构智能体的机载感知流程。该流程由一个轻量级探测器机器人组成，该机器人通过运行零样本、视觉-语言语义分割栈，直接根据自然语言提示检测矿床，从而绘制未知矿山地图并生成检测目标的三维场景图。随后，该地图和场景图被传递给第二个巡检机器人，后者搭载先进传感载荷，并利用这些信息规划近距离检测视点。我们详细阐述了完整流程，重点介绍了将原始检测结果转化为可执行检测目标的几何抽象方法，涵盖逐视角边界框生成、跨视角边界框合并、平面拟合和多边形提取，并报告了在地下测试设施和一座运营中的菱镁矿矿山中开展的大量现场验证，覆盖了在真实且感知退化条件下的铁脉和菱镁矿矿化场景。

Authors: Mario Alberto Valdes Saucedo, Akash Patel, Christoforos Kanellakis, George Nikolakopoulos

Recovering the View: Benchmarking Physical Active Vision for Occlusion Recovery in Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

active vision occlusion recovery bimanual manipulation future-aware policy 4D model

简要说明：本文提出了一个用于机器人操作中遮挡恢复的双臂主动视觉基准BAVO-Bench，以及一种主动视觉策略A-FAR，该策略利用以机器人为中心的3D框架和预训练4D模型提供的未来感知几何指导，来提高对遮挡的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces BAVO-Bench, a bimanual active-vision benchmark for occlusion recovery in robotic manipulation, and A-FAR, an active-vision policy that uses a robot-centric 3D frame and future-aware geometric guidance from a pretrained 4D model to improve robustness to occlusion.

Abstract: Physical active vision allows robots to change their viewpoint when task-relevant observations become unreliable, yet existing manipulation benchmarks provide limited support for studying how policies recover from occlusion during execution. We introduce BAVO-Bench (Bimanual Active Vision under Occlusion), a bimanual active-vision benchmark that systematically controls external visibility through Clean, Stage Occlusion, and Random-time Occlusion conditions, enabling evaluation of both manipulation performance and active visual recovery. Building on this setting, we present A-FAR (Active Future-Aware Recovery), an active-vision policy for joint viewpoint and manipulation control. A-FAR represents moving-camera observations in a unified robot-centric 3D frame and distills relational structure together with its future evolution from a pretrained 4D model, providing the policy with future-aware geometric guidance without requiring future observations at deployment. Experiments across multiple manipulation tasks show that A-FAR improves robustness to both structured and temporally shifted occlusions while maintaining strong performance under clean observations.

摘要（中文）：物理主动视觉使机器人能够在与任务相关的观察变得不可靠时改变视角，然而现有的操作基准对研究策略在执行过程中如何从遮挡中恢复所提供的支持有限。我们引入了BAVO-Bench（遮挡下的双手主动视觉基准），这是一个双手主动视觉基准，通过干净环境、阶段性遮挡和随机时间遮挡三种条件系统性地控制外部可见性，从而能够评估操作性能和主动视觉恢复能力。基于这一设置，我们提出了A-FAR（主动未来感知恢复），一种用于联合视角与操作控制的主动视觉策略。A-FAR将移动相机观测统一表示在机器人中心的3D坐标系中，并从预训练的4D模型中提炼关系结构及其未来演化，为策略提供具有未来感知的几何指导，而无需在部署时获取未来观测。在多项操作任务上的实验表明，A-FAR在结构性和时间偏移遮挡下均提升了鲁棒性，同时在干净观测条件下保持了较强的性能。
