Authors: Kaijun Luo, Yudi Huang, Qijun Zhong, Xinshuai Song, Yang Liu, Liang Lin

All You Need Is Low Fidelity: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real of Learned Robotic Fish Control Locomotion

sim-to-real transfer robotic fish low-fidelity simulation closed-loop control underactuated soft robot

简要说明：本文表明，对于软体机器鱼，一个低保真度、无状态的模拟器足以训练出可零样本迁移到硬件的闭环控制器，实现目标到达、扰动抑制和分布外跟踪。关键在于将控制器限制在已识别的动态频带内，而非提高模拟器保真度。

TLDR: This paper demonstrates that a low-fidelity, stateless simulator is sufficient to train a closed-loop controller for a soft robotic fish that transfers zero-shot to hardware, achieving target reaching, disturbance rejection, and out-of-distribution tracking. The key is constraining the controller to the identified dynamic band rather than increasing simulator fidelity.

Abstract: Complex tasks for underwater robots remain limited by the capabilities of their controllers. Learning a better one for a soft, underactuated robotic fish trades simulator cost against fidelity. We show that an intentionally low-fidelity simulator is enough: a stateless, quasi-steady fluid model with no wake and no added-mass history suffices to learn a \emph{general}, closed-loop controller that transfers to hardware without tuning. Our platform is a soft, single-motor, tendon-driven fish whose policy observes only what the hardware can measure. A staged pipeline grounds the simulator in two independent identifications, fixing the tail dynamics and a stateless fluid model; the policy then acts through a band-limited rhythmic trajectory generator rather than commanding the tail directly. Deployed unchanged in an outdoor pool, a single policy performs closed-loop target reaching, disturbance rejection, and out-of-distribution target acquisition and tracking. The transfer rests on the constraint rather than the fidelity: the generator cannot leave the band over which the fluid was identified. This raises the question of how much of the physics can reside in the controller rather than in the simulator.

摘要（中文）：摘要：水下机器人执行复杂任务的能力仍受限于其控制器的性能。针对一款软体、欠驱动仿生鱼，学习更优控制器需在仿真器成本与保真度之间权衡。我们证明，一个刻意采用低保真度的仿真器便已足够：仅凭一个无状态、准定常的流体模型，既无尾迹效应也无附加质量历史，即可学习一个通用的闭环控制器，且无需调参即可直接迁移至硬件。我们的平台是一条软体、单电机、腱驱动的仿生鱼，其策略仅依赖硬件可测量的状态信息。采用分阶段流水线，通过两次独立辨识将仿真器落地，分别确定尾部动力学与无状态流体模型；随后，策略通过一个带限的节律轨迹生成器发挥作用，而非直接指令尾部动作。在室外泳池中未经改动直接部署，单一策略即可完成闭环目标到达、扰动抑制以及分布外目标的获取与跟踪。迁移的成功依赖于约束而非保真度：生成器无法超出流体辨识所覆盖的频带。这引发了一个问题：究竟有多少物理特性可以置于控制器中，而非仿真器中。

Authors: Liam Maloney, Simon Ramchandani, Mike Y. Michelis, Ronan Hinchet, Robert K. Katzschmann

Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video HumanoidEmbodied

failed video learning humanoid skills imitation learning task completion motion prefix

简要说明：TRACC 通过模仿失败前成功运动前缀并利用任务完成奖励推断并实现预期目标，从单个失败的人类视频中学习人形技能，无需成功演示。

TLDR: TRACC learns humanoid skills from a single failed human video by imitating the successful motion prefix before failure and then using task-completion rewards to infer and achieve the intended outcome, enabling learning without successful demonstrations.

Abstract: Learning humanoid skills from videos typically requires a successful human demonstration, which often demands custom data collection. Although failures have traditionally been treated only as negative examples in robot learning, they can still reveal a usable trajectory prefix before the task fails, as well as the intended outcome. To leverage this information from a failed-attempt video, we propose TRACC, a pipeline that imitates the useful portion of the motion trajectory and then completes the task based on the inferred task outcome. The usable motion prefix serves as prior knowledge until the failure occurs, after which the task-completion reward guides the policy to learn the intended task goal without requiring a successful task trajectory. We evaluate our method on six in-the-wild failed human tasks from the Oops! dataset. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for learning from failed attempts when no successful demonstration is available. Thus, these findings establish failed human videos as a viable source of supervision for humanoid skill learning.

摘要（中文）：从视频中学习人形技能通常需要成功的人类示范，而这往往要求定制化的数据收集。尽管失败在机器人学习传统上仅被视为负面示例，但它们在任务失败前仍能揭示一段可用的轨迹前缀以及预期结果。为了利用失败尝试视频中的这一信息，我们提出了TRACC，一种模仿运动轨迹中可用部分、随后基于推断出的任务结果完成任务的处理流程。可用的运动前缀作为先验知识，直至失败发生，此后任务完成奖励引导策略学习预期任务目标，无需成功的任务轨迹。我们在Oops!数据集的六个野外失败人类任务上评估了我们的方法。实验结果证明了所提方法在无成功示范时从失败尝试中学习的有效性。因此，这些发现确立了失败人类视频作为人形技能学习的一种可行监督来源。

Authors: Sarmad Idrees, Jongeun Choi

GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion Perception3D

radar-RGB-D fusion transparent surface segmentation cross-modal attention robotic perception real-time segmentation

简要说明：GlassFormer 提出了一种用于机器人的实时透明表面分割方法，通过融合毫米波雷达与 RGB-D 数据，利用雷达引导的空间先验和跨模态注意力在轻量级 Transformer 中实现。在低光条件下相比纯视觉基线展示了显著的鲁棒性提升，同时保持实时性能。

TLDR: GlassFormer introduces a real-time transparent surface segmentation method for robots by fusing millimeter-wave radar with RGB-D data, using a radar-guided spatial prior and cross-modal attention in a lightweight transformer. It demonstrates substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines, especially in low-light conditions, while maintaining real-time performance.

Abstract: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.

摘要（中文）：透明表面在建筑环境中无处不在，但它们在机器人感知中始终是一个持续的失败案例。RGB摄像头感知到的是玻璃背后的背景而非玻璃表面本身，而LiDAR、飞行时间法和RGB-D等深度传感器在透明区域往往返回无效或背景测量值。因此，仅依赖光学感知的系统可能将玻璃墙、门或镜子误判为自由空间，从而危及安全可靠的导航。现有的玻璃分割方法通过从RGB图像中学习反射、边界和语义上下文等视觉线索来解决这一问题。尽管在有利的光照和视角条件下效果良好，但这类线索在低光照环境、强光直射、玻璃表面缺乏纹理特征或部分遮挡的情况下会退化失效。在本工作中，我们提出了一种多模态框架，将毫米波雷达与RGB-D感知融合，用于实时透明表面分割。雷达在玻璃表面产生强反射，提供了一种在视觉和深度感知失效时依然可靠的几何线索。我们利用这种跨模态不一致性生成雷达引导的空间先验，并通过跨模态注意力机制将其集成到基于轻量级Transformer的分割网络GlassFormer中。我们在覆盖所有场景类型的混合条件测试集以及专门设计用于考验纯视觉方法的低光照测试集上报告了实验结果。GlassFormer在混合测试集上达到0.88的mIoU，在低光照测试集上达到0.59的mIoU，相较于纯视觉基线方法显示出显著的鲁棒性提升，同时保证了在资源受限平台上的实时性能。

Authors: Suhani Grover, Astik Srivastava, Viswas Dinesh, Avinash Sharma, K. Madhava Krishna

TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations Manipulation

Tactile Reward Learning Touch-based Reward Contact-rich Manipulation Reward Shaping Demonstration Learning

简要说明：TaRL 利用触觉形变图，从成功和失败的演示中学习稠密奖励函数，以提高接触丰富的操作任务中的样本效率和成功率，并在仿真和真实世界中得到验证。

TLDR: TaRL learns dense reward functions from tactile deformation maps using both successful and failed demonstrations, improving sample efficiency and success rates in contact-rich manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to sequence precise contacts, maintain stable grasps, and apply directed forces. Reinforcement learning (RL) can acquire such behaviors automatically, but its performance hinges on reward design: sparse rewards reduce the learning efficiency, while dense rewards are hard to specify. Visual reward learning addresses this by inferring rewards from action-free demonstrations. Because it conditions only on visual observations, it fails to capture rewards beyond visual goals. We propose Tactile Reward Learning (TaRL), a framework that learns rewards from tactile demonstrations. TaRL takes a sequence of tactile deformation maps as input, and regresses task-completion progress from both successful and failed demonstrations. Because TaRL captures local robot-object interaction, it provides informative feedback to learn firm grasps and correctly directed forces; meanwhile, it is robust to changes in scene layout such as object position. We evaluate TaRL on four manipulation tasks in simulation and two in the real world. Used as a shaping reward, it substantially improves both sample efficiency and final success rate, raising success on Nut threading from 34% to 56% in simulation and on cube pickup from 37% to 97% in the real world. Combining tactile with visual rewards improves performance further. TaRL also generalizes across object instances: trained on box placement and directly deployed to can placement, it significantly improves policy learning on the new task. Project page is available at https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/tarl.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的操作要求机器人能够规划精确的接触序列、保持稳定抓取并施加定向力。强化学习能够自动习得此类行为，但其表现高度依赖奖励设计：稀疏奖励会降低学习效率，而稠密奖励则难以明确设定。视觉奖励学习通过从无动作演示中推断奖励来解决这一问题。然而，由于该方法仅依赖视觉观测，因此无法捕捉超出视觉目标之外的奖励信息。我们提出触觉奖励学习框架，该框架从触觉演示中学习奖励信号。具体而言，该方法以触觉形变图序列为输入，并从成功与失败的演示中回归任务完成进度。由于触觉奖励学习能够捕捉局部机器人-物体交互信息，因此可为学习稳固抓取和正确定向力提供有效的反馈信号；同时，该方法对物体位置等场景布局变化具有鲁棒性。我们在四项仿真操作任务和两项真实世界任务上评估了触觉奖励学习。当作为塑形奖励使用时，该方法显著提升了样本效率和最终成功率，在仿真环境中将螺母拧紧任务的成功率从34%提升至56%，在真实世界中将立方体抓取任务的成功率从37%提升至97%。将触觉奖励与视觉奖励相结合可进一步提升性能。此外，触觉奖励学习还具备跨物体实例的泛化能力：在箱体放置任务上训练后直接部署到罐体放置任务中，显著改善了新任务上的策略学习效果。项目页面可在 https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/tarl 查看。

Authors: Po-Yi Wu, Dao-Jan Chang, Shang-Ya Hsiao, Hong-Ming Chen, Yu-Cheng Su, Tsung-Wei Ke

Scale-Invariant Manipulability Shape Tracking Across Heterogeneous Manipulators Manipulation

manipulability shape tracking scale-invariant unit-determinant representative affine-invariant Riemannian metric quadratic program

简要说明：本文提出一种跨异构机械臂的尺度不变可操作度形状跟踪方法，利用单位行列式形状表示和黎曼度量仅传递方向与轴比信息，并结合约束二次规划进行运动控制。

TLDR: This paper proposes a scale-invariant manipulability shape tracking method for heterogeneous manipulators, using unit-determinant shape representatives and a Riemannian metric to transfer only orientation and axis-ratio information across robots or from human demonstrations, integrated into a constrained quadratic program.

Abstract: When transferring manipulability across systems with different sizes and kinematic structures, matching absolute ellipsoid scale may be unnecessary when the goal is to reproduce orientation and semi-axis length ratios. Full-matrix tracking, however, penalizes both shape and absolute-scale differences, even when only shape matching is required. We therefore propose a scale-invariant manipulability shape-tracking method that treats matrices differing only by a positive scalar factor as equivalent and uses their unit-determinant representatives. We derive the differential of the unit-determinant shape representative and an orthonormal coordinate representation of the tangent tracking residual under the affine-invariant Riemannian metric (AIRM). The resulting scale-invariant objective is integrated with position and end-effector direction tasks in a constrained joint-velocity quadratic program. Simulations with four heterogeneous robots evaluate robot-to-robot and human-to-robot transfer. On three followers, the proposed method achieves endpoint shape distances of 9.30 x 10^-5 without scale tuning. With robot-specific target scales tuned during motion, the Full method retains endpoint axis-ratio errors of 0.19-0.31 on KR500 and UR20. For human reaching with concurrent tasks, the proposed method yields dual force shapes elongated along X like the human target on all four robots, with endpoint position errors of 2.4-5.6% of reference arm length versus up to 75% for the Full method tracking the original human ellipsoid.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在不同尺寸和运动学结构的系统之间传递可操作性时，若目标是复现方向及半轴长度比例，匹配绝对椭球尺度可能并无必要。然而，全矩阵跟踪会同时惩罚形状差异和绝对尺度差异，即使在仅需形状匹配的情况下也是如此。因此，我们提出一种尺度不变的可操作性形状跟踪方法，将仅相差一个正标量因子的矩阵视为等价，并使用其单位行列式代表矩阵。我们推导了单位行列式形状代表的微分，以及在仿射不变黎曼度量（AIRM）下切线跟踪残差的正交坐标表示。所得到的尺度不变目标函数与位置和末端执行器方向任务相结合，构成一个带约束的关节速度二次规划。使用四台异构机器人的仿真评估了机器人到机器人与人到机器人的传递效果。在三台从动机器人上，所提方法在不进行尺度调节的情况下实现了端点形状距离为9.30×10⁻⁵。在运动过程中调节机器人特定目标尺度的情况下，全矩阵方法在KR500和UR20上的端点轴比误差保持在0.19至0.31之间。对于伴有多任务的人体伸展动作，所提方法在四台机器人上均生成了沿X方向拉长的双力形状，与人体目标一致，端点位置误差为参考臂长的2.4%至5.6%，而对于跟踪原始人体椭球的全矩阵方法，该误差最高可达75%。

Authors: Geunwoo Kwon, Dong-gyu Lee, Kai Li, Soonwoong Hwang, Wansoo Kim

DRHeC: Differentiable Rendering for Hand-Eye Calibration with RGB-Based Gradients Manipulation

hand-eye calibration differentiable rendering RGB-based gradients markerless calibration robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于RGB的无标记可微渲染手眼标定方法，通过引入颜色和掩码几何特征提高了标定精度和优化稳定性，在真实机器人抓取和插入任务中优于现有方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces a markerless, RGB-based differentiable rendering framework for hand-eye calibration that uses color and mask geometric features to improve accuracy and optimization stability, outperforming prior methods in real-robot grasping and insertion tasks.

Abstract: Accurate hand-eye calibration is crucial for precision manipulation. Traditional methods rely on markers, with their precision dependent on marker accuracy and observability. In contrast, markerless methods, such as learning-based approaches, use deep neural networks to directly extract keypoints or features from images, enabling the computation of hand-eye transformation with a single image and without the need for physical markers. Recently, differentiable rendering-based methods for hand-eye calibration have leveraged physical models to render binary masks and compare them with observations, enabling hand-eye calibration without fiducial markers in the calibration stage and providing interpretable optimization. While the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods achieve remarkable accuracy, the use of binary masks can result in the loss of internal profile details, reducing precision. Additionally, these methods can also suffer from unstable optimization and local minima. In this study, we propose a novel RGB-based differentiable rendering framework that provides richer geometric and appearance cues by incorporating color and mask geometric features, thereby improving calibration accuracy and optimization stability. Additionally, we propose a mask-guided image-to-image translation method to ensure explicit preservation of color and geometric consistency throughout the translation. Our approach is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, with results demonstrating strong accuracy and robustness and clear improvements over existing differentiable rendering methods. Our method achieves a grasping success rate of 88.9% and insertion success rate of 57.4% on the UR5e real-world experiment, outperforming the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering hand-eye calibration method EasyHeC by 46.3 and 48.1 percentage points, respectively.

摘要（中文）：精确的手眼标定对于精密操作至关重要。传统方法依赖于标记物，其精度取决于标记物的准确性和可观测性。相比之下，无标记方法（如基于学习的方法）利用深度神经网络直接从图像中提取关键点或特征，从而能够在无需物理标记的情况下通过单张图像计算手眼变换矩阵。近年来，基于可微渲染的手眼标定方法利用物理模型渲染二值掩码并与观测值进行比较，在标定阶段无需基准标记即可实现手眼标定，并提供可解释的优化过程。尽管最先进的可微渲染方法已达到显著精度，但使用二值掩码可能导致内部轮廓细节丢失，从而降低精度。此外，这些方法还可能面临优化不稳定和陷入局部最小值的问题。 在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于RGB的可微渲染框架，通过融合颜色和掩码几何特征来提供更丰富的几何与外观线索，从而提高标定精度和优化稳定性。同时，我们提出了一种掩码引导的图像到图像转换方法，确保在转换过程中颜色和几何一致性得到明确保留。我们的方法通过仿真和真实世界实验进行了验证，结果表明其具有较高的精度和鲁棒性，并明显优于现有可微渲染方法。在UR5e真实世界实验中，我们的方法实现了88.9%的抓取成功率和57.4%的插入成功率，分别比最先进的可微渲染手眼标定方法EasyHeC高出46.3个百分点和48.1个百分点。

Authors: Xiaotian Zhang, Yusheng Wang, Naoya Kagawa, Noritaka Takamura, Keiji Okuhara, Hiroyasu Baba, Jun Ota

Kinematic Nonlinear Spatio-Temporal Trajectory Warping for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation Demonstrations Manipulation

trajectory warping contact-rich manipulation dexterous hands demonstration object-centric

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于接触分布的重塑接触丰富灵巧操作演示的方法，通过简单目标为中心的扭曲流程，生成考虑中间路点、环境障碍、时间偏移和不同起始/结束配置的高质量非线性轨迹，并在4个人手演示的12个变体中进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to warp contact-rich dexterous manipulation demonstrations, using contact distributions to produce high-quality nonlinear trajectory warps that account for waypoints, barriers, temporal shifts, and varied start/end configurations, and evaluates it across 12 variations from 4 human hand motion demonstrations.

Abstract: We present a straightforward but effective method for repurposing existing contact-rich dexterous manipulation demonstrations. Starting from inputs of hand and object trajectories, our method outputs high-quality nonlinear trajectory warps that account for intermediate waypoints, environmental barriers, temporal shifts, and varied start/end configurations. Foundational to our method is the utilization of contact distributions, which we show allows us to reliably compute complex and high-dimensional dexterous hand trajectories following a simple object-centric warp specification pipeline. We evaluate our method across 12 variations sourced from 4 demonstrations in a publicly available dataset of human hand motion data, perform baseline comparisons, and demonstrate generalization of our approach to different manipulators. Results and code will be made available on publication.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种直接而有效的方法，用于重新利用现有的接触丰富型灵巧操作演示。该方法以手部和物体的轨迹为输入，输出高质量的非线性轨迹变形，能够处理中间路点、环境障碍、时间偏移以及不同的起始/结束配置。我们方法的基础在于利用接触分布，研究表明，这一方法能够使我们通过一个简单的以物体为中心的变形规范流程，可靠地计算出复杂且高维的灵巧手部轨迹。我们在一个公开可获取的人类手部运动数据集中，基于4个演示生成了12种变体，对所提方法进行了评估，进行了基线对比，并展示了该方法对不同操作器的泛化能力。结果和代码将在发表后提供。

Authors: Hyojae Park, Arjun S. Lakshmipathy, Nancy S. Pollard

Foundation-Model-Guided Topology-Aware Semantic Risk Fields for Manipulation Manipulation

foundation model semantic risk field topology-aware motion planning manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种基础模型引导的、拓扑感知的语义风险场，用于机器人操作，通过将语义先验与三维几何集成来超越碰撞避免，并在模拟家庭场景中展示了更低的语义暴露。

TLDR: This paper proposes a foundation-model-guided, topology-aware semantic risk field for robot manipulation, extending safety beyond collision avoidance by integrating semantic priors with 3D geometry, and demonstrates reduced semantic exposure in simulated household scenarios.

Abstract: Robot motion planning in everyday environments must satisfy hard geometric constraints while accounting for context-dependent semantic risk. We present a foundation-model-guided, topology-aware semantic risk field that extends manipulation safety beyond collision avoidance. For each manipulated-object/scene-object pair, a foundation model provides six directional risk weights and a pair-specific spatial decay scale. The method combines these priors with voxelized 3D scene geometry using topology-aware shielding and geodesic spatial decay. A GPU-parallel backend batches object-level distance and risk computations to construct a dense 3D field that serves as a modular cost for downstream motion planning. We evaluate the field's shielding behavior under full and partial barriers and compare its 3D workspace representation with a pixel-wise semantic-prior baseline. Across three household simulation scenarios, trajectories optimized with the proposed field have lower semantic exposure than collision-only trajectories under the same geometric constraints. We also evaluate the computational practicality and reliability of the supporting pipeline. Together, these results support the proposed field as a practical topology-aware semantic cost representation for manipulation planning beyond collision avoidance.

摘要（中文）：日常环境中的机器人运动规划必须满足严格的几何约束，同时兼顾与上下文相关的语义风险。我们提出了一种基于基础模型引导、拓扑感知的语义风险场，将操作安全性拓展到碰撞避免之外。对于每个被操作物体与场景物体之间的配对，基础模型提供六个方向的风险权重，以及针对配对的空间衰减尺度。该方法通过拓扑感知遮挡和测地空间衰减，将这些先验信息与体素化的三维场景几何相结合。一个GPU并行后端批量处理物体级别距离与风险计算，构建出稠密三维场，作为下游运动规划的模块化代价函数。我们在完全和部分遮挡条件下评估该场的屏蔽行为，并将其三维工作空间表示与基于像素的语义先验基线进行比较。在三个家庭仿真场景中，利用所提出场优化的轨迹在相同几何约束下，其语义暴露程度低于仅考虑碰撞规避的轨迹。我们还评估了支撑流水线的计算可行性和可靠性。综合来看，这些结果支持所提出的场作为操作规划中超越碰撞避免的实用拓扑感知语义代价表示。

Authors: Giung Lee, Weihang Guo, Lydia E. Kavraki

RoboChrono: A Real Robot Benchmark for Streaming Task Understanding Manipulation

streaming task understanding real robot benchmark temporal grounding vision-language models action understanding

简要说明：RoboChrono是一个用于机器人操作中流式任务理解的新基准，包含真实机器人执行数据，评估了18个VLM模型在识别、对齐和时间定位任务上的表现，揭示了视觉匹配与时间排序能力之间的差距。

TLDR: RoboChrono is a new benchmark for streaming task understanding in robot manipulation, comprising real robot executions and evaluating 18 VLM models on recognition, alignment, and temporal grounding tasks, revealing a gap between visual matching and temporal ordering abilities.

Abstract: Understanding ongoing robot manipulation requires models to interpret visual observations in relation to interaction history and task progress. We introduce RoboChrono, a benchmark for streaming task understanding comprising 39 scenarios and 34,713 evaluation instances, constructed from real robot executions and complementary bare-hand human recordings. The benchmark evaluates seven tasks grouped into recognition, alignment, and temporal grounding, covering action understanding and anticipation, visual correspondence, temporal ordering, and action localization. Zero-shot evaluation of 18 vision-language models reveals substantial differences across tasks. GPT-6-Astra achieves 98.3% accuracy on Frame Matching but 68.3% on Frame Ordering, while RynnBrain1.1-122B-A10B exhibits a larger gap, reaching 95.4% and 32.9%, respectively. Input ablations on matched questions with five open-weight models further reveal distinct dependencies on visual evidence: removing visual observations reduces Current Action Recognition accuracy by 22.1 percentage points, whereas Next Action Prediction decreases by only 0.7 points. These findings show that strong visual matching does not consistently coincide with strong temporal ordering, and suggest that next-action prediction can be supported by task and action priors even when visual evidence is unavailable. RoboChrono provides a diagnostic setting for examining these differences, highlighting the need for capability-specific evaluation beyond aggregate scores when assessing task understanding in robot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：理解持续的机器人操作需要模型将视觉观察与交互历史和任务进度关联起来进行解读。我们提出了RoboChrono，一个用于流式任务理解的基准测试，包含39个场景和34,713个评估实例，数据来源于真实机器人执行过程以及互补的裸手人类录制的视频。该基准涵盖七项任务，归为识别、对齐和时间定位三大类，涉及动作理解与预测、视觉对应、时间排序以及动作定位。对18个视觉语言模型的零样本评估揭示了不同任务间的显著差异。GPT-6-Astra在帧匹配任务上达到98.3%的准确率，但在帧排序任务上仅为68.3%；而RynnBrain1.1-122B-A10B在这些任务上的差距更大，分别达到95.4%和32.9%。针对五个开放权重模型的匹配问题输入消融实验进一步揭示了模型对视觉证据的不同依赖程度：移除视觉观察后，当前动作识别准确率下降了22.1个百分点，而下一动作预测仅下降了0.7个百分点。这些发现表明，强大的视觉匹配能力并不总是与强大的时间排序能力保持一致，并提示下一动作预测在缺乏视觉证据时仍可依托任务和动作先验得到支持。RoboChrono为考察这些差异提供了一个诊断性环境，强调了在评估机器人操作任务理解时，除总体分数外还需进行面向能力的专项评估的必要性。

Authors: Yuzhou Wu, Longteng Fan, Zimeng Li, Yu Wanchan, Ting Zhang, Yiyang Ma, Shihao Li, Wei Ying, Jianbin Qin, Jiajian Jing, Fangwen Chen, Yifan Wu, Zichen Zhang, Ruiqi Yang, Weibin Kong, Yihang Xu, Haoran Liu, Zonghang He, Xuyang Liu, YiFan Xiong, Siteng Huang, Tao Xu, Zhuo Xu, Long Chen, Ruoxiang Li

Executor-aware Candidate Selection via a Feasibility Certificate Manipulation

candidate selection feasibility certificate motion planning executor constraints modular robotic systems

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于证书的候选选择框架，用于验证运动规划候选是否可由具有硬状态依赖约束的下游执行器执行，从而提高模块化机器人系统的可行性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a certificate-based framework for selecting motion-planning candidates that verifies whether a candidate is executable by a downstream executor with hard state-dependent constraints, improving feasibility in modular robotic systems.

Abstract: Modular robotic systems often separate motion planning from a downstream executor that enforces state-dependent hard constraints. A candidate that is geometrically valid may therefore be incompatible with the executor's available command set. We present a certificate-based candidate-selection framework that constructs a command witness from the executor hard set at predicted rollout states and verifies it against the original constraints, without changing candidate generation, ranking, or the executor. Across 5,085 geometry-valid numerical evaluations on two robot models, 795 admitted no executor-feasible command. The certificate is sufficient but conservative: none of the 795 was certified, while 7.09\% of reference-feasible cases remained uncertified. In controlled FR3 and fixed-base RB-Y1 simulations, certificate admission frequently changed candidate selection, and a post-hoc exact linear-programming (LP) admission baseline revealed platform-dependent conservatism. Relative to geometry-based selection, certificate admission was associated with lower planner-command coverage and higher nominal tracking error, without a consistent advantage in reached-state interaction reserve. A planner-generated MoveIt/OMPL study further evaluates the same admission rule on externally generated candidate pools.

摘要（中文）：模块化机器人系统通常将运动规划与下游执行器分离，后者负责实施依赖于状态变量的硬约束。因此，几何上有效的候选轨迹可能无法兼容执行器可用的命令集。本文提出了一种基于证书的候选选择框架，该框架在预测的滚动状态点上，从执行器硬约束集中构造命令见证，并根据原始约束对其进行验证，而无需修改候选生成、排序或执行器本身。 在对两种机器人模型进行的5,085次几何有效性数值评估中，795次未接受任何执行器可行的命令。该证书条件充分但保守：795次中无一通过认证，而参考可行情况中有7.09%仍未被认证。在受控FR3和固定基座RB-Y1仿真中，证书认证经常改变候选选择结果，且事后精确线性规划（LP）认证基线揭示了平台相关的保守性。与基于几何的选择相比，证书认证与较低的规划器命令覆盖率和较高的名义跟踪误差相关，而在到达状态的交互裕度方面并无一致优势。一项由规划器生成的MoveIt/OMPL研究在外部生成的候选池上进一步评估了相同的认证规则。

Authors: Sooin Choi, Soonwoong Hwang, Wansoo Kim

Inferring Soil Friction Angle from Robot Foot-Ground Force Histories: A Bayesian Inverse Approach to Proprioceptive Soil Sensing Locomotion

proprioceptive soil sensing Bayesian inversion foot-ground forces quadruped robot material point method

简要说明：本文利用基于物质点法模拟训练的GP代理模型和贝叶斯反演，从四足机器人足地力历史中识别土壤内摩擦角，在匹配模型实验中实现了高精度，支持本体感觉土壤感知。

TLDR: This paper uses Bayesian inversion with Gaussian-process surrogates trained on material point method simulations to identify soil friction angles from quadruped robot foot-ground force histories, achieving high accuracy in matched-model experiments and supporting proprioceptive soil sensing.

Abstract: Foot-ground interaction signals recorded by quadruped robots may enable spatially distributed, in situ characterization of soil strength. As a first step, we test whether the internal friction angle $φ$ of cohesionless soil can be identified from the force history of a simplified rotating leg. A two-dimensional continuum model implemented with the material point method, benchmarked against measured rotating-leg force histories, generates the training data, and two Gaussian-process surrogates support Bayesian inversion of the full histories. In matched-model experiments, the framework recovers 14 off-grid friction angles with a median absolute error of approximately $0.1^\circ$ (maximum $\sim 0.7^\circ$); the reported credible intervals contain the true value in every case. These results establish that $φ$ is identifiable when the forward model is correctly specified, and support further development of proprioceptive soil sensing for spatially variable terrain, with applications from physics-grounded world models for robot training to post-wildfire slope assessment.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人记录的脚-地面交互信号可能实现对土壤强度的空间分布式原位表征。作为第一步，我们测试是否可以从简化旋转腿的力历史中识别出无粘性土的内摩擦角$\phi$。采用物质点法实现的二维连续介质模型，以实测旋转腿力历史为基准生成训练数据，两个高斯过程代理模型支持对完整力历史的贝叶斯反演。在匹配模型实验中，该框架恢复了14个离网格摩擦角，中位绝对误差约为$0.1^\circ$（最大约$0.7^\circ$）；所报告的置信区间在每种情况下均包含真实值。这些结果证实，在前向模型正确指定的前提下，$\phi$是可识别的，并支持面向空间变化地形的本体感觉土壤传感的进一步开发，其应用涵盖从基于物理的机器人训练世界模型到火灾后边坡评估。

Authors: Dawei Xu, Zhijie Wang

Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation VLA

visual control barrier functions teacher-student distillation RGB-only safety filter dynamic visual navigation Gaussian Splatting

简要说明：本文提出一种师生蒸馏框架，将特权控制屏障函数教师的安全行为迁移到仅使用RGB的学生滤波器，实现无需3D重建的动态视觉导航安全。

TLDR: This paper proposes a teacher-student distillation framework that transfers safety behaviors from a privileged Control Barrier Function teacher to an RGB-only student filter, enabling safe dynamic visual navigation without 3D reconstruction.

Abstract: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.

摘要（中文）：仅使用RGB的端到端视觉导航策略在真实世界动态环境中仍易发生碰撞，因此需要专门的安全层。现有的基于视觉的控制屏障函数（CBF）方法试图从RGB观测中提供安全保障，但往往依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建，且主要针对静态场景设计，限制了其在机载部署中的实用性。我们提出了一种教师-学生视觉蒸馏框架，将特权CBF教师的安全行为迁移至仅使用RGB的学生滤波器中，以适用于动态环境。学生网络直接将短时RGB历史、机器人速度以及标称控制动作映射为安全动作，而教师网络则在真实到仿真的动态高斯泼溅环境中使用地面真值机器人状态和障碍物状态。为缩小教师-学生之间的信息差距，教师仅基于学生RGB历史中可观测到的障碍物构建安全约束，同时考虑障碍物速度的不确定性以增强对运动变化的鲁棒性；此外，动作增强机制使学生网络暴露于多样化的安全与不安全标称动作中，从而更准确地学习安全边界。在部署阶段，学生网络仅需RGB观测和机器人速度，无需显式三维重建或在线渲染。实验结果表明，所提方法优于基于视觉的CBF基线方法，并在动态障碍物运动条件下显著提升了基于RGB的导航策略的安全性。项目主页：https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/。

Authors: Seungyeon Yoo, Gawon Lee, Seungwoo Jung, Inkyu Jang, H. Jin Kim

LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes? Manipulation

mid-task changes robustness benchmark VLA policies world-action models temporal challenge

简要说明：本文提出了LIBERO-MAX基准，包含8000个配对案例，用于评估机器人策略在任务中途变化时的表现，发现当前VLA和世界动作策略的成功率显著下降，并为诊断鲁棒性提供了受控协议。

TLDR: This paper introduces LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark with 8,000 paired cases to evaluate robot policies under mid-task changes, revealing that current VLA and world-action policies significantly degrade in success, providing a controlled protocol for diagnosing robustness.

Abstract: Robots must often continue a task after a target moves, the viewpoint shifts, or an obstacle appears, even though their earlier observations and committed actions reflect the previous scene. Many simulation robustness benchmarks fix external conditions at reset, leaving this temporal challenge underexamined. We introduce LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark of 8,000 paired cases spanning eight types of changes to geometry, observations, appearance, clutter, and paths. Each pair compares task execution with and without a mid-task event, holding the task, initial state, policy seed, and pre-event action sequence fixed. This controlled comparison distinguishes event-associated regressions from failures already present without the change. Across fourteen current VLA, hybrid, and world-action policies, events reduce success by 11.0-25.7 percentage points. Event profiles reveal shared vulnerabilities to geometry and observation changes, while policy-family rankings interleave. Camera controls show that robustness reflects both competence under the changed conditions and the trajectory from which they are encountered; varying query cadence does not eliminate the gap. Together, the paired protocol and temporal diagnostics establish LIBERO-MAX as a reproducible testbed for diagnosing failures under mid-execution changes and measuring progress toward robot policies that remain effective as the world changes.

摘要（中文）：机器人必须在目标移动、视角变化或障碍物出现后继续执行任务，即使其先前的观察和承诺动作反映的是之前的场景。许多仿真鲁棒性基准在重置时固定外部条件，使得这一时间性挑战未被充分研究。我们提出LIBERO-MAX，一个包含8，000个配对案例的基准，涵盖几何、观察、外观、杂乱和路径等八种变化类型。每个配对比较在有和没有任务中途事件的情况下执行任务的表现，同时保持任务、初始状态、策略种子和事件前动作序列固定不变。这种受控比较能够区分与事件相关的性能下降与在无变化情况下已经存在的失败。在十四个当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、混合和世界动作策略中，事件使成功率下降11.0-25.7个百分点。事件特征揭示了在几何和观察变化上的共同弱点，而策略家族的排名相互交错。相机控制表明，鲁棒性既反映了在变化条件下的能力，也反映了遭遇这些变化时所处的轨迹；改变查询节奏并不能消除差距。综上，配对协议和时间诊断使LIBERO-MAX成为一个可复现的测试平台，用于诊断在执行中变化下的失败，并衡量机器人策略在世界变化中保持有效性的进展。

Authors: Yunbei Zhang, Zijian Jin, Yuanzhe Liu, Janet Wang, Xilun Zhang, Yuyou Zhang, Zhenyu Zhang, Daoan Zhang, Shuaicheng Niu, Gen Li, Jianfei Yang, Jihun Hamm, Ismini Lourentzou, Weirui Ye, Bo Liu, Peter Stone, Marco Pavone

ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning WorldModel

latent world models relational geometry Wasserstein embedding matching planning goal-reaching

简要说明：ATLAS 提出了一种训练目标，在潜在世界模型中保留关系几何并校准边际分布，从而提高了模拟环境中的目标达成性能和规划稳定性。

TLDR: ATLAS introduces a training objective that preserves relational geometry in latent world models while calibrating the marginal distribution via Wasserstein embedding matching, improving goal-reaching performance and planning stability in simulated environments.

Abstract: Latent world models rely on representation geometry for planning, yet regularizing the latent marginal alone does not determine the state-to-state relationships used for action selection. We show that this can cause planning-relevant novelty structure to be weakened as representations are transformed into the final latent used by the planner. We introduce Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS), a training objective that explicitly preserves relational geometry while calibrating the global latent distribution. ATLAS transfers normalized pairwise structure from an informative encoder representation to the planning latent and uses Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) to calibrate its marginal through one-dimensional Wasserstein-2 transport. Our analysis shows that relational preservation and marginal calibration impose non-redundant constraints, and connects finite-candidate planning stability to relational distortion, latent-scale mismatch, and prediction error. Instantiated in LeWM, ATLAS improves mean goal-reaching success across PushT, TwoRoom, and OGBench-Cube on both lower- and higher-novelty evaluation subsets, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes. Representation and rollout diagnostics further show stronger novelty-related structure in the planning latent, improved marginal calibration, and lower multi-step prediction error. Together, these results highlight preservation of planning-relevant latent geometry as an important ingredient for reliable world-model planning. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型依赖于表征几何结构进行规划，然而仅对潜在边际进行正则化并不能确定用于动作选择的态间关系。我们表明，这可能导致当表征被转换为规划器所使用的最终潜在表示时，与规划相关的新颖性结构被削弱。我们引入了潜在结构对齐传输（ATLAS），这是一种训练目标，在校准全局潜在分布的同时显式保留关系几何结构。ATLAS将信息丰富的编码器表征中的归一化成对结构迁移至规划潜在表示，并通过一维Wasserstein-2传输使用Wasserstein嵌入匹配（WEMReg）来校准其边际分布。我们的分析表明，关系保留与边际校准施加了非冗余的约束，并将有限候选规划稳定性与关系失真、潜在尺度失配及预测误差联系起来。在LeWM中实例化后，ATLAS在PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube的低新颖性与高新颖性评估子集上均提升了平均目标达成成功率，其中在高新颖性TwoRoom回合中提升最为显著。表征与轨迹展开诊断进一步显示，规划潜在表示中与新颖性相关的结构更强，边际校准更优，且多步预测误差更低。综合来看，这些结果凸显了保留与规划相关的潜在几何结构作为可靠世界模型规划的重要组成要素。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/ 获取。

Authors: Ke Fang, Yupu Yao, Lu Cheng

Bilinear World Models: Learning Representations with Structured Dynamics for Efficient Control WorldModel

world model JEPA bilinear dynamics action recoverability control

简要说明：本文提出了一种具有双线性潜在动力学的JEPA风格世界模型，能够从高维观测中进行高效规划和控制，并通过动作可恢复性防止表示崩溃。

TLDR: This paper introduces a JEPA-style world model with bilinear latent dynamics, enabling efficient planning and control from high-dimensional observations while preventing representation collapse through action recoverability.

Abstract: World models jointly learn latent representations and dynamics that predict how high-dimensional observations evolve under actions. In this work, we propose a JEPA-style world model in which, rather than learning arbitrary latent dynamics, we restrict them to follow a bilinear parameterization. This structure enables efficient planning and control while shifting the modeling burden onto the encoder, encouraging richer representations that expose the controllable geometry of the system. In particular, this structured parameterization allows us to structurally enforce action recoverability, thereby preventing representation collapse by construction. Although prescribing a bilinear parametrization may appear restrictive, we show that a broad class of nonlinear dynamical systems admits a transformation under which the dynamics become bilinear. Empirically, we show across standard 2D and 3D control tasks that representations with bilinear-parameterized dynamics can be learned directly from high-dimensional observations, reducing planning time by nearly three orders of magnitude while retaining or even improving control accuracy. We also propose more demanding regimes of longer-horizon planning and real-time control, and demonstrate that our method succeeds in both, moving JEPA-style world models beyond short-horizon offline planning.

摘要（中文）：世界模型联合学习潜在表示与动力学，以预测高维观测在动作作用下如何演化。在本工作中，我们提出了一种JEPA风格的世界模型，其中我们并不学习任意的潜在动力学，而是将其限制为遵循双线性参数化形式。这一结构使得高效规划与控制成为可能，同时将建模负担转移至编码器，从而促进更丰富的表示，揭示系统的可控几何结构。特别地，这种结构化参数化使我们能够在结构上保证动作的可恢复性，从而在构造上防止表示坍缩。尽管预设双线性参数化看似具有限制性，但我们证明，一大类非线性动力系统均可通过某种变换转化为双线性动力学形式。在实验中，我们展示了在标准二维和三维控制任务中，具有双线性参数化动力学的表示可以直接从高维观测中学习得到，规划时间减少了近三个数量级，同时保持甚至提升了控制精度。我们还提出了更具挑战性的长时域规划与实时控制场景，并证明我们的方法在这两种场景中均取得成功，从而将JEPA风格的世界模型推广至短时域离线规划之外。

Authors: Antonio Pariente, Ignacio Boero, Nikolai Matni, Alejandro Ribeiro

Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction RLRobot

Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization Feedback Correction Robotic Control Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文提出了ACPPO，一种用于强化学习中动作分块的PPO扩展，使用分块actor和标准状态值critic，并提出了ACPPO-Corr，通过逐步反馈校正器实现块内闭环控制。在IsaacGym和Bi-DexHands的25个模拟机器人任务中展示了强劲性能，表明动作分块与闭环校正结合可在在线PPO中有效。

TLDR: This paper introduces ACPPO, a PPO extension for action chunking in reinforcement learning that uses a chunked actor with a standard state-value critic, and ACPPO-Corr which adds a stepwise feedback corrector for closed-loop control within chunks. It demonstrates strong performance across 25 simulated robotic tasks in IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, showing that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when paired with closed-loop correction.

Abstract: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO.

摘要（中文）：动作分块通过在强化学习中选择短动作序列而非单个动作来实现时间抽象，但许多现有方法在高维机器人控制中面临两个局限性。第一，许多方法依赖于基于动作分块的值函数，而随着动作维度和分块长度的增加，这些值函数可能难以学习。第二，开环执行分块会移除分块内的反馈，从而限制了在接触密集任务中的响应能力。我们提出了动作分块PPO（ACPPO），这是一种PPO扩展，采用分块策略网络，同时保留标准的状态值评论家网络，从而避免了分块Q函数。我们进一步提出了ACPPO-Corr，该方法通过逐步骤反馈校正器增强分块规划器，在分块内在线调整规划动作。在来自IsaacGym和Bi-DexHands的25个模拟机器人任务中，涵盖运动、手臂操作和灵巧手-物体交互，ACPPO-Corr在评估方法中取得了最强的综合性能，并在决策频率敏感和决策频率中性任务子集上均表现最佳。消融实验表明，适度的分块长度效果最佳，且校正器正则化对于平衡分块级规划与局部反馈至关重要。这些结果表明，当分块级规划与闭环校正相结合时，动作分块可以在在线PPO中有效发挥作用。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO。

Authors: Sanghyun Hahn, Jonghyun Choi

Design and Validation of an Antagonistic Tendon-Driven Dexterous Robotic Hand with Bidirectional Operation Manipulation

robotic hand antagonistic tendon-driven dual-sided grasping dexterous manipulation GRASP Taxonomy

简要说明：本文提出了一种具有双向拮抗肌腱机构的17自由度拟人机器人手，实现手掌侧和手背侧抓取，并通过包括33种GRASP抓取类型在内的实验验证了其性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a 17-DoF anthropomorphic robotic hand with a bidirectional antagonistic tendon mechanism, enabling palmar and dorsal grasping, and validates it through extensive experiments including all 33 GRASP Taxonomy grasps.

Abstract: Dexterous robotic hands typically reproduce human hand morphology but inherit its one-sided grasping workspace, requiring wrist or arm reorientation to grasp from the opposite side. Existing reversible hands generally rely on non-anthropomorphic, soft, or task-specific finger arrangements, whereas conventional five-digit anthropomorphic hands remain designed primarily for palmar-side grasping. This paper presents an anthropomorphic, human-scale (200 mm length), lightweight (220 g), 3D-printed, 17-DoF robotic hand built on a bidirectional antagonistic tendon-routing mechanism, in which flexion/extension (except the coupled joint) and abduction/adduction at joints are actively driven without passive return springs. The proposed routing mechanism allows all degrees of freedom to cross their neutral configuration and form grasp closures on either the palmar or dorsal side. Experimental evaluation demonstrates an average motor-to-joint transmission error of 3.0%, an average joint transmission bandwidth of 13.2 Hz, a maximum fingertip force of 29 N, and a positioning repeatability up to 0.15 mm. The hand further achieves a Kapandji score of 8, successfully performs all 33 GRASP Taxonomy grasp types, and performs palmar- and dorsal-side grasping tasks, validating bidirectional operation in a compact, human-scale platform.

摘要（中文）：灵巧机器人手通常复制人类手部形态，但继承了其单侧抓取工作空间，需要腕部或手臂重新定向才能从对侧抓取。现有可翻转手通常依赖非拟人化、软体或任务特定的手指布置，而传统五指拟人化手仍主要设计用于掌侧抓取。本文提出了一种拟人化、人体尺度（200毫米长）、轻量化（220克）、3D打印的17自由度机器人手，其基于双向拮抗肌腱布线机制，关节处的屈曲/伸展（除耦合关节外）和内收/外展均由主动驱动，无需被动复位弹簧。所提出的布线机制允许所有自由度跨越其中立构型，并在掌侧或背侧形成抓取闭合。实验评估表明，平均电机到关节的传动误差为3.0%，平均关节传动带宽为13.2 Hz，最大指尖力为29 N，定位重复精度可达0.15毫米。该手进一步实现了Kapandji评分为8，成功执行了全部33种GRASP分类抓取类型，并完成掌侧和背侧抓取任务，验证了其在紧凑、人体尺度平台上的双向操作能力。

Authors: Chunghyeon Lee, Hyukjun Kwon, Sungeon Kim, Saehyun Moon, Seokhwan Jeong

AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search Other

aerial object-goal search benchmark suite multimodal large language models embodied agents 3D environments

简要说明：AerialDojo-200K 是一个用于开放世界空中目标搜索的大规模基准套件，提供 205,732 个任务实例和统一的评估框架，并显示当前多模态大模型尚缺乏通用空中智能体的能力。

TLDR: AerialDojo-200K is a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, providing 205,732 task instances across diverse 3D scenes and a unified evaluation framework, and showing that current multimodal LLMs still lack general-purpose aerial agent capabilities.

Abstract: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. Specifically, we construct 42 simulation scenes spanning four scene families and 21 scene types, including 18 urban, 12 natural, six infrastructure, and six disaster scenes. To ensure data quality, 12 annotators spent two months manually annotating 109 landmarks, 2099 target objects, and 2099 object anchors across these scenes. We further construct 205,732 task instances, comprising over 100K semantic-goal and over 100K image-goal instances across Base, Standard, and Long-Horizon settings. Each task instance includes a collision-free reference trajectory and corresponding multi-view video recordings. We also develop a unified evaluation framework with a scene partition comprising 21 in-distribution scenes and 21 out-of-distribution scenes. Finally, our evaluation of five open-source and four closed-source multimodal large language models reveals that there is still a long way to go toward achieving general-purpose aerial agents. All can be found at https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/.

摘要（中文）：开放世界空中物体-目标搜索是一项基础但具有挑战性的任务，要求空中智能体自主探索大规模、非结构化的三维环境，并根据语义描述或参考图像到达目标物体，而非遵循与路线相关的指令。然而，该任务的研究仍处于起步阶段，且依赖规模较小、环境特定的基准，其动作空间和数据格式异构。这些局限性阻碍了大规模训练和跨基准评估，制约了空中智能体的可扩展性和泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AerialDojo-200K，一个面向开放世界空中物体-目标搜索的大规模基准套件，其场景数量是现有最大基准的3倍，任务实例数量是其18.7倍。具体而言，我们构建了42个仿真场景，涵盖四个场景族和21种场景类型，包括18个城市场景、12个自然场景、6个基础设施场景和6个灾害场景。为确保数据质量，12名标注人员花费两个月时间，在这些场景中人工标注了109个地标、2099个目标物体和2099个物体锚点。我们进一步构建了205，732个任务实例，包括超过10万个语义目标实例和超过10万个图像目标实例，涵盖基础（Base）、标准（Standard）和长时程（Long-Horizon）三种设置。每个任务实例包含一条无碰撞参考轨迹及相应的多视角视频记录。我们还开发了一个统一的评估框架，场景划分为21个分布内场景和21个分布外场景。最后，我们对五个开源和四个闭源多模态大语言模型的评估表明，实现通用空中智能体仍有很长的路要走。所有资源可在 https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/ 获取。

Authors: Tongtong Feng, Xin Wang, Haoran Hou, Ren Wang, Weiran Wang, Shaokai Zhu, Ziqi Jia, Hao Wang, Yu-Wei Zhan, Zongyuan Wu, Jinghao Cui, Wenwu Zhu

CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes Manipulation

simulation-ready reconstruction deformable objects agentic framework robot interactions behavioral testing

简要说明：CoDimRecon 是一个智能体框架，可从多视角 RGB 图像重建包含刚体、铰接体和可变形体的仿真就绪 3D 场景，利用类别智能体会话生成曲线/曲面/体积表示，并通过基于模拟器的行为测试细化物理模型。它在杆、壳和实体模拟资产上展示了机器人交互，包括塑料弯曲的折纸案例。

TLDR: CoDimRecon is an agentic framework that reconstructs simulation-ready 3D scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB images, leveraging category-wise agent sessions for deformable curve/surface/volume representation and simulator-based behavioral tests to refine physics models. It demonstrates robot interactions across rod, shell, and solid simulation assets, including a paper-folding case with plastic bending.

Abstract: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.

摘要（中文）：从真实世界观测中重建可直接用于仿真的3D场景，为机器人技术、游戏和沉浸式应用提供了支撑，然而现有方法大多假设物体为刚体。这为可变形物体留下了重要空白，因为其可仿真几何取决于维度（曲线、曲面或体积），且其行为可能需要对弹性模型之外的物理模型进行建模。我们提出CoDimRecon，一个代理式框架，可从多视角RGB观测中重建包含刚体、铰接物体和可变形物体的可编辑场景。场景级几何先验为尺度和布局提供基准，而物体级生成网格引导代理获得细节丰富且紧凑的几何结构；铰接刚体被分解为带显式关节的可运动部件。对于可变形物体，按类别划分的代理会话将曲线重建为中心线加半径，将曲面重建为带厚度的流形壳，将体积重建为用于体网格划分的水密实体。可复用的仿真器技能可初始化兼容的物理模型和参数，而代理引导的行为测试可暴露不匹配问题，并触发对运动、几何、数值或材料建模的定向修订。在评估的Replica和ScanNet++场景中，CoDimRecon在实现有竞争力的组合重建精度的同时，还额外生成了用于杆、壳和实体仿真的可变形资产。我们进一步展示了在全部三种表示上的机器人交互，包括一个受控折纸案例，其中行为测试促使了塑性弯曲的实现。

Authors: Shuzhao Xie, Lelin Wang, Guying Lin, Zhi Wang, Minchen Li

Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning WorldModel

dual-latent world model long-horizon planning action-conditioned transitions macro-actions goal-conditioned visual control

简要说明：本文提出双潜在世界模型（Dual-WM），通过分离局部执行与长期规划的状态表示和动力学模型，提升长时域目标条件视觉控制的性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes Dual-WM, a dual-latent world model that separates local execution and long-range planning via distinct state representations and dynamics models, improving long-horizon goal-conditioned visual control.

Abstract: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型尽管在短期预测上表现准确，但在长期规划方面往往面临困难。递归式展开会导致误差累积，而高维潜在空间中的距离集中现象也可能削弱目标区分能力。为此，我们提出了一种双潜在世界模型（Dual-WM），通过不同的状态表示和动力学模型，将局部执行与长程规划分离。低层模型预测动作条件下的状态转移，而高层模型利用学习到的宏动作在更长时间跨度上进行规划。我们还提出了一种基于加权展开的长期表征学习方法（LoRe），在两个层次上对自生成预测进行监督。对递归误差传播的分析促使我们采用指数级时间跨度权重，并为两个时间尺度设置不同的衰减率。在规划过程中，高层模型生成潜在子目标，低层模型将其细化为精确执行所需的动作。我们在五个目标条件化视觉控制任务上，从零开始对Dual-WM进行评估，并与各任务中最强的基线方法（不含演员引导提议）进行比较。在目标偏移量为50和100个环境步时，平均成功率分别从75.9%提升至84.4%，以及从61.4%提升至69.5%。在偏移量为100时，Dual-WM在所有五个任务上均优于这些基线，并相较于LeWM将平均成功率提高了30.8个百分点。消融实验及辅助分析进一步证明，该方法能够为目标评估提供更具信息量的表征，并在递归预测下保持更高的一致性。这些结果凸显了在潜在规划中将时间角色分离并进行多时间跨度训练的重要性。我们的核心实现可在 https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official 获取。

Authors: Delin Zhao, Zhengrong Yue, Shaobin Zhuang, Junlin He, Xiaoyu Chen, Zikang Wang, Yuxin Liu, Limin Wang, Yali Wang

Abductive World Modeling via Causal Representation Learning WorldModel

Abductive World Modeling causal representation learning latent-space world model structured state representation state pyramid

简要说明：本文提出了溯因世界建模（AWM）框架，通过从预测的未来中溯因推断潜在原因，学习结构化因果表示，并在物理预测、因果推理和动作理解任务上相较V-JEPA取得了提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations for world modeling by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures, and demonstrates improvements over V-JEPA on physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding tasks.

Abstract: The central challenge of world modeling is to learn representations that capture how the world evolves. However, existing world models predominantly represent future states without explicitly capturing the latent causes underlying their evolution, limiting their ability to reason about why and how the world changes. To address this limitation, we propose Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures. Specifically, we realize AWM through the Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP), which organizes the inferred world state into three complementary components - Entity, Dynamic, and Relation - capturing what exists, how it changes, and how entities interact, respectively. By jointly reasoning over the current observation and its predicted future, HASP abductively infers these latent factors and integrates them into a structured state representation for downstream reasoning. To the best of our knowledge, AWM is the first framework to introduce abductive state inference into latent-space world modeling for learning structured representations of world dynamics. Experiments across physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with V-JEPA, a state-of-the-art latent-space world model, AWM improves physical prediction AUROC by 10.7%, causal reasoning accuracy by 16.8%, and action Top-1 accuracy by 68.0%.

摘要（中文）：世界建模的核心挑战在于学习能够捕捉世界演变过程的表征。然而，现有的世界模型主要表征未来状态，并未显式地捕捉驱动其演变的潜在原因，从而限制了模型对世界变化原因和方式的推理能力。为应对这一局限，我们提出溯因世界建模（AWM），这是一个通过从预测的未来中溯因推断潜在原因来学习结构化因果表征的框架。具体而言，我们通过层级溯因状态金字塔（HASP）实现AWM，该金字塔将推断所得的世界状态组织为三个互补的组成部分——实体、动态和关系——分别捕捉存在什么、如何变化以及实体之间如何交互。通过联合推理当前观测及其预测未来，HASP溯因推断这些潜在因素，并将其整合为结构化的状态表征，用于下游推理。据我们所知，AWM是首个将溯因状态推断引入潜空间世界建模以学习世界动态结构化表征的框架。在物理预测、因果推理和行为理解方面的实验验证了我们方法的有效性。与当前最先进的潜空间世界模型V-JEPA相比，AWM在物理预测AUROC上提升了10.7%，因果推理准确率提升了16.8%，行为Top-1准确率提升了68.0%。

Authors: Ziqi Liu, Songhan Yang, Linfan Zhou, Jiatong Liu, Lijun Peng, Long Wan, Yinqi Bai

The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface VLA

Vision-Language-Action latent interface layer selection InfoNCE manipulation

简要说明：该论文研究了视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型中潜在接口层的选择问题，发现单层选择通常优于多层融合，并提出基于InfoNCE的代理指标来以更少计算量选择层。

TLDR: The paper studies how to select the latent interface layers in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, finding that single-layer selection often outperforms multi-layer fusion and proposing an Information-Noise-Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) based proxy to select layers with much less compute.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过潜在接口将预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络与动作头连接起来，但该接口应暴露哪些骨干网络层仍不明确。我们针对三个预训练模型和两个操作基准（LIBERO和CALVIN），在每种配置下使用三个策略训练种子，研究了冻结骨干网络的单层选择与多层融合。在三种融合机制和三种层子集策略下，54种配置中有47种表现逊于观察到的最优单层策略。我们的统计分析进一步证实，融合的优势非常有限。然而，最佳层在不同骨干网络和基准之间差异显著，这使得层选择至关重要，而穷举式策略扫描成本高昂。我们进一步推导了所提出的针对动作条件InfoNCE和动作预测的信息瓶颈目标之间的重加权等价性，从而将InfoNCE作为层质量的代理指标。在评估的四种代理指标中，经验结果表明InfoNCE与策略成功率的一致性正相关最为稳定。选择InfoNCE得分最高的层所需的GPU计算量比穷举式策略扫描少9至33倍，并将六个设置中的平均选择遗憾从最深层选择的17.89个百分点降低至3.71个百分点。其平均遗憾接近利用全部六个真实扫描事后优化的固定层启发式方法所达到的3.28至3.50个百分点，且在选择过程中无需闭环评估。

Authors: Yuxiang Liu, Lizhi Yang, Fengze Xie, Aaron Ames, Yisong Yue

Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding Other

spatial intelligence visual question answering data synthesis multi-agent coding sim-to-real

简要说明：Exemplar2VQA 提出了一种通过多智能体编码在模拟环境中生成大规模3D空间问答数据集的框架，利用确定性几何工具克服LLM空间推理缺陷，并在多个基准上提升了MLLM的性能。

TLDR: Exemplar2VQA introduces a multi-agent coding framework that generates large-scale 3D spatial question-answer datasets in simulated environments, using deterministic geometric utilities to overcome LLM spatial reasoning limitations, and demonstrates improved MLLM performance on various benchmarks.

Abstract: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

摘要（中文）：推进多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的空间智能发展，受限于复杂、可扩展的三维问答（QA）数据的稀缺。尽管人工标注劳动密集，直接利用LLMs合成这些QA对往往因其在空间与几何计算方面的固有缺陷而失败。我们提出Exemplar2VQA，一种可扩展的基于范例驱动的视觉问答生成框架，通过多智能体编码在模拟环境中快速合成大规模空间QA对。通过为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，Exemplar2VQA通过确定性代码执行绕过了LLMs的空间推理缺陷。至关重要的是，该框架展现出卓越的通用性：以多样化的静态对象中心空间查询模板作为范例，它能无缝且自主地将它们扩展为大规模、高保真的合成数据集。仅使用Exemplar2VQA生成的合成室内数据对Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B）进行微调，即可在多个多样化基准测试中带来显著的性能提升。此外，其有效性不仅局限于室内领域数据集，还能稳健地扩展到室外及混合场景基准测试。这些结果确立了Exemplar2VQA作为一种可扩展且强大的范式，用于弥合具身AI中的仿真到现实鸿沟。我们的代码位于https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

Authors: Jiayu Ying, Qijian Tian, Ruijie Xu, Xinnan Zhu, Daoguo Dong, Jiachen Xu, Xin Tan

Multi-Granularity Language-Guided Imitation Learning via Instruction Decomposition Manipulation

imitation learning language instructions instruction decomposition multi-task learning manipulation

简要说明：该论文提出了一种多粒度语言引导的模仿学习方法，通过将任务级指令分解为子任务级指令，以提高多任务操作策略的学习效率和性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a multi-granularity language-guided imitation learning method that decomposes task-level instructions into subtask-level instructions to improve multi-task policy learning for manipulation.

Abstract: Using language instructions as conditions to guide robot policy learning has recently become an important research domain. However, existing language-guided policy learning methods typically use an overall task description to guide the entire demonstration trajectory. For manipulation tasks involving multiple execution stages, these methods assign the same language description to different subtasks, making it difficult to distinguish the behaviors required at different stages. In this work, we propose a multi-granularity language guidance method based on instruction decomposition. The proposed method decomposes an overall task description into more fine-grained, concrete subtask-level language instructions, thereby enhancing learning efficiency and improving performance. We evaluate the proposed method in the setting of multi-task imitation learning and validate its effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：以语言指令作为条件来引导机器人策略学习，近年来已成为一个重要的研究领域。然而，现有的语言引导策略学习方法通常使用整体任务描述来引导整个示范轨迹。对于涉及多个执行阶段的操作任务，这些方法将相同的语言描述分配给不同的子任务，难以区分不同阶段所需的行为。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于指令分解的多粒度语言引导方法。该方法将整体任务描述分解为更细粒度、更具体的子任务级语言指令，从而提升学习效率并改善性能。我们在多任务模仿学习场景下对所提方法进行了评估，并验证了其有效性。

Authors: Yi-Pei Chiu, Wei-Ta Chu

World2Motion: Turning Video World Models into 3D Human Motion Generators WorldModel

video world model 3D human motion generation motion-text alignment scene interaction noise schedule

简要说明：World2Motion 将视频世界模型转化为单阶段 3D 人体动作生成器，从单张图像和文本提示生成场景感知的动作和视频，推理速度比两阶段基线快约 3.3 倍。

TLDR: World2Motion turns a video world model into a single-stage 3D human motion generator, producing scene-aware motion and video from a single image and text prompt with faster inference than two-stage baselines.

Abstract: We present World2Motion, a framework that generates scene-aware 3D human motion and corresponding video from a single image and a text prompt. While existing 3D motion generators learn from motion datasets, their generalization is constrained by limited coverage of environments. In contrast, video world models such as Cosmos 3 offer broader environmental priors but are not designed for full-body motion generation; recovering motion from their generated videos requires costly two-stage inference. To address these, we turn Cosmos 3 into a single-stage 3D motion generator. This adaptation has two challenges: the scarcity of paired video--motion data and temporal instability in the generated motion. First, we construct a training dataset combining synthetic video--motion pairs with real videos paired with estimated 3D motion. Second, we propose a shift-decoupled noise schedule that assigns different noise levels to video and motion through shared denoising progress. This design accommodates the different denoising requirements of the two modalities, reducing motion jitter. Experiments on a multi-source interaction benchmark show that World2Motion has better motion--text alignment and scene interaction compared with the evaluated 3D motion generators. It also matches the interaction success rate of the two-stage baseline while achieving approximately 3.3$\times$ faster inference. Our project page is available at https://fyantu.github.io/World2Motion/.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了World2Motion，一个从单张图像和文本提示生成场景感知的三维人体运动及对应视频的框架。现有三维运动生成器从运动数据集中学习，但其泛化能力受限于环境覆盖范围不足。相比之下，视频世界模型（如Cosmos 3）提供了更广泛的环境先验，但并非为全身运动生成而设计；从生成视频中恢复运动需要昂贵的两阶段推理流程。为解决上述问题，我们将Cosmos 3转化为单阶段三维运动生成器。这一改造面临两个挑战：视频-运动配对数据的稀缺以及生成运动的时间不稳定。首先，我们构建了一个训练数据集，将合成的视频-运动配对与配对估计三维运动的真实视频相结合。其次，我们提出了一种位移解耦噪声调度方法，通过共享去噪进程为视频和运动分配不同的噪声水平。该设计适应了两种模态不同的去噪需求，减少了运动抖动。在多源交互基准上的实验表明，与所评估的三维运动生成器相比，World2Motion在运动-文本对齐和场景交互方面表现更优。同时，其交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，而推理速度提升约3.3倍。我们的项目页面可在https://fyantu.github.io/World2Motion/获取。

Authors: Fangyuan Tu, Xiangyue Zhang, Yiyi Cai, Yichen Peng, Kunhang Li, Bo Zheng, Zhixiang Wang, Kaipeng Zhang, Erwin Wu, Haoran Xie, Haiyang Liu

S4VY: Segment Anything in Feed-Forward 4D Visual Geometry Perception3D

4D instance segmentation class-agnostic masks feed-forward visual geometry natural-language grounding Segment Anything

简要说明：S4VY 是一种基于前馈 4D 视觉几何的 SAM 模型，支持无提示以及点/框/语言条件化的时空实例分割，面向机器人和自动驾驶应用。

TLDR: S4VY is a Segment Anything model for feed-forward 4D scene understanding, enabling prompt-independent and point/box/language-conditioned instance segmentation across space-time, targeting robotics and autonomous driving applications.

Abstract: Accurate instance segmentation in dynamic scenes is important for downstream applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Existing Segment Anything models operate primarily on 2D image or video masks and preserve identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation built upon feed-forward visual geometry remains underexplored. We introduce S4VY, a Segment Anything model built on feed-forward 4D visual geometry. From a set of RGB observations, S4VY transforms shared visual-geometric features into an exhaustive set of class-agnostic 4D instance masks through a space-time query decoder, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations. This representation supports prompt-independent segmentation as well as point- and box- conditioned selection, without requiring a seed mask or temporal ordering. We further develop an agentic harness for natural-language grounding in the large observation space of a 4D scene. Active tree search identifies relevant frames without scanning every fixed window; a dual-stream grounder combines fine-grained VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features through complementary bounding-box prediction and object-query matching; and an independent critic selects the final 4D instance mask from their predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under a unified evaluation spanning static and dynamic scenes.

摘要（中文）：动态场景中的精确实例分割对于机器人和自动驾驶等下游应用至关重要。现有的Segment Anything模型主要基于2D图像或视频掩码进行操作，并通过顺序记忆保持身份信息，而基于前馈视觉几何构建的可提示4D实例分割仍待深入探索。我们提出了S4VY，一种建立在前馈4D视觉几何基础上的Segment Anything模型。从一组RGB观测中，S4VY通过时空查询解码器将共享的视觉几何特征转换为一组全面的、与类别无关的4D实例掩码，其中每个持久对象查询在所有观测中绑定一个实体。这种表示支持无提示的分割以及基于点和框条件的选择，无需种子掩码或时间排序。我们还开发了一个智能代理框架，用于在4D场景的大观测空间中进行自然语言接地。主动树搜索无需扫描每个固定窗口即可识别相关帧；双流接地器通过互补的边界框预测和对象查询匹配，将细粒度的VLM视觉先验与几何一致的实例特征相结合；独立的评审器从这些预测中选择最终的4D实例掩码。大量实验表明，在涵盖静态和动态场景的统一评估下，该方法在4D实例分割和语言引导接地性能方面均达到了最先进水平。

Authors: Jingdong Zhang, Xin Li, Jan Kautz, Wenping Wang, Chris Choy

MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model WorldModel

video world model weather control camera trajectory mixture of experts dataset

简要说明：MeteoVerse 是一个统一的天气可控视频世界模型，从单张图像生成未来视频，显式建模天气转换（保持、引入或去除），并支持细粒度强度控制及一个新的 50K 片段数据集。

TLDR: MeteoVerse is a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single image, explicitly modeling weather transitions for preservation, introduction, or removal, with fine-grained intensity control and a new 50K-clip dataset.

Abstract: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型旨在根据观察到的场景，在遵循指定相机运动的同时预测未来内容。真实世界的场景演变不仅取决于视点变化和物体动态，还取决于天气等环境条件，这些条件可能显著改变场景外观和可见性。对此类真实天气演变进行建模颇具挑战性，因为所需的天气修改同时依赖于观察到的天气状态和期望的天气状态。根据它们之间的关系，模型可能需要保留、引入或移除某种天气效果。现有视频世界模型通常隐式处理这种天气转换，迫使生成主干网络将天气演变与场景动态和相机运动一同推断，从而导致天气控制不够精确。为解决这一局限，我们提出了MeteoVerse，一个统一的天气可控视频世界模型，可从单张晴天或恶劣天气图像生成未来视频，并以无天气场景描述、目标天气指令和相机轨迹为条件。MeteoVerse不仅以期望天气为条件，还显式估计观察到的天气状态和目标天气状态，并表征所需的天气转换。随后，一个转换感知的天气专家混合模块将该转换转化为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一了天气的保留、引入和移除，同时实现对引入天气强度的细粒度控制。我们进一步构建了MeteoVerse数据集，包含超过5万段真实天气视频片段、生成的晴天对应片段、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注以及相机轨迹。大量实验表明，该方法在保持具有竞争力的场景一致性和相机控制性能的同时，显著提升了天气可控性。

Authors: Renlong Wu, Guanqiao Wang, Xuan Shang, Yin Hanming, Xiaoxiao Sheng, Tianyu Huang, Hui Li, Wangmeng Zuo

Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models WorldModel

video world models physical prediction event-anchored evaluation free-fall trajectory prediction

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于事件锚定的视频世界模型评估协议，测试模型从真实世界记录中预测物理后果（如自由落体）的能力，发现现有模型常常无法启动或准确实现后果。

TLDR: This paper introduces an event-anchored evaluation protocol for video world models, testing their ability to predict physical consequences (e.g., free-fall) from real-world recordings, and finds that current models often fail to initiate or accurately realize consequences.

Abstract: Video world models are largely regarded as predictive models of the physical world and are therefore expected to anticipate the consequences of observed events. However, evaluation has mainly focused on reference similarity, physical-law consistency, or judgment plausibility, estimating anticipation only indirectly. We address this directly: when a release or impact has just occurred but its consequence is withheld, can a world model anticipate what should happen next? We introduce an event-anchored evaluation based on 62 controlled real-world free-fall recordings and 124 clips spanning three object types, with fine-grained release and impact annotations and ground-truth trajectories. The protocol separates consequence production, temporal placement, and physical realization. Across six contemporary video generation and world models, Runway and Veo produce release and subsequent impact events at rates above 93% but often initiate them substantially late, whereas Cosmos-Predict-2.5 and MAGI-1 frequently preserve the pre-event state and produce little or no measurable consequence. Among measurable falls, plausible timing does not necessarily imply physically consistent motion. We further conduct a 15-participant, 20-condition human study in which participants describe the expected consequence from a single event-anchored frame and draw its trajectory. Human predictions favor the recorded future in aggregate while revealing genuine ambiguity among plausible continuations. Overall, physical foresight emerges as a sequence of distinct challenges: initiating a consequence, anchoring it in time, and realizing its motion.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型在很大程度上被视为物理世界的预测模型，因此预期它们能够预判所观察事件的结果。然而，现有评估主要侧重于参考相似性、物理定律一致性或判断合理性，对预判能力的估计仅是间接的。我们直接针对这一问题展开研究：当一次释放或撞击事件刚刚发生但其后果被隐匿时，世界模型能否预判接下来应当发生什么？我们引入了一种基于事件的评估方法，采用62段受控的真实世界自由落体录像及124段涵盖三种物体类型的视频片段，并配有细粒度的释放与撞击标注及地面真实轨迹。该评估方案将后果生成、时间定位与物理实现三者分离。在六种当代视频生成模型与世界模型中，Runway和Veo生成释放及后续撞击事件的比率超过93%，但往往显著延迟启动这些事件；而Cosmos-Predict-2.5和MAGI-1则频繁保留事件前状态，产生的可测后果极少甚至为零。在可测的坠落事件中，看似合理的时间节点并不必然意味着物理上一致的运动。我们进一步开展了一项包含15名受试者、20种条件的人类研究，参与者需根据单张事件锚定帧描述预期后果并绘制其轨迹。人类预测在总体上倾向于已记录的未来，同时也揭示了合理延续之间真实存在的不确定性。总体而言，物理前瞻能力表现为一系列截然不同的挑战：启动后果、在时间上锚定后果，以及实现其运动。

Authors: Estela Monserrat Arriaga Santana, Julian Rosas Scull, Ehécatl Sacamch'en Núñez Rico, Hugo Jair Escalante

RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model WorldModel

interpretability world models activation patching persistent effects fitted editors

简要说明：本文提出 RolloutFaith 框架，用于审计视觉世界模型中持续的内部干预，发现拟合编辑器长期效果有限，而参考干预（激活修补）提供更持续的改进，并提出 Delayed LoReFT 通过未来过渡优化以改善持久干预效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces RolloutFaith, a framework for auditing persistent internal interventions in visual world models, showing that fitted editors yield limited long-term effects while reference intervention (activation patching) offers more sustained gains, and proposing Delayed LoReFT to improve lasting intervention by optimizing through future transitions.

Abstract: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.

摘要（中文）：可解释性方法（如探针、激活补丁和学习型编辑器）旨在揭示或修改模型当前的运算过程。世界模型则提出了更高的要求：由于其预测结果会成为后续预测的输入，因此有效的内部修正必须在编辑停止后仍然持续生效。为此，我们提出了RolloutFaith框架，该框架在固定事件、动作、噪声和信息预算条件下，同时衡量干预时刻所产生预测的语义改进，以及其后自主预测中的语义改进。我们分别在Crafter、Cartpole和CoinRun上，对三个世界模型中的十个拟合编辑器进行了评估。我们还使用了参考激活补丁（Reference Activation Patching），即用从真实观测中计算得到的配对激活替换模型激活，以衡量所选接口上可用的修正效果。该参考干预在所有九种模型与任务组合中均改进后续预测，并在其中八种组合中优于最佳拟合编辑器；然而，在九种组合中的五种里，其持续增益随预测视界延长而下降。当前拟合编辑器仅能获得有限且不一致的长期效果。通过将各个状态分量恢复到其未受干扰的值，我们发现持久效果在DIAMOND中经由最新生成的帧传播，在DreamerV3中经由循环记忆传播，而在STORM中则经由两者共同传播。这些发现表明，训练应奖励未来后果。为验证这一假设，我们提出了延迟LoReFT（Delayed LoReFT），该方法通过四个冻结的未来转移对相同的低秩干预进行优化，并一定程度上提升了干预的持续效果。

Authors: Junchi Yao, Ziyi Wang, Youling Huang, Lijie Hu

Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance Other

flow matching multi-agent generation decoupled generative guidance multi-robot collaboration affordance requirements

简要说明：该论文提出了DeGG-Flow，一种具有解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配框架，可生成满足硬约束的对象，并在多机器人协作和多对象场景生成中进行了验证。

TLDR: The paper introduces DeGG-Flow, a multi-agent flow matching framework with decoupled generative guidance that generates objects satisfying hard constraints, demonstrated on multi-robot collaboration and multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements.

Abstract: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbors. For both classes, we establish feasibility conditions and finite-horizon convergence guarantees. We further derive a Wasserstein bound that characterizes the distributional deviation induced by the guidance. We demonstrate DeGG-Flow on multi-robot collaboration for crossing a spatial gap by reconfiguring the environment, and on multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements. Across both applications, DeGG-Flow directly generates objects that satisfy all corresponding hard requirements, including at team sizes unseen during training.

摘要（中文）：生成式建模被广泛用于从复杂的多模态分布中生成多样化对象。然而，其表达能力通常并不伴随正式保证，即生成对象满足硬约束或要求。在多智能体生成中，这一问题变得更加具有挑战性，因为硬性要求可能依赖于多个智能体，而每个智能体可能需要在不依赖其他智能体同时计算的引导输入的情况下，自行确定其引导输入。为此，我们提出了DeGG-Flow，一个用于多智能体流匹配的解耦生成引导通用框架。通过将生成过程表示为控制仿射动力学系统，我们针对两类耦合要求开发了引导条件：共享要求，其满足依赖于多个智能体共同作用；以及私有要求，与每个个体智能体相关，并依赖于其邻居。对于这两类要求，我们建立了可行性条件和有限时域收敛保证。我们进一步推导了一个Wasserstein界，用以刻画由引导引起的分布偏差。我们在多机器人协作跨越空间间隙并通过重构环境实现任务，以及带有可供性要求的多对象场景生成中，展示了DeGG-Flow的有效性。在这两个应用中，DeGG-Flow直接生成满足所有相应硬性要求的对象，即使在训练中未见过的团队规模下也是如此。
