Authors: Ruoyu Lin, Magnus Egerstedt, Fabio Pasqualetti

Semantic Map Sharing and Capability-Aware Coverage Planning for AI-Native 6G Robotic Coordination Other

Semantic grid maps coverage planning traversability reasoning multi-robot coordination goal-oriented communication

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向搜救任务的异构空地机器人边缘中心语义感知覆盖规划框架，通过将航空观测转换为紧凑的语义地图，实现机器人专属可通过性推理和能力感知路径规划，并利用语义修正将通信负载降低约82倍，在基准测试中实现91.5%的覆盖率且无不合理分配。

TLDR: This paper presents an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework for heterogeneous aerial-ground robot teams in search and rescue, which converts aerial observations into compact semantic maps for robot-specific traversability reasoning and capability-aware path planning. It drastically reduces communication payload via semantic corrections and achieves 91.5% coverage with no infeasible allocations in benchmarks.

Abstract: Search and Rescue (SAR) operations increasingly deploy heterogeneous teams of aerial and ground robots. However, conventional coverage methods typically do not translate perceived terrain into platform-specific reachability, while continuous image exchange imposes a high communication cost. We propose an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework that integrates aerial terrain perception, robot-specific traversability reasoning, and payload-efficient semantic state sharing. Aerial observations are converted into compact semantic grid maps, enabling reachability-constrained area decomposition and capability-aware coverage paths that assign only regions admitted by each robot's capability profile. The resulting perception-sharing-planning loop feeds semantic corrections into traversability reasoning and replanning, forming an application-level mechanism motivated by AI-enabled goal-oriented communication envisioned for AI-native 6G networks. For the high-update case, transmitting semantic corrections reduces the application payload by a factor of approximately $82$ relative to periodic full-map sharing. Across matched benchmark scenarios, the proposed method achieved $91.5\%$ coverage with no capability-infeasible allocations, compared with $78.8\%$ coverage and a $21.5\%$ capability-infeasible allocation rate for LS-MCPP. Semantic corrections update the shared planning state without requiring repeated transmission of the complete map.

摘要（中文）：搜救（SAR）任务日益采用由空中和地面机器人组成的异构团队。然而，传统覆盖方法通常不会将感知到的地形转化为特定平台的可达性，而连续图像交换则会带来较高的通信成本。我们提出了一种以边缘为中心、语义感知的覆盖规划框架，该框架整合了空中地形感知、机器人特定可通过性推理以及负载高效的语义状态共享。空中观测被转换为紧凑的语义栅格地图，从而支持受可达性约束的区域分解和具备能力感知的覆盖路径规划，仅分配各机器人能力档案所允许的区域。由此形成的感知-共享-规划闭环将语义修正反馈至可通过性推理与重规划中，构建了一种应用级机制，其动机源自面向人工智能原生6G网络所设想的、由AI驱动的目标导向通信。在高更新频率场景下，相较于周期性全地图共享，传输语义修正可使应用负载减少约82倍。在匹配的基准测试场景中，所提方法实现了91.5%的覆盖率且无能力不可行分配，而LS-MCPP的覆盖率为78.8%，且能力不可行分配率为21.5%。语义修正仅更新共享规划状态，无需重复传输完整地图。

Cascaded consensus splitting for multi-branch contingency games AutonomousDriving

multi-branch contingency games asynchronous intent revelation ADMM-based solver scenario-level parallelism receding-horizon planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种具有异步分支时间的多分支应急博弈架构，并开发了基于ADMM的求解器。在紧密耦合的三智能体交互实验中，该方法相比单分支方法性能更优且求解时间更短。

TLDR: This paper introduces a multi-branch contingency game architecture with asynchronous branching times for intent uncertainty, along with an ADMM-based solver. Experiments on tightly coupled three-agent interactions show improved performance and lower solve time compared to single-branch approaches.

Abstract: Contingency games enable agents to anticipate and plan for other agents' hypothetical intents by constructing trajectories with a shared prefix and intent-dependent branches. While contingency games capture intent uncertainty, existing formulations rely on a single branching time, oversimplifying interactions in which different agents' intentions are revealed at different times. Moreover, the computational cost of such problems grows rapidly with the number of agents and intents, as all scenario-dependent best responses must be solved jointly. We introduce a multi-branch contingency architecture in which sources of intent uncertainty can be resolved progressively at different branching times, allowing the planned trajectories to adapt to the asynchronous revelation of intents. We also develop an ADMM-based solver that exploits scenario-level parallelism. Experiments on tightly coupled three-agent interactions support that the proposed architecture outperforms the conventional single-branch while achieving a lower mean receding-horizon solve time.

摘要（中文）：偶然性博弈使智能体能够通过构建具有共享前缀和意图依赖分支的轨迹，来预测并规划其他智能体的假设性意图。尽管偶然性博弈能够捕捉意图不确定性，但现有公式依赖于单一分支时间，这过度简化了不同智能体意图在不同时间点被揭示的交互过程。此外，此类问题的计算成本会随着智能体和意图数量的增加而迅速增长，因为所有依赖于场景的最优响应必须联合求解。我们引入了一种多分支偶然性架构，其中意图不确定性的来源可以在不同分支时间点逐步被解析，从而使规划轨迹能够适应意图的异步揭示。我们还开发了一种基于ADMM的求解器，利用场景级并行性。在紧密耦合的三智能体交互实验表明，所提出的架构优于传统单分支架构，同时实现了更低的平均滚动时域求解时间。

Authors: Bastien Lechardoy, Pau de las Heras Molins, Thibault Lahire, Laurent Pautet, David Filliat, David Fridovich-Keil, Georgios Bakirtzis

When to Adapt: Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection for Efficient Training-Free Adaptation in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation Other

multi-signal domain shift detection training-free adaptation open-vocabulary segmentation continual test-time adaptation robotic perception

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于开放词汇分割中免训练连续测试时适应的多信号域偏移检测方法，旨在减少长期机器人部署中不必要的适应。

TLDR: This paper introduces a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation in open-vocabulary segmentation, aiming to reduce unnecessary adaptations for long-term robotic deployments.

Abstract: Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment. Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware. To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.

摘要（中文）：稳健且可靠的感知能力对于在真实环境中运行的自主机器人至关重要，尤其是在环境条件可能随时间显著变化的长期任务中。尽管视觉基础模型（VFM）的最新进展提升了开放词汇语义分割的性能，但这些模型仍可能受到域偏移的影响，若未能适应当前环境，其性能将显著下降。免训练域自适应是一种相关的自适应范式，其核心在于通过轻量级适配器在线调整模型。近期方法多采用逐帧处理的方式，这对于资源受限的机器人硬件部署而言并不实际。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于开放词汇分割中免训练连续测试时自适应（TF-CTTA）的多信号域偏移检测方法。该方法利用连续帧之间的时间一致性，通过监测并综合域偏移的互补方面（视觉变化、适配器失配和语义漂移）来仅在必要时触发自适应。我们在包含室内与室外环境的基准测试以及真实机器人数据上验证了所提方法。实验结果表明，该方法在保持分割精度的同时显著减少了自适应次数，从而使免训练自适应在长期真实世界机器人部署中变得切实可行。

Authors: Michele Antonazzi, Alejandra C. Hernandez, José Araujo, Olov Andersson, Patric Jensfelt

RoboFin3D: A Sim-to-Real Platform for Robotic Surface Finishing Other

surface finishing sim-to-real Isaac Sim signed distance field perception

简要说明：RoboFin3D 是一个基于 Isaac Sim 的机器人表面处理仿真到现实平台，利用 SDF 建模几何和表面场模拟外观变化，并通过 WeldGen 生成焊缝资产；仿真数据微调 SAM2 可提升未打磨区域分割的 IoU。

TLDR: RoboFin3D is a sim-to-real platform for robotic surface finishing built on Isaac Sim, using SDF for geometry and a surface field for appearance, plus WeldGen for generating weld assets; it shows sim-to-real transfer by improving SAM2 segmentation of unsanded regions.

Abstract: Grinding and sanding are fundamental processes in industrial robotic surface finishing. However, physical trials are expensive and consume workpieces, making reproducible experiments difficult. We present RoboFin3D, a sim-to-real platform built on Isaac Sim and the Newton physics engine, that provides physics-based grinding and sanding simulation for cheap and repeatable robotic surface finishing experiments. RoboFin3D utilizes a signed distance field (SDF) to model the changing geometry of the workpiece, enabling contact computation, live updates and rendering without an intermediate mesh. It additionally uses a separate surface field to model progressive surface appearance change during sanding. We also introduce WeldGen, a weld sampling module, to generate weld beads on 8,918 real-world workpiece meshes for providing diverse simulation assets. The simulation parameters are calibrated on real experimental results and our evaluation demonstrates our simulation's fidelity against the real world. We also demonstrate that simulation-generated data can be used to improve the performance of perception models. Simulation-only fine-tuning of SAM2 improves IoU for segmentation of unsanded regions from 77.15% to 84.47%, while combined synthetic and real training reaches 97.41%.

摘要（中文）：磨削和砂光是工业机器人表面精加工中的基础工序。然而，物理试验成本高昂且消耗工件，使得可重复实验难以实现。我们提出RoboFin3D，一个基于Isaac Sim和Newton物理引擎的仿真到现实平台，为低成本、可重复的机器人表面精加工实验提供基于物理的磨削和砂光仿真。RoboFin3D利用符号距离场（SDF）对工件变化中的几何形状进行建模，无需中间网格即可实现接触计算、实时更新和渲染。此外，它还使用独立的表面场来模拟砂光过程中表面外观的渐进变化。我们还引入了WeldGen，一个焊缝采样模块，在8,918个真实工件网格上生成焊缝，以提供多样化的仿真资产。仿真参数根据真实实验结果进行校准，我们的评估证明了仿真相对于现实世界的保真度。我们还展示了仿真生成的数据可用于提升感知模型的性能。仅使用仿真数据对SAM2进行微调，即可将未砂光区域分割的IoU从77.15%提升至84.47%，而结合合成数据与真实数据训练则可达到97.41%。

Authors: Haowei Wen, Shangtao Li, Vaibhav Sanjay, Philip Huang, Jiaoyang Li, Changliu Liu

Adversarially Robust Geometric Safety Certificates for Nonholonomic Robots Against Maneuvering Obstacles Other

control barrier functions nonholonomic robots safe navigation adversarial robustness kinematic bicycle model

简要说明：本文针对非完整机器人提出对抗鲁棒的几何安全证书，通过收缩安全集的控制屏障函数保证对机动障碍的安全性，并在仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces adversarially robust geometric safety certificates for nonholonomic robots, using control barrier functions with contracted safe sets to guarantee safety against maneuvering obstacles, validated in simulations.

Abstract: Safe navigation against obstacles that can actively maneuver within bounded capabilities remains challenging: robust control barrier function methods typically treat obstacle actions as generic disturbances, while differential-game approaches are computationally expensive for online navigation. We propose an adversarially robust geometric certificate that accounts for the worst-case effect of admissible obstacle maneuvers directly in the safe-set geometry through a closed-form contraction of the certificate parameters. The construction exploits a structural property of line-of-sight (LoS) certificates: the robot and obstacle actions enter the certificate through a common state-dependent geometric gain. This gain cancels in the worst-case comparison, reducing the differential game to a direct comparison between obstacle maneuvering capability and the weaker of the robot's longitudinal and steering authorities. Instantiated on the parabolic certificate, the construction yields Adversarially Robust Dynamic Parabolic Control Barrier Functions (AR-DPCBF), for which we establish sufficient conditions for forward invariance of the contracted safe set against all admissible obstacle maneuvers under kinematic bicycle dynamics with bounded inputs. When the obstacle capability is unknown, a sliding-window estimator supplies a high-probability upper bound, allowing the guarantee to be retained with the corresponding coverage probability. We further formulate soft and buffered variants to recover feasibility in dense environments. Simulations across obstacle capabilities, densities, and capability mismatch show substantial reductions in barrier violations and collisions and demonstrate that pointwise robustification of the barrier derivative cannot substitute for contraction of its geometry.

摘要（中文）：针对具备有界机动能力的主动障碍物的安全导航仍具挑战性：鲁棒控制屏障函数方法通常将障碍物行为视为一般扰动，而微分博弈方法在在线导航中计算成本过高。我们提出一种对抗鲁棒几何证书，通过在证书参数的闭式收缩中，直接在安全集几何中考虑可容许障碍物机动的最坏情况影响。该构造利用了视线（LoS）证书的一个结构性性质：机器人和障碍物的作用通过一个共同的、依赖于状态的几何增益进入证书。该增益在最坏情况比较中相互抵消，从而将微分博弈简化为障碍物机动能力与机器人纵向及转向权限中较弱者之间的直接比较。将该构造应用于抛物线证书，我们得到对抗鲁棒动态抛物线控制屏障函数（AR-DPCBF），并建立了在运动学自行车模型及有界输入下，收缩安全集对所有可容许障碍物机动保持前向不变性的充分条件。当障碍物能力未知时，滑动窗口估计器提供高概率上界，使保证得以以相应的覆盖概率保留。我们进一步提出软性及缓冲变体，以在密集环境中恢复可行性。跨障碍物能力、密度及能力失配的仿真结果表明，屏障违规和碰撞显著减少，并证明屏障导数的逐点鲁棒化不能替代其几何收缩。

Authors: Chandan Kumar Sah, Bazeela Banday, Jishnu Keshavan

Multifunctional Locomotion Control of Multi-Jointed BURs with Swimming and gait Capabilities Locomotion

biomimetic underwater robot multimodal locomotion multi-jointed structure nonlinear control potential function

简要说明：本文提出一种用于多关节仿生水下机器人的机构和控制系统，通过基于传感器的非线性控制和势函数实现游泳和腿式运动的多种运动模式，并在物理和仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a mechanism and control system for multimodal biomimetic underwater robots (BURs) with multi-jointed leg-fins, enabling swimming and legged locomotion via sensor-based nonlinear control and potential functions, validated in physics and simulation.

Abstract: Multimodal biomimetic underwater robots (BURs) can conduct underwater tasks suitable for the environment. Combining the characteristics of aquatic organisms enables the swimming and leggedlocomotion required for underwater exploration. Locomotion control mechanism relies on rule-based behavior selection and the designer's discretion. This limits the robot's ability to acquire new behavioral capabilities to the predetermined range of behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a mechanism and control system that enables the expression of multimodal locomotion capabilities from the same multi-jointed structure. A mechanism equipped with four leg-fins each having four axes is used. This controller achieves nonlinear behavior based on sensor modalities, rather than relying on predefined conditional rule-based on locomotion functions. This system was validated through both physical and simulation testing based on multiple sensor data and behavioral patterns. Utilizing a potential function in multimodal locomotion control was verified to enable transitions between two or three behaviors. Implementing the control method as a multimodal controller is expected to enhance its application in underwater exploration. Our project page is at https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/.

摘要（中文）：多模态仿生水下机器人（BURs）能够执行适应环境的水下任务。结合水生生物的特性，使其具备水下探索所需的游动与步行运动能力。其运动控制机制依赖于基于规则的行为选择及设计者的判断，这限制了机器人获取新行为能力的范围，使其局限于预设行为集之内。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了一种机构与控制系统，能够从同一多关节结构中表达多模态运动能力。该系统采用了一种配备四个腿鳍、每个腿鳍具有四个轴的机构。该控制器基于传感器模态实现非线性行为，而非依赖预定义的基于运动功能的规则条件。通过基于多种传感器数据和行为模式的物理实验与仿真测试，该系统得到了验证。利用势函数进行多模态运动控制，已被证实能够实现两种或三种行为之间的转换。将该控制方法实现为多模态控制器，有望增强其在水下探索中的应用。我们的项目主页为：https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/。

Authors: Takumi Asada, Hideo Furuhashi, Kenta Tabata, Renato Miyagusuku, Koichi Ozaki

All Roads Lead to Rome: Flow-driven Multi-Anchor Exploration for Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping Other

Active 3D Mapping Conditional Flow Matching Exploration Open-Environment Long-horizon planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于开放环境主动三维建图的流驱动多锚点探索方法，将长时程目标预测重新表述为基于条件流匹配的条件多模态锚点生成，并通过聚类和分层选择来选择最佳路径。

TLDR: This paper proposes a flow-driven multi-anchor exploration method for open-environment active 3D mapping, reformulating long-horizon target prediction as conditional multimodal anchor generation using Conditional Flow Matching, and selecting the best path via clustering and hierarchical selection.

Abstract: To advance the development of embodied intelligence, Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping has attracted increasing attention, aiming to perform a long-horizon and shortest trajectory exploration for reconstructing unseen scenarios. Since only limited information about unseen environments is available, methods built on the closed-set assumption, i.e., assuming that the test environments are similar to those seen during training, cannot generalize satisfactorily. In existing active mapping methods, long-horizon exploration is often guided by predicting a coarse long-range goal and then converting it into an executable path. However, this stage is usually formulated as single-point prediction. Under partial observability, the same local observation may correspond to multiple plausible exploration directions, making such deterministic prediction prone to brittle decisions and degraded performance in unseen scenarios. Our experiments further verify that this is a key factor underlying their weak generalization. To address this issue, we reformulate long-horizon target prediction as conditional multimodal anchor generation using Conditional Flow Matching.Instead of predicting a single goal, our method learns a conditional distribution over coarse exploration anchors from the current mapping state. These anchors are first converted into executable candidate paths through obstacle-aware planning. We then apply exploration-mode clustering to compress geometrically similar trajectories and reduce candidate redundancy. Finally, a hierarchical selection module selects the most promising mode and reranks paths within it to produce the final executable trajectory. Experiments show that our method improves generalization and reconstruction efficiency in open environments.

摘要（中文）：为了推动具身智能的发展，开放环境下的主动三维建图日益受到关注，其目标是通过长时程、最短轨迹的探索来重建未知场景。由于对未知环境仅有有限信息可用，基于封闭集假设（即假设测试环境与训练环境相似）的方法难以实现令人满意的泛化性能。在现有的主动建图方法中，长时程探索通常通过先预测一个粗糙的远距离目标，再将其转化为可执行路径来实现。然而，这一阶段通常被建模为单点预测。在部分可观测条件下，相同的局部观测可能对应多个合理的探索方向，使得这种确定性预测容易产生脆弱的决策，并在未知场景中性能下降。我们的实验进一步验证了这是其泛化能力较弱的关键因素。为解决这一问题，我们将长时程目标预测重新表述为基于条件流匹配的条件多模态锚点生成。我们的方法不是预测单一目标，而是从当前建图状态中学习粗粒度探索锚点的条件分布。这些锚点首先通过考虑障碍物的规划转化为可执行的候选路径。随后，我们应用探索模式聚类来压缩几何上相似的轨迹并减少候选冗余。最后，一个分层选择模块选出最有前景的模式，并在该模式内对路径进行重新排序，以生成最终的可执行轨迹。实验表明，我们的方法在开放环境中提升了泛化能力和重建效率。

Authors: Yang Li, Aming Wu, Zihao Zhang, Ziju Han, Sijia Zhang, Yahong Han

Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows RLRobot

offline reinforcement learning diffusion policy refinement flow proposal-conditioned OGBench

简要说明：PReFlow 提出了一种基于提议条件的细化流，结合评论家提议选择与条件流来建模多模态高价值动作，在 OGBench 上取得了优异的离线和在线微调性能。

TLDR: PReFlow introduces a proposal-conditioned refinement flow for offline RL that combines critic-based proposal selection with a conditional flow to model multi-modal high-value actions, achieving strong offline and online fine-tuning performance on OGBench.

Abstract: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.

摘要（中文）：扩散与流策略能够对离线强化学习中的复杂行为进行建模。然而，对其与行为策略之间的KL散度施加惩罚，可能会抑制那些具有高评论家值但行为密度较低的动作。直接优化行为提议或许是一种替代方案，但高斯或确定性编辑器在表达上受限，难以针对同一提议表示多个分离的模态。在本研究中，我们提出提议条件细化流（PReFlow），一种结合基于评论家的提议选择与条件细化流的策略提取方法。为联合优化提议选择与细化过程，我们构建了一个KL正则化目标，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出关于最终动作的吉布斯策略。细化流能够表示多个高值模态，而提议中心的高斯参照则约束大幅动作变化。该高斯参照进一步使我们能够利用无模拟的闭式伴随匹配目标，该目标由采样端点与评论家梯度导出，从而产生单一的速度回归损失，无需反向伴随求解。在50个OGBench任务中，PReFlow取得了具有竞争力的离线性能，并在在线微调后获得所比较方法中的最高总分，在500K环境步后达到91%。

Riemannian Splat Regression Models for Learning Time Fields on Arbitrary Riemannian Manifolds Other

Riemannian manifolds motion planning neural time fields splat regression wrapped Gaussian distributions

简要说明：本文提出了一种黎曼样条回归模型，无需坐标投影即可在任意黎曼流形上学习到达时间函数，并在运动规划中展示了相较于流形自适应MLP的更高精度和效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a novel Riemannian splat regression model for learning time-to-go functions on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds without coordinate projections, demonstrating improved accuracy and efficiency over manifold-adapted MLPs for motion planning.

Abstract: Motion planning on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds is an important and difficult problem that frustrates typical planning methods for Euclidean spaces. In particular, motion planning methods that approximate optimal time-to-go functions with neural networks, e.g., Neural Time Fields (NTFields), cannot be directly applied without using ad-hoc coordinate projections into higher dimensions. Using these methods directly without such projections is desirable, as it promises to provide the lowest-possible-runtime method for obtaining optimal plans on high-dimensional manifolds while using minimal model capacity. In this work, we develop a model that requires no coordinate projection and can learn arbitrary functions on Riemannian manifolds by combining splat regression models with splats defined by wrapped Gaussian distributions. We successfully apply this model for learning arrival time fields on several Riemannian manifolds, and we compare the accuracy and model size of this approach with multi-layer perceptrons adapted to work on each manifold individually.

摘要（中文）：任意黎曼流形上的运动规划是一个重要且困难的问题，常常令针对欧几里得空间的典型规划方法受挫。特别是，利用神经网络近似最优到达时间函数的运动规划方法（如神经时间场，NTFields）在缺乏针对更高维度的特设坐标投影时，无法直接应用。然而，无需此类投影而直接使用这些方法却极具吸引力，因为这有望提供在保持最小模型容量的同时，于高维流形上获得最优规划的最低运行时方法。在本研究中，我们开发了一种无需坐标投影的模型，通过将样条回归模型与由包裹高斯分布定义的样条相结合，能够在黎曼流形上学习任意函数。我们成功将该模型应用于多个黎曼流形上的到达时间场学习，并将此方法的准确性与模型大小同针对各流形单独调整的多层感知机进行了比较。

A robust single-sensing-element tactile sensor for concurrent pressure and tackiness detection with real-time signal decoupling capability Perception3D

tactile sensor Hall effect sensor pressure sensing tackiness detection signal decoupling

简要说明：本文提出一种新型触觉传感器，利用单个霍尔效应元件和软磁复合材料，通过实时信号解耦同时检测压力和粘性（拉力），旨在增强机器人的触觉感知能力。

TLDR: This paper presents a novel tactile sensor that uses a single Hall effect element and a soft magnetic composite to simultaneously detect pressure and tackiness (pull-off force) with real-time signal decoupling, aimed at enhancing robotic tactile sensing capabilities.

Abstract: Integrating tackiness sensation into the artificial skin of humanoid robots significantly enhances their cognitive and operational capabilities. However existing tactile sensors face challenges in decoupling of the multimodal signal and stability. Here we present a surface-soft tactile sensor that incorporates a Hall effect sensor and a soft magnetic composite within a robust elastic framework. The sensor surface indents under pressure and bulges prominently when retracted from sticky surfaces dynamically altering the Hall sensor-magnet distance. This generates whole-process-traceable and baseline-separated signals enabling real-time differentiation between pressure and pull-off force. This single-sensing-element design facilitates bimodal sensing at the same contact spot while eliminate stress cross-talk enhancing both accuracy and sensitivity. The fusion of a robust framework and magneto-mechanical sensing mechanism equips the sensor with exceptional reliability and excellent signal baseline stability. This tactile sensor holds substantial potential for advancing robotic capabilities in evaluating adhesive properties monitoring rubber aging precisely handling lightweight objects and cognizing natural objects surface characteristics.

摘要（中文）：将粘性感知整合到仿人机器人的人造皮肤中，显著增强了其认知与操作能力。然而，现有的触觉传感器在多模态信号解耦及稳定性方面面临挑战。本文提出了一种表面柔软型触觉传感器，其将霍尔效应传感器与软磁复合材料集成于坚固的弹性框架内。该传感器表面在受压时内凹，在从粘性表面回撤时则显著隆起，从而动态改变霍尔传感器与磁体之间的距离。这一机制产生了全过程可追踪且基线分离的信号，能够实时区分压力与剥离力。这种单传感元件设计使得在同一接触点实现双模态感知成为可能，同时消除了应力串扰，提升了精度与灵敏度。坚固框架与磁-机械传感机制的融合，赋予了该传感器卓越的可靠性和优异的信号基线稳定性。该触觉传感器在提升机器人评估粘附特性、监测橡胶老化、精确操控轻质物体以及识别自然物体表面特征等能力方面具有巨大潜力。

Authors: Ying Yang, Mingwei Gu, Jia-Sen Xie, Xingyu Ma, Yan-Na Lu, Lin Zheng, Jinhui Gu, Junshuai Chen, Yunjie Lu, Denys Makarov, Jin Ge

DORA: Divergence-Oriented Data-Relay Algorithm for Partially Connected Robot Teams Other

multi-robot coverage data relay information divergence intermittent communication UAV teams

简要说明：DORA 形式化了异构任务感知覆盖（HMAC）问题，并提出了一种面向分歧的数据中继算法，用于部分连接的无人机团队，将任务相关目标解决延迟最多降低 74.8%。

TLDR: DORA formalizes the heterogeneous mission-aware coverage (HMAC) problem and proposes a divergence-oriented data-relay algorithm for partially connected UAV teams, improving mission-relevant target resolution delay by up to 74.8% over time-based scheduling.

Abstract: Teams of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) deployed for search and monitoring missions frequently operate as partially connected networks, forcing each robot to trade off exploring the environment against relaying information to teammates. This tradeoff is especially acute when robots are semantically heterogeneous: an observation that appears uninformative to the robot that made it may be critical to a teammate with complementary detection capabilities. In this work, we formalize this setting as the heterogeneous mission-aware coverage (HMAC) problem, which couples complete multi-robot coverage of an area with capability-constrained mission-relevant target (MRT) discovery under intermittent communication. We then present DORA, a divergence-oriented data-relay algorithm that drives communication by the value of information to the team rather than by discovery alone. DORA quantifies the mission-relevant divergence between a robot's current information state and its estimate of each teammate's knowledge, capturing mission relevance, discovery novelty, sensor uncertainty, and the age of information. We evaluate DORA in simulation across four environments with differing object densities and spatial structure, and validate it on a physical UAV platform. Our results show that DORA improves MRT resolution delay by up to 74.8% over traditional time-based communication scheduling methods.

摘要（中文）：用于搜索与监控任务的无人机集群常常在部分连通网络条件下运行，这迫使每架机器人在探索环境与向队友传递信息之间进行权衡。当机器人具备语义异构性时，这种权衡尤为严峻：一架机器人认为无信息价值的观测结果，可能对具备互补探测能力的队友至关重要。在本研究中，我们将该场景形式化为异构任务感知覆盖（HMAC）问题，该问题将多机器人区域的完全覆盖与间歇通信条件下受能力约束的任务相关目标（MRT）发现相结合。随后，我们提出了DORA——一种面向散度的数据中继算法，该算法以信息对团队的价值驱动通信，而非仅依赖发现结果。DORA量化了机器人当前信息状态与其对每位队友知识估计之间的任务相关散度，综合考虑任务相关性、发现新颖性、传感器不确定性及信息时效。我们在四种具有不同物体密度和空间结构的环境中进行了仿真评估，并在物理无人机平台上进行了验证。结果表明，与传统基于时间的通信调度方法相比，DORA将MRT解析延迟最多降低了74.8%。

Authors: Jonathan Diller, Fernando Cladera, Camillo Jose Taylor, Vijay Kumar

MagNav: A Dual-Core Magnetic Track Guidance Framework for Lighting-Invariant Navigation in Two-Wheeled Robots Locomotion

magnetic track guidance two-wheeled inverted pendulum cascaded PID Hall-effect sensor lighting-invariant navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自平衡两轮机器人的磁轨导引系统，利用霍尔效应传感器阵列和级联PID控制实现不受光照影响的循线导航，在强光条件下优于光学传感器。

TLDR: This paper presents a magnetic track guidance system for self-balancing two-wheeled robots, using a Hall-effect sensor array and cascaded PID control to achieve lighting-invariant line-following, outperforming optical sensors in bright conditions.

Abstract: Two-Wheeled Inverted Pendulum (TWIP) robots are useful for studying how to control systems that are naturally unstable and have fewer actuators than degrees of freedom. Adding autonomous line-following to these robots is challenging because steering and balancing are closely linked. Most existing systems use infrared sensors, which can be affected by changes in lighting, such as sunlight or shadows, making them reliable only indoors. This paper presents a self-balancing robot that can follow a line using a magnetic track guidance system. By using a five-channel analog Hall-effect sensor array, the robot is not affected by optical interference. The control system uses a cascaded PID structure: the inner loop keeps the robot balanced using data from an inertial measurement unit with a complementary filter, while the outer loop adjusts steering based on the magnetic sensor readings. Stepper motors provide precise torque control without needing extra rotary encoders. For comparison, an optical sensor module was also included. Tests show that the magnetic guidance system keeps accurate tracking even in very bright lighting, over 10,000 Lux, while the optical system loses accuracy and sometimes fails. This design provides a reliable, lighting-independent solution for autonomous navigation in places like factories, warehouses, and outdoor paths.

摘要（中文）：两轮倒立摆（TWIP）机器人对于研究如何在系统天然不稳定且执行器数量少于自由度的情况下实现控制，具有重要价值。在这类机器人上实现自主循线功能颇具挑战性，因为转向与平衡控制紧密耦合。现有的大多数系统采用红外传感器，易受光照变化（如阳光或阴影）影响，因此仅在室内条件下可靠。本文提出一种基于磁性轨道引导系统的自平衡循线机器人。通过采用五通道模拟霍尔效应传感器阵列，该机器人不受光学干扰影响。控制系统采用级联PID结构：内环利用惯性测量单元数据并结合互补滤波器维持机器人平衡，外环则根据磁传感器读数调整转向。步进电机提供精确的力矩控制，无需额外旋转编码器。为便于对比，系统同时集成了光学传感器模块。实验测试表明，即使在超过10000勒克斯的强光环境下，磁性引导系统仍能保持精确跟踪，而光学系统则出现精度下降甚至失效。该设计为工厂、仓库及室外路径等场景中的自主导航提供了一种不受光照影响、可靠性高的解决方案。

Authors: Arpita Kumari, Anupam Chatterjee, Richa Srivastava

GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning Other

UAV planning wind prediction neural operator energy efficiency urban environment

简要说明：GeoWind2Plan利用局部几何条件神经算子，从建筑几何和背景风预测任务时间的三维城市风场，从而在CFD评估的真实风况下实现节能的无人机路径和速度规划。

TLDR: GeoWind2Plan predicts mission-time 3D urban wind fields from building geometry and background wind using a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, enabling energy-efficient UAV path and speed planning under realistic CFD-evaluated wind conditions.

Abstract: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

摘要（中文）：在城市低空飞行中，建筑物将环境风重塑为空间变化的二维流场，使无人机能量既取决于飞行路径长度，也取决于局部风暴露程度。然而，在任务规划阶段，建筑物解析级别的风场信息往往难以获取。计算流体力学能够生成高保真的城市流场，但每次仿真都绑定于固定的入流边界条件，且耗时数小时至数天，与通常仅持续数分钟至数十分钟的城市无人机任务不相匹配。本文提出GeoWind2Plan，一个面向任务时段三维城市风场预测与节能无人机规划的“几何—风场—规划”一体化框架。仅需输入背景风矢量、三维建筑物几何以及起终点对，GeoWind2Plan即将建筑物几何变换至参考风坐标系，利用基于局部几何条件的神经算子预测任务相关的三维风场块，将其拼接为可查询的局部风场，并基于物理驱动的无人机能量模型优化出可行的三维路径与速度剖面。GeoWind2Plan的目标并非追求CFD级完美重建，而是实现面向决策有用的风场预测：轨迹基于预测风场进行规划，并在高保真CFD风场下进行评估。在留出的多个城市域、风速及任务风向角场景中，GeoWind2Plan的走廊局部风场推理仅需约3秒，而CFD约需8小时。在CFD评估下，相较于不考虑风场的规划方法，GeoWind2Plan规划的轨迹在顺风、逆风和侧风任务中分别降低能耗6.9%、12.7%和4.5%，恢复了CFD参考节能量的87.9%、85.7%和75.0%。上述结果表明，快速、走廊局部的三维城市风场预测能够使风感知的无人机能量规划在任务时段内具备实际可行性。

Authors: Shaoxiang Qin, Yucheng Zhao, Fuyuan Lyu, Di Zhou, Jiachen Yao, Xue Liu, Anima Anandkumar, Liangzhu Leon Wang, Xiongye Xiao

GaugeVLM: Structuring Spatial Supervision with Measured Geometric Interventions Other

spatial reasoning vision-language models 3D interventions preference optimization embodied reasoning

简要说明：GaugeVLM通过受控3D干预和测量误差结构化空间监督，提升VLM的空间推理能力，并泛化到自动驾驶和具身推理。

TLDR: GaugeVLM structures spatial supervision in VLMs using controlled 3D interventions and measured errors, improving spatial reasoning and generalization to autonomous driving and embodied reasoning.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can contradict themselves across views of the same spatial relation and fail to respond when that relation changes. Addressing these failures requires supervision that captures error magnitude and geometric dependencies across observations, both of which remain implicit in training on individual answers or ordinal preferences. Therefore, we introduce GaugeVLM, which makes this structure explicit through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes, producing linked observations with measured differences between spatial relations and shared truths across views. To translate this structure into learning signals, its core objective, GaugeDPO, converts measured errors into preference margins, directly supervises correct canonical rankings across views, and links intervention-induced answer-odds contrasts to measured relation changes with view-specific scales. Our analysis bounds canonical prediction error and establishes that the cross-view and intervention constraints can be jointly satisfied. Empirically, GaugeVLM improves all 10 established spatial metrics over supervised fine-tuning across three VLM backbones, with the main 7B model gaining 15.0 and 18.9 percentage points on MSMU distance and QSpatial+, respectively. These gains also extend to autonomous driving and embodied reasoning, demonstrating the robust generalization across domains.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在观察同一空间关系的不同视角时可能会产生自相矛盾的输出，并且在该关系发生变化时无法作出响应。解决这些失败需要能够捕捉误差幅度以及跨观测几何依赖性的监督信号，而这两者在基于单个答案或序数偏好的训练中始终是隐性的。为此，我们提出了GaugeVLM，通过在显式3D场景中进行受控物体与相机干预，生成具有测量到的空间关系差异及跨视角共享真实信息的关联观测，从而使这一结构变得显式。为了将该结构转化为学习信号，其核心目标GaugeDPO将测量误差转化为偏好边际，直接监督跨视角的正确规范排序，并将干预引发的答案几率对比与测量到的关系变化以视角特定尺度相关联。我们的分析界定了规范预测误差，并确立了跨视角约束与干预约束可同时满足。实验上，GaugeVLM在三种VLM骨干网络上相较于有监督微调在所有10项既有空间度量上均取得改进，其中主7B模型在MSMU距离和QSpatial+上分别提升了15.0和18.9个百分点。这些提升同样延伸至自动驾驶和具身推理任务，展示了跨领域的稳健泛化能力。

Authors: Hongbo Wang, Zihan Lin, Wenkui Yang, Shiran Ge, Yuang Ai, Jie Cao, Huaibo Huang, Ran He

DSWM: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal World Model for Demand-Driven UAV Base Station Repositioning Other

world model UAV base station repositioning latent planning demand-driven

简要说明：DSWM 提出了一种分解时空世界模型，结合潜在空间决策时规划，用于无人机基站重定位，在真实流量数据集上达到最先进的覆盖率。

TLDR: DSWM proposes a decomposed spatio-temporal world model with latent-space decision-time planning for UAV base station repositioning, achieving state-of-the-art served ratios on real traffic datasets.

Abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicle base stations (UAV-BSs) are expected to cover traffic demand that shifts across space and time, yet most repositioning schemes either re-solve an optimization problem per slot or learn reactive policies without an explicit demand model. We cast demand-driven fleet repositioning as latent-space decision-time planning and propose DSWM, a decomposed spatio-temporal world model: an agentic controller that perceives the demand field through a rolling observation window, retains operational context in a latent recurrent state, reasons about candidate motions by imagined rollouts under an uncertainty penalty, and coordinates the fleet through replanned first actions. DSWM learns a recurrent state-space model shaped by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) based latent predictive objective with variance regularization. It attaches a differentiable service simulator that replays the association, probabilistic line-of-sight channel, and Shannon rate chain inside latent rollouts. Planning uses a cross-entropy method whose imagined demand is anchored on the current observation window with mixing coefficient $ρ=0.95$. On a unified pipeline over three real datasets (Milan CDR (call detail record), Shanghai Telecom, YJMob100K) and 14 methods including five reproduced IEEE baselines, DSWM attains weekday served ratios of 0.889, 0.908, and 0.898, ranking first among non-ablated configurations on every dataset. On Milan it improves over the strongest non-learning baseline (Greedy, 0.780) by 0.109, a margin that comes from decision-time use of observations rather than prediction accuracy.

摘要（中文）：无人机基站（UAV-BSs）被期望能够覆盖随空间和时间变化而转移的流量需求，然而大多数重定位方案要么在每个时隙重新求解优化问题，要么学习无显式需求模型的反应式策略。我们将需求驱动的机群重定位建模为潜在空间中的决策时规划问题，并提出DSWM，一种分解的时空世界模型：一个智能体控制器，通过滚动观测窗口感知需求场，在潜在循环状态中保留运行上下文，在不确定性惩罚下通过想象回放来推理候选运动，并通过重新规划的首步动作协调机群。DSWM学习一个由基于指数移动平均（EMA）的潜在预测目标（含方差正则化）塑造的循环状态空间模型。它附加了一个可微分的服务模拟器，在潜在回放中重放关联、概率视距信道以及香农速率链路。规划采用交叉熵方法，其想象需求锚定在当前观测窗口上，混合系数ρ=0.95。在包含三个真实数据集（米兰CDR（通话详细记录）、上海电信、YJMob100K）及14种方法（包括五种复现的IEEE基线）的统一流水线上，DSWM在周一至周五的已服务比分别达到0.889、0.908和0.898，在每个数据集的非消融配置中均排名第一。在米兰数据集上，其相对于最强非学习基线（Greedy，0.780）提升了0.109，这一差距来源于决策时对观测值的使用，而非预测精度。

Authors: Shengjie Zhong, Zhongliang Zhao, Jingxuan Chen, Xianbin Cao, Xinmei Qiang, Dapeng O. Wu, Tony Q. S. Quek

HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model WorldModel

interactive world model audio-visual spatial audio 6-DoF camera distillation

简要说明：HelixWorld 提出了一个实时交互式音视频世界模型，联合生成视觉场景和与相机对齐的空间立体声，通过师生蒸馏实现在单GPU上24 FPS的滚动生成，并引入了 HelixBench 基准来评估动态视角下的空间声学一致性。

TLDR: HelixWorld introduces a real-time interactive audio-visual world model that jointly generates visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound, using a teacher-student distillation approach to achieve 24 FPS rollouts on a single GPU. It also proposes HelixBench, a benchmark for evaluating spatial-acoustic consistency under dynamic viewpoint changes.

Abstract: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

摘要（中文）：世界模拟本质上是多感官的，要求视觉与声学动态在实时中同步呈现。然而，现有交互式世界模型仍严格保持静默，仅专注于视觉渲染与控制，忽略了声学维度。我们提出HelixWorld，一种实时交互式视听世界模型，其中视觉场景与基于相机姿态的空间立体声在用户交互下原生协同演化。我们构建了一个高保真空间视听数据集，包含真实立体声学和度量相机位姿，并在此基础上预训练了一个以6自由度相机轨迹和用户动作条件化的双向教师模型。为实现低延迟因果交互，我们通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将教师模型蒸馏为少步流式学生模型，在单块GPU上以24 FPS维持无漂移的联合视听推演。此外，我们形式化了空间声学一致性，并引入HelixBench以评估合成声场是否忠实跟踪动态视点运动。大量实验表明，HelixWorld在视觉保真度和响应性上媲美最先进的静默世界模型，同时在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸感上显著超越现有基线。

Authors: Lei Ke, Jiahao Pan, Zeyue Tian, Jiaming Wang, Haoyuan Huang, Kam Man Wu, Pengjun Fang, Hongyu Liu, Chenyang Qi, Lin Wang, Ruibin Yuan, Weijia Chen, Fangneng Zhan, Qifeng Chen, Wei Xue, Yike Guo

Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models WorldModel

video world model scene memory constant-size representation low-rank memory long-horizon video generation

简要说明：Honeycomb 提出了一种固定大小的场景记忆表示，用于视频世界模型，在保持恒定存储的同时实现长时间视频生成并提升一致性。

TLDR: Honeycomb introduces a fixed-size scene memory representation for video world models, enabling long-horizon video generation with constant memory and improved consistency.

Abstract: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型需要持久的场景记忆，以在长时程视频生成过程中保持一致。现有的空间记忆系统会累积RGB观测或潜在特征，导致存储需求随生成过程不断增长。我们提出**Honeycomb**，一种基于**HexMemory**的视频世界模型，其采用紧凑的低秩表示，将场景特征存储于由六个空间及时空平面组成的固定大小记忆中。前馈写入器将每个新生成的视频块映射为平面特征。随着空间覆盖范围或时间跨度扩大，HexMemory在保持维度不变的同时对现有平面进行扭曲变换，并通过置信度加权池化与学习到的残差校正整合新特征。读取器从HexMemory中检索潜在特征，以条件化后续视频生成。由于写入器仅处理最新视频块的观测数据，Honeycomb避免了逐场景优化以及重复处理完整生成历史。在WorldScore和RealEstate10K上的实验表明，该方法在重访先前观测区域时展现出优异的视频生成质量与稳健的一致性，同时在整个生成过程中保持恒定的特征存储需求。代码及更多可视化内容请访问我们的 https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/。

Authors: Jack Wei Lun Shi, Kaichen Zhou, Haoyu Chen, Yufeng Weng, Keane Ong, Ruojin Cai, Hang Hua, Justin K. W. Yeoh, Mengyu Wang

Scene Retargeting: Learning Object Placement with Analogical Transfer Other

scene retargeting object placement analogical transfer 3D-FRONT layout generation

简要说明：本文提出场景重定向（Scene Retargeting）方法，通过簇级类比转移将三维场景的空间组织迁移到其他布局，在3D-FRONT数据集上优于现有方法，并支持真实到仿真迁移与轨迹迁移等应用。

TLDR: This paper introduces Scene Retargeting, a method to transfer spatial organization from one 3D scene to another via cluster-wise analogical transfer, achieving better layout generation and enabling real-to-sim transfer and trajectory transfer.

Abstract: Interactive simulations of embodied AI or spatial computing applications build on realistic 3D scenes that support daily activities. However, sparse, irregular layout structures impose scene-specific physical constraints, making it hard to define a generalizable framework for generating similar functional context. We formalize Scene Retargeting as stably transferring the semantically coherent spatial organization across layouts, rather than relying on textual descriptions or pairwise relationships. Our cluster-wise transfer flexibly handles mismatched object instances and adapts to distinctive floor plans. We optimize to preserve the rich semantic context of individual clusters by respecting the spatial distribution of foundation features. We can then impose physical constraints to refine wall contacts, pairwise alignment, or clear passageways and openings. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on layout generation on the 3D-FRONT dataset, and demonstrates downstream applications including real-to-sim transfer, analogical trajectory transfer, and multi-reference composition.

摘要（中文）：具身智能或空间计算应用的交互式模拟，建立在支持日常活动的逼真3D场景之上。然而，稀疏且不规则的布局结构施加了场景特有的物理约束，使得定义一个可泛化的框架来生成类似的功能性上下文变得困难。我们将场景重定向（Scene Retargeting）形式化为在不同布局间稳定迁移语义连贯的空间组织，而非依赖文本描述或成对关系。我们的簇级迁移能够灵活处理对象实例数量不匹配的问题，并适应多样化的平面布局。我们通过保留基础特征的空间分布，优化以维持各个簇丰富的语义上下文。随后，我们可施加物理约束，以细化墙体接触、成对对齐，或确保通道与开口的畅通。我们的框架在3D-FRONT数据集上的布局生成任务中优于现有最先进方法，并展示了多项下游应用，包括真实到仿真迁移、类比轨迹迁移及多参考组合。

Authors: Minkwan Kim, Junho Kim, Seungmin Lee, Changwoon Choi, Young Min Kim

DynamicHOI: Coupled Dynamics for Physics-aware HOI Reconstruction Manipulation

physics-aware reconstruction hand-object interaction diffusion refinement coupled dynamics monocular RGB video

简要说明：DynamicHOI 结合几何引导的扩散与手-物耦合动力学，从单目视频中重建手物交互，并通过物理监督和手部驱动概率先验提高轨迹合理性。

TLDR: DynamicHOI reconstructs hand-object interactions from monocular videos by combining geometry-grounded diffusion with coupled hand-object dynamics, adding physics-based supervision and a probabilistic prior on hand actuation to improve trajectory plausibility.

Abstract: We study hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB videos, where partial observations can produce visually plausible yet mechanically inconsistent trajectories. Existing methods mainly enforce visual and geometric agreement, leaving the underlying interaction dynamics insufficiently constrained. We propose DynamicHOI, a physics-aware HOI reconstruction framework combining geometry-grounded diffusion refinement with coupled hand-object dynamics. Geometry spatially grounds visual evidence for trajectory refinement, while articulated inverse dynamics and Newton-Euler dynamics derive hand generalized forces and object wrenches for dynamics-level supervision. We further couple hand and object dynamics through contact-force transfer and recover active hand actuation as an interaction-level physical quantity. We formulate its empirical magnitude distribution into a probabilistic prior that penalizes unlikely actuation and suppresses mechanically implausible reconstructed motion. Experiments on three HOI datasets show consistent improvements in both hand and object reconstruction. The reconstructed trajectories further benefit downstream applications including hand world-model generation and robotic manipulation learning, demonstrating the value of physics-aware HOI modeling beyond reconstruction.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了从单目RGB视频中进行手-物交互（HOI）重建的问题，其中部分观测可能产生视觉上合理但力学上不一致的轨迹。现有方法主要强制视觉和几何一致性，而对底层交互动力学的约束不足。我们提出了DynamicHOI，一种物理感知的HOI重建框架，结合了几何引导的扩散精化与手-物耦联动力学。几何在空间上将视觉证据锚定用于轨迹精化，而关节逆向动力学和牛顿-欧拉动力学则推导出手部广义力和物体 wrench，以实现动力学层面的监督。我们进一步通过接触力传递耦联手和物体的动力学，并恢复主动手部驱动作为交互层面的物理量。我们将其经验幅度分布建模为概率先验，惩罚不可能的驱动并抑制力学上不合理的重建运动。在三个HOI数据集上的实验显示，手和物体重建均取得了一致改进。重建轨迹进一步惠及下游应用，包括手部世界模型生成和机器人操作学习，展示了物理感知HOI建模在重建之外的价值。

Authors: Wenliang Guo, Zhanbo Huang, Yu Kong

One-Step Next-Latent Prediction Is Not a World Model WorldModel

next-latent prediction world model transition kernel isotropy penalty open-loop error

简要说明：本文从理论和实验角度分析了为何一步下一潜在状态预测（如LeNEPA）不足以构成世界模型，强调多步或窗口预测对于捕捉转移动力学的必要性。

TLDR: The paper theoretically and empirically analyzes why one-step next-latent prediction, as in LeNEPA, is insufficient to form a world model, highlighting the need for multi-step or windowed predictions to capture transition dynamics.

Abstract: Next-latent prediction fits a map from the current embedding to the next one. LeNEPA carries this objective to time series, replacing the stop-gradient of next-embedding prediction with the isotropy penalty of LeJEPA. A world model is a transition kernel that can be rolled out. The one-step regression identifies a conditional mean, and a mean is a kernel only in special cases. For a linear-Gaussian Markov latent, the mean transition and the innovation covariance are fixed by the one-step problem, and the open-loop squared error at horizon $K$ equals the trace of the sum of the pushed-forward innovation covariances. That error grows with $K$ after the one-step fit is exact. If the conditional mean is nonlinear, composing it is not the multi-step conditional mean. If the observation is a non-injective function of a Markov state, a memoryless one-step map does not determine future observations, while a short window can. An isotropy penalty is a function of the embedding marginal, so its partial derivative in the transition weights is zero. On a scalar autoregression with coefficient $0.9$, the one-step mean squared error is $0.998$ and the $16$-step open-loop error is $5.10$. On a hidden rotation, an eight-step window reaches $16$-step error $0.056$, while the current scalar alone reaches $0.778$. Raising the isotropy weight from $0.1$ to $10$ leaves eight-step latent error inside $[0.78,0.85]$ on three seeds.

摘要（中文）：下一潜变量预测拟合了从当前嵌入到下一嵌入的映射。LeNEPA将该目标应用于时间序列，用LeJEPA的各向同性惩罚替代了下一嵌入预测中的梯度停止。世界模型是一种可展开的转移核。单步回归识别条件均值，而均值仅在特殊情况下才是核。对于线性高斯马尔可夫潜变量，均值转移和创新协方差由单步问题确定，且水平为\( K \)的开环平方误差等于前推创新协方差之和的迹。在单步拟合精确后，该误差随\( K \)增大。若条件均值为非线性，则其复合并非多步条件均值。若观测是马尔可夫状态的非单射函数，则无记忆的单步映射无法确定未来观测，而短窗口可以。各向同性惩罚是嵌入边际的函数，因此其对转移权重的偏导数为零。在系数为\( 0.9 \)的标量自回归中，单步均方误差为\( 0.998 \)，16步开环误差为\( 5.10 \)。在隐旋转中，八步窗口达到16步误差\( 0.056 \)，而仅当前标量达到\( 0.778 \)。将各向同性权重从\( 0.1 \)提高到\( 10 \)，在三个随机种子上八步潜变量误差保持在\( [0.78,0.85] \)范围内。

Authors: Shitong Wang, Zhongang Cai, Yuzhou Hong

Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning Other

adaptive computation loop transformers reinforcement learning policy learning robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出Looped Actor，一种具有自适应计算能力的基于Transformer的强化学习策略，通过共享模块反复细化潜在表示，在需要多步规划的任务中匹配或超越参数多16倍的基线模型。

TLDR: This paper introduces Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy with adaptive computation for reinforcement learning, which repeatedly refines a latent representation via a shared block to match or exceed the performance of a much larger untied baseline, especially in tasks requiring multistep planning.

Abstract: Looped reasoning models repeatedly apply a shared set of parameters, enabling more computation without increasing the model size. These models also support input-dependent computation by dynamically deciding when to stop looping. Motivated by the recent success of looped transformers in language modeling and reasoning, we investigate whether dynamic looping can similarly benefit sequential decision-making. We provide a complexity-theoretic motivation for this approach by showing that there exist Markov decision processes in which a state-adaptive policy achieves the optimal return with asymptotically less expected computation than any optimal fixed-runtime policy. To learn compute-adaptive policies in practice, we introduce Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block. This allows the model to allocate computation adaptively by varying the number of loops based on the current state. We evaluate Looped Actor on 22 tasks across six environments, ranging from combinatorial puzzles to robotic manipulation and spanning online and offline reinforcement learning (RL) with discrete and continuous actions. Looped Actor matches or exceeds the performance of an untied baseline with 16$\times$ more parameters, with the largest gains in environments where action selection requires substantial multistep planning. For the Boxoban environment, we find that the computation allocation is structured: the number of loops increases with the number of remaining pushes and future optimal pushes become increasingly predictable from the latent state over successive loops. Together, these results highlight actor looping as a simple and efficient way to equip RL agents with adaptive computation and improve their planning capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/camail-official/LoopedActor

摘要（中文）：循环推理模型重复应用一组共享参数，从而在不增加模型规模的情况下实现更多计算。这类模型还通过动态决定何时终止循环，支持依赖于输入的计算分配。受循环Transformer近期在语言建模和推理领域取得成功的启发，我们探讨了动态循环是否同样能够惠及序贯决策问题。我们从计算复杂度角度为该方法的合理性提供了理论支撑，证明了存在一类马尔可夫决策过程，在这些过程中，状态自适应策略能够以渐进意义上更少的期望计算量达到最优回报，而任何最优的固定运行时长策略都无法实现这一点。为了在实际中学习计算自适应策略，我们提出了Looped Actor——一种基于Transformer的策略模型，它通过一个共享计算模块，将潜在表示反复精化至不动点。这使得模型能够根据当前状态动态调整循环次数，从而实现计算资源的自适应分配。我们在六个环境中的22项任务上评估了Looped Actor，任务范围涵盖组合谜题到机器人操作，并涉及在线与离线强化学习（RL），动作空间包含离散与连续类型。实验结果表明，Looped Actor在性能上与参数数量为其16倍的解耦基线相当或更优，并且在那些动作选择需要大量多步规划的环境中提升最为显著。在Boxoban环境中，我们发现计算分配具有结构性特征：剩余推箱次数越多，循环次数越多，且随着循环的推进，未来的最优推箱动作从潜在状态中变得越来越可预测。综合来看，这些结果凸显了actor循环作为一种简单而有效的方式，能够为强化学习智能体赋予自适应计算能力并增强其规划能力。代码已公开于 https://github.com/camail-official/LoopedActor
